About the Job

Join us as a Senior Technical Support Engineer and help drive the resilience, scale, and efficiency of our global value transfer infrastructure. This role is perfect for a highly technical, detail-oriented professional who excels at architectural problem-solving and acts as the ultimate escalation point for our most complex integration and infrastructure challenges.

You will not only play a critical part in ensuring our digital asset and fiat transactions move seamlessly for our enterprise partners, but you will also lead the charge in building internal improvements, driving product engineering decisions, and mentoring the broader support team. If you enjoy deep-diving into code, architecting scalable support processes, and communicating directly with high-tier clients to make an immediate, global impact, this role is for you.

Responsibilities

  • Advanced Technical Troubleshooting: Act as the final escalation point for the support team. Deep-dive into complex codebases, distributed systems, and enterprise client integrations to identify hidden bugs, performance bottlenecks, and intricate configuration issues.
  • Product & Engineering Advocacy: Partner closely with Software Engineering and Product teams to escalate critical bugs, advocate for architectural improvements based on client feedback, and directly influence the technical roadmap.
  • Advanced Tooling & Automation: Architect and build internal tools, scripts, and comprehensive dashboards to automate support workflows, reduce resolution times, and monitor overall API health at scale.
  • Proactive Alerting & Systems Reliability: Lead the creation of robust alerts, observability monitors, and detailed runbooks to catch platform issues before they impact end-users.
  • Critical Incident Management: Take the reins during major incidents, providing immediate, high-level support and transparent communication for our enterprise partners during critical application and infrastructure events. Lead post-incident root cause analyses (RCAs).
  • Mentorship & Team Elevation: Serve as a technical mentor to junior and mid-level Technical Support Engineers, creating internal training materials and documentation, and leveling up the team's diagnostic capabilities.

Requirements

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in a highly technical client-facing support engineering, solutions engineering, or backend software development role—ideally within enterprise SaaS, fintech / blockchain, or trading infrastructure.
  • Advanced API Knowledge: Deep architectural understanding of REST APIs, SDKs, websockets, webhooks, and how to debug complex authentication and payload issues.
  • Advanced SQL Knowledge: Ability to write complex, optimized SQL queries to retrieve, analyze, and troubleshoot data across massive internal databases.
  • Polyglot Developer: Strong proficiency in writing and debugging code in one or more common programming languages, preferably Python, Javascript/Typescript, or Golang
  • AI Tooling & Automation: Hands-on experience leveraging AI tools, LLM APIs, or AI-driven developer tooling to accelerate code debugging, automate root-cause analysis, and streamline support workflows.
  • Systems & Tooling Mastery: Deep experience with logging and observability platforms, documentation, sophisticated ticket tracking, and SLA monitoring tools.
  • Exceptional Communication: Proven ability to deconstruct and explain highly complex technical issues clearly to both technical engineering teams and non-technical executive stakeholders.

Preferred

  • Hands-on experience working with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure components (AWS, GCP).
  • Strong background in fintech, high-frequency trading, SaaS, or other fast-moving, highly regulated industries.
  • Solid understanding of blockchains, cryptography, web3 technologies, and digital asset market structure.
  • Hands-on experience debugging FIX protocol messages, managing FIX sessions, and troubleshooting connectivity to trading engines, OMS/EMS platforms, or exchange infrastructure.

Benefits

  • Healthcare Insurance: zerohash covers roughly 100% of employee premiums as well as a portion of spouse/children (U.S. only)
  • Vision & Dental Insurance (U.S. only)
  • Chance to earn equity
  • Maternity & Paternity leave (after 6 months)
  • WeWork All Access Membership
  • WFH Yearly Stipend
  • L&D Yearly Stipend (after 6 months)

About zerohash

zerohash is the leading crypto and stablecoin infrastructure platform and the operating system for digital money, powering the next generation of financial services. Founded in 2017, zerohash enables banks, brokerages, fintechs, and payment companies to offer crypto trading, stablecoin payments, and tokenized assets without having to build or manage complex blockchain infrastructure on their own.

The zerohash platform supports three core pillars: Trade, Transact, and Tokenize. Through a single integration, customers can launch regulated crypto buy, sell, and custody services; enable 24/7 stablecoin-based funding, payouts, and settlement; and issue and manage tokenized assets with built-in compliance, risk controls, and reporting. By abstracting away technical, regulatory, and operational complexity, zerohash allows partners to treat digital assets as just another financial primitive: fast, programmable, and global.

zerohash is trusted by some of the world’s most recognized financial and consumer brands, including Interactive Brokers, Morgan Stanley, Stripe, Franklin Templeton, BlackRock, DraftKings, Gusto, Worldpay, Kalshi, One Pay, among others. Today, zerohash infrastructure supports millions of end users across brokerage, wealth, payments, and marketplace platforms globally.

The company is deeply regulated and compliance-first, operating across the U.S. and internationally with licenses and approvals that allow partners to enter crypto and stablecoins with confidence. zerohash has become a trusted partner for enterprises seeking to modernize financial products while meeting the highest standards for security, risk management, and regulatory oversight.

To date, zerohash has raised over $280 million in funding from a mix of leading venture firms and strategic investors, including Morgan Stanley, Interactive Brokers, SoFi, Point72 Ventures, Bain Capital Crypto, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and more.

zerohash has been featured in top-tier media outlets such as Bloomberg, CNBC, The Wall Street Journal, Financial Times, Reuters, Forbes, and CoinDesk, and its leadership team regularly contributes to global conversations on the future of payments, investing, and financial infrastructure.

At zerohash, we're building the infrastructure that makes digital money work securely, compliantly, and at global scale.

The zerohash Culture

All zerohash employees are guided by the following characteristics and core principles:

  • Independence/Ownership - An ability to work autonomously. Join zerohash, pitch ideas, and shape the work you do.
  • Passion - We are innovating quickly and challenging the status quo. We want you to think big, be creative and ​make a difference every day.
  • Collaborative - A good attitude and respect for others. We’re teammates, not co-workers. Everything we do is a shared success and equally a shared failure - we talk in terms of “we” not “me”.
  • Initiative - An ability and passion for learning and asking questions. We will champion you, challenge you and push you to achieve your best - and we expect you to do the same.
  • Empathy - An ability to listen, respect, and understand your co-workers, customers, and everyone you interact with no matter how different they are to you.
  • Adaptability - An ability to respond quickly. We are in a fast-paced industry and so we expect you to be creative when solving a new problem and comfortable under pressure.
  • Transparency - We believe that transparency is critical to empowering everyone to make the best decisions, both the company to its people and vice versa.

jobs.title: Family Offices Services Manager
jobs.excerpt: Family Office Investment Services ManagerAbout the RoleFSM seeks a CFA Charterholder to lead investment services delivery — and directly manage capital — across a growing roster of ultra-high-net-worth client families.
jobs.description:
Family Office Investment Services Manager

About the Role

FSM seeks a CFA Charterholder to lead investment services delivery — and directly manage capital — across a growing roster of ultra-high-net-worth client families. This role carries a dual mandate: you are both the institutional framework builder who ensures every advisor is tracked, benchmarked, and held accountable, and a discretionary portfolio manager with direct responsibility for assigned capital sleeves within each client's overall allocation.

This is a rare seat for a CFA who has managed real money, is fluent in multi-asset portfolio construction, and can simultaneously operate at the orchestration level — sitting above a roster of outside managers — and at the execution level, managing positions directly. You will not be a passive scorekeeper. You will be in the game.

What You'll Own

Discretionary Portfolio Management

  • Manage assigned capital sleeves across client portfolios on a fully discretionary basis, spanning liquid equities, fixed income, and select alternatives
  • Construct and maintain model portfolios with explicit factor exposures, benchmark targets, and risk budgets approved by the client principal
  • Execute investment decisions including security selection, position sizing, rebalancing, and tactical allocation shifts within the agreed investment policy statement (IPS)
  • Generate time-weighted and money-weighted return reporting on directly managed sleeves, held to the same S&P 500 benchmark standard applied to all outside managers
  • Produce written investment rationale for every material position change — no undocumented trades
  • Coordinate with client tax advisors on tax-lot management, wash sale rules, and the interaction between active trading and the client's broader tax posture

Investment Oversight & Multi-Manager Coordination

  • Maintain and continuously improve performance measurement frameworks for each client's full advisor roster, benchmarked against the S&P 500 and appropriate secondary indices
  • Produce quarterly manager scorecards covering rolling 1-, 3-, and 5-year returns (gross and net of fees), with plain-English summaries written for principals, not advisors
  • Build and maintain pairwise correlation matrices and factor-decomposed diversification analyses across all active managers, including directly managed sleeves
  • Perform look-through concentration analysis to surface true single-name, sector, geography, and thematic exposures across the entire portfolio — including positions you hold directly

Portfolio Analytics & Risk

  • Decompose each manager's results by asset class, sector, and factor exposure (value, growth, size, momentum); apply the same attribution framework to your own directly managed sleeves
  • Develop and maintain liquidity waterfall models under defined stress scenarios, incorporating LP lockups, directly held positions, real estate assumptions, and credit line availability
  • Monitor concentration risk in real time across all sleeves — both managed externally and managed directly — and escalate when aggregate exposures exceed agreed thresholds
  • Partner with the FSM operations team on cross-entity insurance and risk audits, contributing investment-side risk context

Investment Policy & Client Governance

  • Draft and maintain a written Investment Policy Statement (IPS) for each client, covering return objectives, risk tolerance, liquidity requirements, constraints, and benchmark selection
  • Lead quarterly investment review meetings with family principals; present performance of directly managed sleeves alongside outside manager scorecards in a unified format
  • Participate in asset allocation reviews with the client's strategic advisor; provide quantitative support for allocation shift recommendations
  • Translate institutional-grade analytics into direct, no-jargon deliverables that respect client sophistication without burying them in unnecessary complexity

Advisor Coordination & Governance

  • Serve as FSM's primary point of contact for each client's wealth management roster, operating as an objective oversight layer above individual outside managers
  • Facilitate quarterly advisor review sessions; provide written scorecard summaries to the client principal in advance of each meeting
  • Coordinate on capital call timing, distribution reinvestment, and cash management across all sleeves

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in finance, economics, mathematics, or a related quantitative field
  • CFA Charterholder in good standing
  • Series 65 (or Series 66) license, or willingness to obtain prior to assuming discretionary management responsibilities; RIA registration experience preferred
  • 7+ years of experience in investment management, with demonstrated responsibility for managing discretionary capital — not just analyzing or recommending
  • Deep fluency in portfolio construction, performance attribution, factor analysis, and multi-asset risk management
  • Direct experience with investment policy statements, rebalancing frameworks, and client-level reporting for discretionary accounts
  • Demonstrated experience working in or alongside multi-entity family office structures (trusts, LLCs, LP structures, multi-state tax exposure)
  • Proficiency with portfolio management and analytics tools (Addepar, Black Diamond, Orion, Masttro, or equivalents); ability to operate effectively without them when necessary
  • Exceptional written communication — your investment memos and scorecards will go directly to principals

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience as a named portfolio manager on a discretionary account with documented performance track record
  • Experience managing capital in a family office or multi-family office environment, not just an institutional or retail wealth context
  • Familiarity with crypto asset reporting, covered call overlays on concentrated positions, and the tax coordination those strategies require
  • Working knowledge of LP/PE structures, capital call mechanics, and IRR computation for illiquid sleeves
  • Comfort operating without a large support infrastructure — this role rewards self-sufficiency and judgment under ambiguity

What FSM Is Not Looking For

  • Analysts who have recommended trades but never owned the P&L
  • Advisors whose primary value proposition is tax optimization over investment returns
  • Portfolio managers who manage to a style box rather than to a client's actual objectives
  • Candidates who equate glossy client materials with institutional rigor

Who You'll Work With

You will report to FSM's engagement lead and work alongside the FSM operations team, client tax advisors, outside wealth managers, legal counsel, and the family principals themselves. Clients are performance-first, intellectually rigorous, and allergic to theater. You will be held to the same benchmark standard you apply to every outside manager on the roster — and that's exactly the point.

Compensation

Competitive base salary commensurate with experience, performance-based bonus tied to portfolio outcomes, client retention, and deliverable quality, and equity participation in FSM's family office practice as it scales. AUM-based compensation is not the primary structure — by design — though performance incentives tied to risk-adjusted returns on directly managed sleeves are on the table for the right candidate.

About Sage Haus

At Sage Haus, we empower busy parents to reclaim their time and energy by building home systems and connecting them with the right support, such as house managers, family assistants, and meal prep chefs. We’re passionate about lightening the mental load of parenthood, creating practical solutions, and showing families how outsourcing is attainable and approachable.

About the Role

We’re seeking a dynamic and motivated Hiring Services Specialist to join our growing team. This is a key role that blends recruiting, sales, customer service, and administrative support to help connect families with top-tier candidates while ensuring a seamless hiring process.

In addition to supporting family-specific searches, this role will own a designated supply territory and play an active role in building and maintaining candidate supply in that region.

As a Hiring Services Specialist, you’ll collaborate closely with candidates, clients, the hiring team, as well as the VP of Hiring Services and your Regional Manager, to deliver an exceptional experience throughout the hiring journey. This is a highly family-facing role, ideal for someone who is organized, communicative, and energized by relationship-building.

Who We’re Looking For

You are:

  • Compassionate and people-centered — you care deeply about helping others thrive
  • Customer service oriented — you create warm, positive interactions and know how to read the room
  • A believer in our mission — you understand the mental load of parenthood and want to help lighten it
  • A strong communicator — clear, responsive, and thoughtful, with good judgment about when to loop in the team
  • Confident and capable — you take initiative and problem-solve without needing constant direction
  • Intuitively aware — you have a strong sense of judgment when evaluating candidates and navigating conversations
  • Organized and detail-oriented — systems and structure help you do your best work
  • Energetic and positive — you bring enthusiasm and care to your work
  • Curious and eager — you enjoy learning, improving processes, and asking good questions

Responsibilities

Hiring Support

  • Participate and lead client kickoff calls to understand family dynamics, role requirements, and household needs, then craft tailored job descriptions to guide the hiring process
  • Conduct research to identify and source qualified candidates
  • Post job openings across various platforms and manage job boards
  • Screen resumes to identify strong potential candidates
  • Coordinate and schedule interviews between clients and candidates
  • Communicate regularly with candidates, providing updates and answering questions
  • Conduct initial candidate interviews to assess skills, experience, and alignment with client needs, using sound judgment to identify strong matches

Territory Ownership & Supply Building

  • Own a designated geographic territory and actively build candidate supply within that market
  • Proactively source, engage, and nurture candidates for current and future family roles
  • Maintain a strong bench of top talent for your territory, even when no active family role is open
  • Partner with the hiring team to ensure candidates are routed into the appropriate supply pipelines and kept warm for future opportunities

Sales & Outreach

  • Perform outbound outreach to prospective clients via email, social media, or other platforms
  • Engage with potential clients and candidates on social media to promote Sage Haus services and support brand awareness

Administrative Tasks

  • Manage administrative aspects of the hiring process, including tracking progress, sending follow-ups, and keeping the Notion CRM up to date
  • Attend weekly pipeline meetings
  • Update the Sage Haus website with job postings, updates, and other relevant content
  • Partner with the VP of Operations & Strategy on administrative, SOP, and process-related work as needed

  • Recruiting, hiring, or talent sourcing experience (preferred)
  • Strong organizational and multitasking skills
  • Clear, professional, and empathetic communication style
  • Sales or outbound outreach experience (a plus)
  • Comfort using email platforms, social media tools, and website management systems (Notion used as CRM)
  • Collaborative, adaptable, and comfortable in a fast-moving environment

Schedule & Work Environment

  • Full-Time: 30–40 hours per week, flexible schedule
  • Remote: Work from anywhere with reliable, high-speed internet and the ability to take Zoom calls

  • Own a territory and contribute directly to long-term supply growth
  • Work closely with families, candidates, and a collaborative leadership team

How to Apply

jobs.description:
Job Title: Chef principal des essais cliniques, IQVIA Biotech/Senior Clinical Trial

Job Location: Ottawa, Canada

Job Location Type: Home-based

Job Contract Type: Full time

Job Seniority Level:

Chef principal des essais cliniques

IQVIA Biotech collabore exclusivement avec des entreprises de biotechnologie et des sociétés biopharmaceutiques émergentes pour soutenir le développement clinique à toutes les phases et dans tous les domaines thérapeutiques. Notre structure agile, notre culture collaborative et notre expertise thérapeutique approfondie nous permettent d'offrir des solutions sur mesure qui contribuent à accélérer l'accès des patients à des traitements innovants.

IQVIA Biotech est à la recherche d'un(e) Chef principal des essais

cliniques possédant de l'expérience en oncologie et à l'échelle mondiale.

Les responsables cliniques jouent un rôle essentiel dans la réalisation des essais cliniques. En étroite collaboration avec les équipes cliniques, ils contribuent à améliorer la vie des patients en accélérant la commercialisation de nouveaux médicaments. Membre clé de l'équipe de projet, le gestionnaire clinique est responsable de la réalisation des études cliniques afin de répondre aux exigences contractuelles, conformément aux procédures opérationnelles normalisées (POS), aux politiques et aux pratiques en vigueur. Il assure la réalisation des essais cliniques pour les clients, pilote les équipes cliniques et collabore avec les chefs de projet et les autres équipes fonctionnelles pour garantir le respect des exigences de réalisation à chaque étape.

Fonctions essentielles :

  • Assurer la réalisation des essais cliniques des projets assignés, conformément aux exigences réglementaires (Conférence internationale sur l'harmonisation (ICH) - Bonnes pratiques cliniques (BPC), protocole), aux exigences du client (contrat) et aux exigences internes (politiques, procédures opérationnelles standard (POS), plans de projet).
  • S'assurer que les objectifs de recrutement des projets sont atteints et s'assurer de la mise en place de stratégies de recrutement appropriées.
  • Contribuer à l'élaboration du plan de gestion des risques du projet et gérer les risques cliniques tout au long de son cycle de vie.
  • Assurer la qualité des essais cliniques en identifiant les normes et exigences de qualité, en planifiant les modalités d'évaluation de la conformité et en assurant le suivi et la gestion des problèmes de qualité clinique. • Gérer les aspects cliniques du financement du projet, y compris l'estimation à l'achèvement (EAC). Comprendre la portée de la prestation clinique et élaborer des plans pour sa mise en œuvre. Suivre et gérer les modifications par rapport à l'estimation à l'achèvement (EAC) de référence et identifier les occasions de services supplémentaires ou les travaux hors périmètre.
  • Identifier les intervenants cliniques du projet et gérer les intervenants internes et externes grâce à une communication efficace et une gestion rigoureuse des problèmes.
  • Collaborer avec l'équipe clinique pour atteindre les objectifs fixés. Faire rapport aux intervenants internes et externes conformément aux exigences du projet.
  • Planifier les ressources et les talents de l'équipe clinique. Encadrer l'équipe clinique au niveau du projet afin d'assurer sa réussite grâce à la mise en place de plans opérationnels de haute qualité, à des formations et à des accompagnements adaptés.
  • Animer des réunions d'équipe régulières et communiquer efficacement pour atteindre les objectifs.
  • Contribuer au perfectionnement professionnel en fournissant une rétroaction aux gestionnaires de première ligne de l'équipe clinique sur leur rendement par rapport aux tâches du projet.
  • Participer, s'il y a lieu, à l'élaboration de la stratégie de prestation clinique pour les propositions. Participer à la préparation et aux réunions de soutenance des offres. Élaborer et présenter le plan d'opérations cliniques en partenariat avec le développement des affaires et la direction de projet. • Peut encadrer et former les nouveaux collègues lors de leur intégration.
  • Peut agir à titre de responsable clinique principal(e) aux côtés d'autres responsables cliniques pour la réalisation d'essais cliniques internationaux de grande envergure.
  • Peut participer aux visites de sites, le cas échéant, pour soutenir la réalisation des projets.

Qualifications

  • Baccalauréat en sciences de la santé ou autre discipline scientifique requise.
  • 5 ans d'expérience en recherche/monitoring clinique ou combinaison équivalente de formation et d'expérience requise.
  • Connaissance de base des pratiques et de la terminologie de la gestion de projet requise.
  • Bonne connaissance des exigences réglementaires applicables à la recherche clinique, notamment les Bonnes Pratiques Cliniques (BPC) et les lignes directrices de la Conférence Internationale sur l'Harmonisation (ICH).
  • Solides connaissances des protocoles et des aspects thérapeutiques.
  • Comprendre les aspects financiers des projets.

Senior Clinical Trial Manager

IQVIA Biotech collaborates exclusively with biotechnology companies and emerging biopharmaceutical companies to support clinical development across all phases and therapeutic areas. Our agile structure, collaborative culture, and deep therapeutic expertise enable us to offer tailored solutions that help accelerate patient access to innovative treatments.

IQVIA Biotech is seeking a SeniorClinical Trial Manager with oncology experience and a global perspective.

Clinical Trial Managers play a vital role in the conduct of clinical trials. Working closely with clinical teams, they contribute to improving patients' lives by accelerating the commercialization of new medicines. As a key member of the project team, the Clinical Trial Manager is responsible for conducting clinical studies to meet contractual requirements, in accordance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), policies, and best practices. They ensure the successful execution of clinical trials for clients, lead clinical teams, and collaborate with project managers and other functional teams to guarantee adherence to execution requirements at every stage.

Essential Functions:

  • Ensure the execution of clinical trials for assigned projects, in accordance with regulatory requirements (International Conference on Harmonisation (ICH) - Good Clinical Practice (GCP), protocol), client requirements (contract), and internal requirements (policies, standard operating procedures (SOPs), project plans).
  • Ensure that project recruitment targets are met and implement appropriate recruitment strategies.
  • Contribute to the development of the project risk management plan and manage clinical risks throughout its lifecycle.
  • Ensure the quality of clinical trials by identifying quality standards and requirements, planning compliance assessment methods, and monitoring and managing clinical quality issues.
  • Manage the clinical aspects of project funding, including the Estimate at Completion (EAC). Understand the scope of clinical delivery and develop plans for its implementation. Track and manage changes to the baseline Estimate at Completion (EAC) and identify opportunities for additional services or out-of-scope work.
  • Identify and manage the project's clinical stakeholders, both internal and external, through effective communication and rigorous issue management.
  • Collaborate with the clinical team to achieve established objectives. Report to internal and external stakeholders as required by the project.
  • Plan the clinical team's resources and talent. Coach the clinical team at the project level to ensure its success through the implementation of high-quality operational plans, appropriate training, and mentoring.
  • Lead regular team meetings and communicate effectively to achieve objectives.
  • Contribute to professional development by providing feedback to the clinical team's frontline managers on their performance against project tasks.
  • Participate, as appropriate, in the development of the clinical delivery strategy for proposals. Participate in the preparation and presentation of proposals. Develop and present the clinical operations plan in partnership with business development and project management.
  • May mentor and train new colleagues during their onboarding.
  • May act as a lead clinical manager alongside other clinical managers for the execution of large-scale international clinical trials.
  • May participate in site visits, as required, to support project execution.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in health sciences or another scientific discipline required.
  • 5 years of experience in clinical research/monitoring or an equivalent combination of education and experience required.
  • Basic knowledge of project management practices and terminology required.
  • Sound knowledge of regulatory requirements applicable to clinical research, including Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and International Conference on Harmonisation (ICH) guidelines.
  • In-depth knowledge of protocols and therapeutic aspects.
  • Understanding of the financial aspects of projects.

IQVIA est un fournisseur mondial de premier plan de services de recherche clinique, d'informations commerciales et de renseignements sur les soins de santé pour les secteurs des sciences de la vie et de la santé. IQVIA se consacre à accélérer le développement et la commercialisation de traitements médicaux innovants pour aider à améliorer les résultats des patients et la santé de la population dans le monde entier. jobs.description:
Description du poste

Alphanumeric recrute un Spécialiste bilingue du service client dans le secteur pharmaceutique (anglais/français) - CDI à temps plein (télétravail au Canada)pour travailler à distance et soutenir l’une des plus grandes sociétés pharmaceutiques au monde. Vous fournirez du soutien relativement à des produits liés au diabète, à l’obésité, aux maladies rares ainsi qu’à la santé cardiovasculaire et hépatique.

Il s’agit d’un centre de contact à volume élevé, et les candidats sont sélectionnés pour offrir une expérience de service à la clientèle optimisée et personnalisée. Ce poste joue un rôle essentiel dans le soutien aux patients, aux professionnels de la santé et aux parties prenantes internes, en fournissant des réponses exactes, rapides et empathiques, tout en respectant les normes les plus élevées en matière de qualité, de conformité et d’éthique.

La personne retenue répondra aux questions fréquemment posées et fournira des renseignements généraux conformes à l’indication approuvée. Elle devra également reconnaître les demandes d’information médicale et les acheminer au service approprié. Le poste exige également de savoir reconnaître les événements indésirables (EI) potentiels et les plaintes potentielles relatives à la qualité des produits (PQP), aux fins de documentation et de signalement.

Veuillez noter que nous ne pouvons embaucher que des personnes résidant déjà au Canada et disposant de documents entièrement légaux et valides les autorisant à y travailler.

Veuillez soumettre votre CV en anglais, puisque les gestionnaires responsables de l’embauche ne sont pas établis au Québec. En plus du français, la personne titulaire du poste doit maîtriser l’anglais à l’oral et à l’écrit, car elle communiquera avec des parties prenantes, des gestionnaires et des clients situés à l’extérieur du Québec, dans un environnement qui exige l’usage de l’anglais. Une préférence sera accordée aux personnes résidant dans le fuseau horaire de l’Est ou dans un fuseau similaire.

Conditions/offre:

  • Emploi: poste permanent à temps plein
  • Mode de travail: entièrement à distance au Canada, de préférence dans le fuseau horaire de l’Est ou un fuseau voisin.
  • Date d’entrée en fonction: 21 septembre
  • Salaire : 45 000 $CA brut par année
  • Heures de travail: 40h par semaine
  • Quarts de travail: du lundi au vendredi, entre 9:00 et 20:00 dans le fuseau horaire de l’Est — quarts de 8 h comprenant une pause-repas d’une heure
  • Avantages sociaux : assurance maladie, soins dentaires et assurance vie après la période d’essai
  • Formation: 3 semaines de formation + 1 semaine de certification, soit 4 semaines
  • Horaires de formation: du lundi au vendredi 8:00-17:00 EST
  • Vacances: 2 semaines de vacances payées
  • Équipement: entièrement fourni par l’entreprise; aucun achat d’équipement n’est requis.
  • Il est obligatoire de résider au Canada et de disposer de documents entièrement légaux et valides (permis de travail, résidence permanente et NAS). Veuillez noter que nous n’offrons pas de parrainage.

Exigences:

  • Excellente maîtrise de l’anglais et du français (il est obligatoire de parler couramment les deux langues)
  • Une préférence sera accordée aux personnes possédant au moins 2 ans d’expérience dans le soutien de centres d’appels pharmaceutiques ou biotechnologiques, ou dans un environnement médical ou commercial
  • Une expérience préalable avec des produits pharmaceutiques dans un centre d’appels pharmaceutique ou biotechnologique est souhaitée
  • Une expérience préalable avec Salesforce et Vonage est souhaitée
  • Une expérience antérieure en centre de contact constitue un atout
  • Passion pour le service à la clientèle, excellentes aptitudes relationnelles au téléphone et volonté d’exceller
  • Capacité à s’épanouir dans un environnement innovant et au rythme soutenu, tout en faisant preuve de souplesse, d’initiative, d’ingéniosité et d’efficacité

Qualités clés et responsabilités:

  • Répondre aux appels entrants généraux, aux clavardages et aux courriels des patients, des professionnels de la santé et des parties prenantes internes, de manière professionnelle et empathique
  • Répondre aux demandes générales des consommateurs et/ou des professionnels de la santé
  • Naviguer sur les sites et aider les utilisateurs à y naviguer
  • Utiliser différents sites et contenus afin que le consommateur ou le professionnel de la santé reçoive un service à la clientèle rapide, complet et professionnel
  • Traiter les demandes et les mises à jour concernant les excursions de température (p. ex., origine de l’excursion de température)
  • Reconnaître et signaler les événements indésirables (EI) potentiels et les plaintes relatives à la qualité des produits (PQP)
  • Consigner les notes de dossier dans le système de gestion de la relation client (CRM)
  • Soutenir le contrat, agir comme agent de liaison et représenter le client
  • Possibilité de quarts rotatifs et de soutien en dehors des heures normales

Compétences et aptitudes requises:

  • Excellentes aptitudes interpersonnelles et capacité à établir et à maintenir des relations importantes avec les principales parties prenantes, par téléphone, clavardage ou courriel.
  • Excellente capacité d’écoute et empathie manifeste envers la personne aidée.
  • Capacité démontrée à communiquer et à distinguer différents types de questions liées aux demandes commerciales
  • Volonté d’apprendre à reconnaître les événements indésirables ou les plaintes relatives aux produits, ainsi qu’à les documenter et à les signaler
  • Capacité à traiter tous les canaux de travail : appels, clavardages et courriels
  • Capacité démontrée à résoudre des problèmes
  • Esprit d’équipe, approche axée sur le service à la clientèle et orientation vers les solutions
  • Capacité à apprendre rapidement à utiliser de nouveaux systèmes et de nouvelles technologies

Compétences techniques:

  • Systèmes d’exploitation : Windows, jusqu’à la version actuelle
  • Outils Microsoft Office
  • Environnement matériel informatique : ordinateurs portables, ordinateurs de bureau et imprimantes
  • Outils de téléphonie, de courriel et de clavardage pour centre de contact — souhaité
  • Connaissance d’un système de gestion de la relation client — souhaitée

Autres exigences:

  • Capacité à rester assis pendant de longues périodes
  • Connaissances informatiques et matérielles de base permettant d’installer un poste de travail à distance
  • Connexion Internet filaire offrant une vitesse minimale de 15 Mbit/s en téléversement et de 15 Mbit/s en téléchargement
  • Disposer d’un espace de bureau privé et calme, sans interruptions, afin de mener des appels professionnels au nom d’un client.
Salary: $45,000 / year

jobs.excerpt: Reports to: Founder & CEO Direct reports: None Location: Canada (Remote) - Toronto area preferred About Odd BunchOdd Bunch is on a mission to make groceries more affordable and accessible across Canada and beyond.
jobs.description:
Reports to: Founder & CEO
Direct reports: None
Location: Canada (Remote) - Toronto area preferred

About Odd Bunch

Odd Bunch is on a mission to make groceries more affordable and accessible across Canada and beyond. We are a fast-growing, sustainable, subscription-based grocery service, helping families save thousands of dollars on their bills, supporting local farmers, fighting food waste, donating to families facing food insecurity, and building a better planet in the process.

About the role

Odd Bunch is scaling across Canada, Australia and now into the US – a company moving this quickly runs when the small things are handled well. The Executive Assistant role keeps the CEO’s world organized so the day-to-day doesn’t slow the bigger picture down. You’ll own the calendar, inbox, travel, and follow-through that keeps things moving, prepare the research and materials behind key decisions, and be a trusted point of contact across the team.

This role suits a generalist who likes range: one day you’re untangling a travel and meeting puzzle across three time zones, and the next you’re pulling together a deck, chasing down a partner, or sitting in on a conversation about a new product or a new market. You get to taste a bit of everything the business is doing, and you work closely enough with the CEO that it turns into a real mentorship seat, a close-up view of how a bootstrapped company gets built, with growing trust and ownership over time.

We care more about drive and the hunger to make things better than about years on a resume. The rhythm is remote and mostly asynchronous, and honest that a founder’s schedule isn’t a 9-to-5, with real give and take on both sides.

What you’ll own

  • The CEO’s time and information flow: Own his calendar, inbox, and travel as one system. Shape his days around the work that matters most, decide what reaches him and what doesn’t, coordinate multi-leg international travel across Canada, the US, and Australia, and stay ahead of conflicts and prep needs before they land on him.
  • Follow-through and execution: Turn his intentions into tracked commitments and push them to completion across the team, partners, and outside advisors. Keep projects on track, and flag problems early rather than letting them grow.
  • Research, briefings, and materials: Pull the research, write the summaries, and build the decks that turn a messy question into a decision the CEO can make quickly. Draft outreach and correspondence, and handle it start to finish when something needs to go out.
  • Communications and relationships: Be a trusted point of contact for the CEO, inside the company and out. Handle what comes in with good judgment, and help manage the relationships and partnerships that matter to the business.
  • Discretion and judgment: Hold sensitive financial, legal, and personal matters in confidence. Know what to quietly handle, what to elevate, and what to keep off his plate.
  • Systems and leverage: Build efficient systems, and use AI where it helps, so one you can stay on top of everything the founder has going on. Leave things better set up than how you found them.

What you’ll dive into

The Executive Assistant role sits in the middle of a fast-growing company, so you won’t just support the work at surface level, you’ll be right in the heart of it:

  • New and innovative products: From our Pantry line expansion to wholesale and other verticals and product launches, you’ll support how they come to life, launch, and iterate.
  • Our tech and tools: The apps, data, and internal systems the business runs on, which you’ll watch evolve and help progress.
  • Global expansion: Help with the groundwork behind entering new markets, from research and diligence to the logistics of getting operations off the ground, starting with bolstering our existing Australia presence and soon to be US going live in the fall.
  • Partnerships that matter: Take part in building new relationships from the first conversation, and help manage & grow our corporate partnerships that move the business forward
  • How a company like this gets built: The financing, real estate, strategy, and hiring calls behind turning a bootstrapped mission-driven business into a global sustainable enterprise

What you bring

  • A few years of experience behind you - though we care more about who you are than how long you’ve been at it. Time in a fast-paced environment is a plus, and if you don’t have it yet - but you pick things up fast and like working out how to do things better - that counts just as much.
  • You take pride in being organized and dependable, and you can shift gears quickly, from the smallest detail to the bigger picture, without dropping the thread.
  • High EQ: You read people and situations well, you tend to see what’s needed before it’s said, and you’ll quickly pick up how the CEO thinks and operates.
  • You’re reliable, the way good operators are. You own what you take on from start to finish, raise problems early, and don’t let things slip through the cracks.
  • You can be trusted with sensitive information (financial, legal, and personal), and you’ve got the judgment to know what needs the CEO’s attention and what doesn’t.
  • You’re comfortable with AI tools and at home in the everyday stack (Gmail, Google Calendar, Slack). A remote, mostly asynchronous rhythm that sometimes runs past standard hours suits you.

Benefits

  • Free grocery plan
  • Annual bonus tied to company growth and individual contribution
  • Health plan available after 3 months
  • RRSP and pension plan available at 12 months
  • 20 days Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Fully remote within Canada, with flexible hours
  • Professional development stipend

jobs.excerpt: ABOUT BAD MARKETING:We're a team of 130+ passionate leaders and creatives who have worked diligently to make BAD Marketing one of the largest and most robust Growth Marketing Agencies in the world.
jobs.description:
ABOUT BAD MARKETING:

We're a team of 130+ passionate leaders and creatives who have worked diligently to make BAD Marketing one of the largest and most robust Growth Marketing Agencies in the world. At the core of our philosophy is the belief that excellence stems from a united team working toward a common objective: to not only help our clients grow profitably but also to provide them with an experience they can’t find anywhere else.

We specialize in local lead generation, e-commerce, and information marketing, catering to clients that span from auto and local shop owners to online consumer product brand owners, online gurus selling courses or coaching, and more.

Our approach to success involves more than just Bold And Disruptive strategies. We invest in our team through extensive training, continuous support for growth and learning, and the cultivation of a happy and confident company culture. For us, finding fulfillment in your career is just as crucial as excelling in it.

ABOUT THIS POSITION:

We're looking for a direct response copywriter who can own creative strategy, ad writing, and email within a client pod in our info/coaching marketing division.

You'll be embedded in a cross-functional pod alongside a strategist, media buyer, and PM - writing ad scripts, body copy, emails, and hooks for clients spending $100k-$1M+ monthly on ads. But this isn't a "write what you're told" role. You're expected to drive the creative strategy process for your pod - analyzing what's working, understanding why it's working, developing new concepts grounded in data, and coming to creative calls with prepared ideas and reasoning. The strategist collaborates and approves, but you lead on what gets tested and why.

You'll also write email copy within frameworks established by a Senior Copywriter - automation sequences, promotional campaigns, nurture flows. And you'll be pulling from messaging foundations (avatar research, messaging bibles, swipe files) that exist to make your creative sharper and more grounded. You're not starting from scratch on every ad - you're building on a strategic base.

If you're the type of copywriter who wants to understand why winners win - not just that they win - and you want to operate as a strategic partner rather than a production resource, this role is built for that.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:

  • You come to creative strategy calls with prepared concepts, data analysis, and clear reasoning for what to test next - not waiting for direction
  • You can explain why a winning ad works - the hook, the awareness level, the belief shift, the lead type - not just that it performed well
  • Your first drafts are close to final - strategists are refining your copy, not rewriting it
  • You know what's winning and losing across your clients without being asked - creative trackers and performance data are part of your daily workflow
  • Iterations are based on insight - what messaging element is driving performance, what objection isn't being handled, what awareness level to target next - not surface-level changes
  • Your ads are grounded in the messaging foundations built by the Senior Copywriter - not improvised from scratch every time
  • The strategist trusts you to lead on creative so they can focus on client relationships and offer strategy
  • Email copy is executed cleanly within Senior-defined frameworks - you understand the sequence purpose and write accordingly

A DAY IN THIS ROLE:

Morning: Review your assigned tasks and creative priorities. Check the creative tracker - what launched? What's testing? Any winners or losers from the last batch? Review any feedback or revision requests.

Writing blocks: The bulk of your day is writing - ad scripts, body copy, leads, emails. You're working from messaging foundations and your own performance analysis, not briefs handed to you fully formed.

Performance check: Review creative trackers, Hyros, and reporting data. Know what's winning and losing. This isn't an occasional check-in - it's a daily habit that drives your next round of concepts.

Creative strategy calls: Weekly with your pod. You come prepared with analysis and concepts - what's working, what's not, what we should iterate on, what net-new ideas are worth testing and why. You drive this conversation.

Throughout the day:

  • Fill out creative briefs with strategic reasoning (angle, awareness level, lead type, hypothesis) - not just the copy
  • Keep the creative tracker updated with batch details before submitting
  • Coordinate with designers and editors on video scripts and static direction
  • Communicate with your strategist and media buyer on creative status and pipeline health

End of day: You can answer: What's the status of my active batches? What's winning and losing for each client? What's next and why?

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 2-3+ years of direct response copywriting experience; info/coaching space preferred
  • Understanding of awareness levels, belief shifts, and persuasion principles - you know why messaging works, not just what to write
  • Experience writing ad copy across formats: video scripts, static copy, body copy, hooks, headlines
  • Ability to analyze creative performance and iterate based on data - not just "try something different" but "here's what I think is working and what to test next"
  • Experience with email copy execution - writing within defined frameworks and understanding sequence purpose
  • Comfortable with performance data - creative trackers, attribution platforms, and reporting tools are part of your workflow, not something you avoid
  • Strong grasp of avatar psychology and offer positioning - you understand the audience you're writing for at a meaningful level
  • Can take loose direction ("we need to test a new angle for this audience segment") and return with developed concepts backed by reasoning
  • Comfortable working within structured systems - creative trackers, naming conventions, brief templates, and approval workflows
  • Collaborative by default - you communicate proactively about status, pipeline, and performance insights without being asked

YOU’LL THRIVE HERE IF:

  • You're energized by understanding why copy works - awareness levels, belief shifts, persuasion principles - not just writing what sounds good
  • You want to drive creative strategy, not just execute someone else's ideas
  • You're curious about performance data and want your work to be measured - wins and losses both teach you something
  • You can take loose direction and come back with developed concepts and clear reasoning
  • You're comfortable pushing back when briefs are unclear or strategy doesn't make sense
  • You want to be a strategic partner to your pod, not a production resource
  • You communicate proactively - you'd rather over-communicate on status and pipeline than let things slip

THIS MAY NOT BE FOR YOU IF:

  • You prefer detailed briefs that tell you exactly what to write
  • You see copywriting as creative expression rather than strategic persuasion
  • You're not interested in performance data or iteration - you'd rather write and move on
  • You're uncomfortable with direct feedback on your work
  • You want to write in isolation without worrying about how creative is performing
  • You prefer to wait for direction rather than bring your own ideas

BENEFITS:

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance plans (US Residents Only)
  • PTO
  • Paid US Holidays
  • Opportunities for professional development and advancement within the organization.
  • A collaborative and innovative work environment with a focus on creativity and results.

ADDITIONAL:

  • 9AM - 6PM EST
  • Remote
  • W2 (US Residents Only)

OUR CORE VALUES:

  • BE BAD
  • PLAY TO WIN
  • EXTREME OWNERSHIP
  • SOLUTIONS NOT PROBLEMS
  • BEST IDEA WINS
  • ALWAYS BE GROWING
  • NOBODY IS BIGGER THAN THE TEAM

jobs.excerpt: The Proportional Representation HubAmerican democracy is at a breaking point.
jobs.description:
The Proportional Representation Hub

American democracy is at a breaking point. Across the country, voters increasingly find themselves throwing up their hands and turning away from a failing political system. Hyper-partisanship has become entrenched. Fewer than one in ten House races is competitive, and 97% of incumbents cruise to reelection: for most voters, the outcome was settled before a single ballot was cast. Little wonder that politicians feel little pressure to deliver legislative results. Public trust in democratic institutions continues to erode as more and more voters tune out.

But the problem isn’t the politicians. It’s the rules. U.S. elections are distorted by single-winner, winner-take-all districts. A party can win 45% of the vote in districts across a state yet it wins no power. The Supreme Court’s evisceration of the Voting Rights Act has made things much worse: voters in communities of color are being carved up and packed into districts engineered to drown out their voices, and the court has triggered a redistricting death spiral. The need for structural reform has never been more urgent.

There is a fix, and most of the world already uses it: proportional representation. The idea is simple––districts elect several members, and a party that wins a third of the votes wins about a third of the seats. It breaks the two-party monopoly, makes every district competitive, eliminates partisan gerrymandering, and reduces polarization.

The Proportional Representation Hub has launched to help build the next chapter of American democracy. We have raised more than $70 million to lead a campaign to advance proportional representation at the local, state, and federal levels and build a government that delivers again. Proportional representation is the best path to create a democracy that better reflects the diversity of the American people, and the best path to end the redistricting wars.

This work is ambitious: forging unlikely coalitions, winning new legislation and ballot measures, changing public narratives, and developing innovative political strategies. Above all, it demands a cross-partisan movement big enough to persuade the huge majority of Americans who say the political system no longer works for them that our democracy can work far better than it does today.

We are building a team of exceptional leaders working together to reshape the architecture of American democracy itself.

Position Summary

The Vice President of Political Strategy & Outreach serves as the organization’s senior political relationship strategist and coalition builder, responsible for organizing partners and leaders to action in support of our campaigns while growing the movement behind proportional representation.

This leader will cultivate the political support, organizational partnerships, and strategic alliances necessary to advance proportional representation across the country. This role focuses on building external relationships and coalitions necessary to propel both the federal and state campaigns to victory.

This role is responsible for building the ecosystem that enables those campaigns to succeed; bringing together civil rights organizations, labor unions, democracy reform organizations, policymakers, right-of-center constituencies, philanthropic partners, campaign organizations, and other influential stakeholders into durable coalitions capable of winning transformational reform.

This executive will serve as one of the movement’s principal ambassadors, helping position proportional representation as one of the defining democracy reforms of the coming decade. The Vice President of Political Strategy and Outreach will serve as a member of the organization’s Senior Leadership Team.

This is a role for a senior strategist, movement builder, and campaign leader who understands how to translate ambitious ideas into real-world political victories.

What You’ll Lead

National Coalition Building

  • Develop and execute a national political engagement strategy that dramatically expands support for proportional representation.
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with nonprofit and political stakeholders and policymakers interested in advancing structural democracy reform and proportional representation at both the state and federal levels.
  • Identify opportunities to bring new sectors, constituencies, and unlikely allies into the movement.

Political Strategy & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Develop strategies and design engagement plans for securing endorsements, institutional support, and public commitments from a diverse range of influential organizations and political leaders, with a primary focus on the ecosystem around elected officials/campaigns rather than the electeds/campaigns themselves.
  • Serve as a senior strategist on coalition dynamics, stakeholder management, and political strategy.
  • Represent the organization with senior political leaders, coalition partners, donors, and public audiences, as well as through speaking engagements, conferences, and media opportunities.
  • Lead the day-to-day execution of the organization’s strategy around key political moments, elections, national conventions, and respond to rapidly changing political opportunities.

Growing the Movement & Building the Field

  • Create and execute strategies to grow the movement for proportional representation nationwide.
  • Bring together organizations across the democracy ecosystem to coordinate on campaigns, share learning, and strengthen collaboration. Design and host national convenings, state strategy meetings, and leadership summits that build alignment across the field.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration across diverse partners with differing priorities, on both the left and right sides of the political spectrum, while maintaining alignment around shared objectives.
  • Partner with congressional and caucus leadership, campaign committees and allied political organizations to advance long-term support for reform.
  • Engage leading constitutional scholars, election law experts, and policy leaders to strengthen the campaign’s strategic foundation.

Supporting Campaign Success

  • Partner closely with campaign leads to ensure campaign efforts are supported by strong political coalitions and stakeholder engagement.
  • Recruit influential validators, partner organizations, and local champions for campaign efforts.
  • Ensure political outreach, field building, and movement infrastructure evolve alongside campaign expansion.
  • Coordinate cross-functional work across communications, research, political outreach, policy, and organizing teams.

Who You Are

The ideal candidate has spent their career building movements, cultivating powerful political relationships, and bringing diverse organizations together around ambitious goals.

You understand that transformational policy victories require more than strong campaigns—they require trusted relationships, durable coalitions, and sustained political organizing.

You are equally comfortable meeting with national labor leaders, civil rights organizations, faith organizations, members of Congress, state legislative leaders, philanthropic partners, grassroots organizers, and campaign professionals. You know how to build trust across institutions, navigate complex political dynamics across partisan divides, and unite organizations behind a shared vision.

You thrive in environments where the goal is not simply to win a campaign, but to build a lasting movement.

DC-based candidates are ideal.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Based in the DC area.
  • 15+ years of senior political, advocacy, organizing, coalition-building, or movement leadership experience.
  • Significant experience leading national or multi-state coalitions or campaigns resulting in significant legislative or policy victories..
  • Deep relationships across civil rights organizations, labor unions, democracy reform organizations, advocacy groups, political committees, and allied institutions.
  • Significant experience working with Congress, congressional leadership, campaign committees, presidential campaigns, or national political organizations.
  • Deep understanding of federal legislative strategy and electoral politics.

Joy 101 is Hoda Kotb's content, community, and experiences company, built on one belief: Joy is a practice, not a destination you arrive at or a reward you earn when life finally gets easier. It's something you choose deliberately, every single day, until choosing it becomes who you are.

We're looking for a part-time (20-30 hrs/week) Lifecycle Marketing Manager to work alongside our Sr. Lifecycle Marketing Manager across both sides of the business: our core consumer product and the enterprise partner programs that offer Joy 101 as a member benefit. The two audiences arrive differently, one by choice and one through their employer, and they need different things from us.

This role is technical first. The hard part of lifecycle here isn't coming up with the idea, it's building the thing correctly with multi-branch logic, event-based triggers, clean data going in, suppression logic, and a rigorous QA process. You'll spend most of your time inside Braze, and you should like it there.

You do, however, need real marketing instincts. You'll design flows, not just wire them, which means understanding why a message lands and where a journey should branch. You'll write and sharpen copy. But we’re looking for a hire who thinks in systems and knows how to build.

This is a part-time contract role, 20 to 30 hours a week for 3 to 6 months, with potential to renew.

What You'll Do

Build the systems

  • Own Canvases, segmentation, behavioral triggers, suppression logic, subscription groups, frequency caps, and send scheduling across consumer and enterprise programs.
  • Design and build multi-branch journey logic that holds up in the real world.
  • Work with data and product on the events, attributes, and instrumentation that lifecycle depends on. Know what you need, ask for it clearly, and verify it's landing correctly before you build on it.
  • Use Liquid, custom attributes, and API-triggered campaigns to do things templates alone can't.

Own QA and program health

  • Set and hold the QA standard: targeting, rendering across clients, link integrity, timing logic, merge tags, fallback values, edge cases. Build it as repeatable process with documentation so that nothing ships unverified.
  • Monitor deliverability, opens, clicks, unsubscribes, and downstream conversion and retention. Flag issues before anyone asks.
  • Diagnose when something breaks: a stalled Canvas, a segment behaving strangely, and a genuinely underperforming message look similar in a dashboard and require different fixes.

Design flows and write the copy

  • Design journey strategy with the Sr. Lifecycle Manager: what the flow should do, where it branches, what triggers it, and what success looks like.
  • Write and sharpen email, push, and in-app copy for both audiences.
  • Make sure every message sounds like Joy 101.

Test, report, and improve

  • Run tests that answer real questions. Build them correctly, size them honestly, and be straight about what the results say.
  • Find underperformers and fix them. Subject line, timing, segment, content, or the journey logic itself.
  • Bring a weekly read to the Sr. Lifecycle Marketing Manager: what's working, what's not, what you'd change next.
  • Spot patterns across programs that need a fix.

What You Bring

  • 4+ years in lifecycle, CRM, or marketing operations, ideally on a subscription or app product.
  • Deep Braze skills. You can architect a multi-branch Canvas from a blank page, debug one that's misbehaving, and QA it without a guide. You know where Braze will fight you.
  • Real technical fluency: Liquid templating, custom events and attributes, API-triggered campaigns, webhooks, and a working understanding of how data gets from the product into your tool.
  • Comfort with data. You can pull your own numbers, write a query or navigate an analytics tool without waiting on someone, and separate signal from noise.
  • Detail orientation. You catch the broken merge tag, the wrong audience filter, the missing fallback, the link that goes nowhere.
  • Solid marketing judgment. You can read a subject line and know in ten seconds whether it will land, and you know where a journey should branch and why.
  • Comfort working autonomously from a brief. You need clear inputs and then space to execute.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with B2B2C or employer-sponsored benefit programs.
  • Experience running multiple co-branded programs at once with distinct audiences and suppression rules.
  • Health, wellness, or media and content backgrounds.

Job Title: Client Service Director, Marketing and Brand Promotion

Job Summary

Simpson Healthcare, an IQVIA Company, is an established scientific agency & dedicated partner to clients in the life sciences industry for over 20 years. We are actively seeking a Client Service Director to join our growing team within IQVIA in support of an AOR seat on a key client account in the oncology space.

Our Client Services Directors are responsible for optimizing the customer relationship with specific clients and facilitates the relationships between the many internal and external departments associated with a project. Primary responsibilities include management of projects and client accounts, client relations, and brand management.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Project Management

  • Responsible for overall management of assigned projects on specific accounts including coordination of digital and interactive content, working with content experts to validate scientific accuracy, achieving project goals, and timelines.
  • Prepare and deliver client presentations in a manner that effectively showcases the featured content as directed by client, internal departments, and Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs).
  • Drive long-term planning of assigned accounts including timelines, quality assurance, SOP creation and adherence, and budget monitoring.
  • Monitor project to guarantee adherence and pull-through of client strategy
  • Supervise and train junior staff members, as applicable, by creating a positive work environment, fostering a team approach, manage training and development, and oversee project progress.
  • Manage and attend relevant internal meetings, as assigned.
  • Contribute to enhanced customer service through timeliness and quality of communications and deliverables, including thorough hand-offs to internal project teams.
  • Adhere to all standard operating procedures (SOP’s) and drive internal project team adherence to PIT Crew, Basecamp, CCR, Good to Go, and Weekly client update meetings SOPs.
  • Develop and maintain working knowledge of managed products and disease areas.
  • Develop and assist with preparation of client pitches, presentations, and metrics.
  • Manage faculty recruitment, engagement, and relationships on behalf of clients.

Client Relations and Management

  • Maintain regular contact with client to ensure expectations are met.
  • Plan, schedule, organize team members, and prepare client update agendas and summaries to facilitate and lead client update meetings
  • Synthesize client feedback for implementation by project team members.
  • Collaborate with internal project team members and departments including Scientific Services, Interactive/Graphics, and Marketing to ensure client expectations are being met.
  • Track and report on all opportunities, key milestones, support requirements, etc.

Brand Management

  • Establish meaningful, professional relationships with various client stakeholders, including gaining understanding of their individual roles, communication preferences, personal motivators, and the desired outcomes for the brand and for the team.
  • Ensure Simpson’s brand is properly represented and promoted throughout client interactions, communications, and deliverables.
  • Promote and deliver service levels which are sustainable and allow for efficient delivery of a quality product.
  • Provide data, decisions and delivery of services in support of client, project and community success.

Position Requirements

  • 3+ years of related experience within the pharmaceutical industry or a healthcare/life sciences-focused agency is required for this position.
  • 1+ year(s) of experience in a pharmaceutical/healthcare promotional role is preferred.
  • Experience within the Oncology therapeutic area is preferred, but not required.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree required, preferably with emphasis in Marketing, Business, or Science.
  • Experience using Veeva is highly preferred.
  • Must be efficient and skilled at using Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Word, etc.).
  • Experience with Basecamp or similar project management systems is preferred.
  • Strong communicator both in written and verbal forms with a proven ability to effectively establish and nurture client and internal relationships.
  • Strong organization, time management, and project management skills.
  • Ability to leverage internal and external relationships to the benefit of the project, client, and Simpson.
  • An efficient and persuasive speaker and writer who can communicate effectively to a wide range of audiences.
  • Great team player with a strong drive and willingness to take initiative.
  • Ability to travel to meet with stakeholders as necessary (up to 25% of time).

jobs.description:
Job Summary:

Systems Administrator is responsible for the administration, maintenance, and support of network systems on premises and cloud-based systems infrastructure. This role manages server environments, virtualization platforms, cloud services, enterprise applications, and identity systems to ensure high availability, performance, and reliability across the organization. Systems Administrator operates effectively in a hybrid environment spanning VMware on-premises infrastructure, Microsoft Azure, and Microsoft 365, and serves as a key technical resource for day-to-day systems operations, application support, and infrastructure projects.

Job Details
Work set up: Work from home
Schedule: Monday to Friday | 8 AM to 5 PM PH time

Holiday: Will follow US holidays

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

Systems & Server Administration

  • Administer and maintain Windows Server environments including Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, and file services in a hybrid on premises/cloud configuration.
  • Manage VMware vSphere/vCenter infrastructure including VM provisioning, resource allocation, snapshot management, and host maintenance.
  • Monitor system performance, capacity, and availability across physical and virtual servers; proactively identify and resolve bottlenecks.
  • Perform OS patching, firmware updates, and lifecycle management for physical and virtual servers.
  • Maintain and support storage systems, including SAN/NAS administration, volume management, and performance monitoring.

Cloud & Identity Administration

  • Administer Microsoft 365 services including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, and OneDrive; manage tenant configuration, licensing, and user provisioning.
  • Maintain Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) for user and group lifecycle management, role assignments, and application integrations.
  • Manage Microsoft Intune for endpoint enrollment, compliance policies, and application deployment across Windows and mobile devices.
  • Support Azure cloud resources including virtual machines, storage accounts, Azure Files, and Entra-registered applications.
  • Administer hybrid identity configurations including Entra Connect sync, hybrid join, and SSO integrations.

Application & System Support

  • Administer and support enterprise business applications, including installation, configuration, upgrades, and vendor coordination.
  • Manage user accounts, permissions, access rights, and license assignments across on-premises and cloud platforms.
  • Support application integrations and troubleshoot cross-system issues between on-prem and cloud environments.
  • Coordinate with application vendors and internal stakeholders to plan and execute system upgrades and migrations.
  • Assist with onboarding and offboarding workflows, ensuring timely provisioning and deprovisioning across all systems.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • N/A

Knowledge & Other Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 4+ years of experience in systems administration with demonstrated experience across both on-premises and cloud platforms.
  • Strong proficiency with Windows Server administration, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and Group Policy.
  • Hands-on experience with VMware vSphere/vCenter virtualization administration.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 administration including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, and OneDrive.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, and hybrid identity configurations.
  • Experience with enterprise backup platforms; Veeam experience preferred.
  • Proficiency with PowerShell scripting for automation of administrative and operational tasks.
  • Familiarity with SAN/NAS storage administration and general networking concepts (VLANs, DNS, TCP/IP).
  • Microsoft certifications (MS-102, AZ-104, or equivalent) preferred.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with ability to document technical configurations clearly.

Other Characteristics:

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team and maintain high ethical standards of integrity and quality.
