jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.excerpt: TL;DR As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll embed with customers and partners to build, deploy, and win the technical trust that lands and grows enterprise deals.
jobs.description:
TL;DR As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll embed with customers and partners to build, deploy, and win the technical trust that lands and grows enterprise deals. Remote, low travel, high ownership. We are looking for someone who can build, understand how enterprises work, and walk into a room and talk to a CIO like a peer. You've spent years in the enterprise space—maybe leading teams, maybe sitting in our buyer's chair—and you're ready to get deeply hands-on again: closer to the code, closer to customers, and using AI tools to move fast. If that sounds like you, read on.

Role Overview

Forward Deployed Engineers are Harper's most trusted people in the field—highly technical, customer-facing engineers who embed in customer environments, drive real adoption and outcomes, and are trusted advisors when it's time to win the business.

This is a role for someone with deep, been-there-done-that enterprise experience and a consulting mindset. You'll build, deploy, and troubleshoot inside real customer environments, and you'll sit across from enterprise buyers and speak their language because you've been in their chair. You'll lean on modern AI tooling every day to move faster, and you'll help customers see how AI fits into their architecture.

We care far more that you can walk into a room with a CIO, architect, or operations lead and talk about their real problems with authenticity than we do about any single development framework or services delivery experience on your resume. We move fast, wear many hats, and value people who flex to get things done. You won't have a playbook for most things; instead you'll help write it.

And unlike most forward-deployed roles: this one is remote and doesn’t require constant travel.

If you're tired of the corporate grind and want to get your hands dirty again—closer to the code, closer to customers, using your experience where it counts—this is your stage.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Technical Delivery

  • Partner closely with customers to understand technical requirements, business objectives, and operational constraints.
  • Build, configure, customize, integrate, and deploy Harper's platform to meet unique customer workflows—directly within customer environments.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve systems, data, integration, and operational issues during deployment and after go-live.
  • Own customer outcomes end-to-end, working independently in ambiguous, fast-moving environments while staying aligned with internal teams and partners.

What success looks like: Customers achieve measurable outcomes from their Harper implementations, with stable production workloads they can own independently.

Customer Calls & Presales Support

  • Get in the room with enterprise buyers—leading technical discussions with developers, architects, and executive sponsors with the authenticity of someone who has sat in their seat.
  • Support the sales cycle: run discovery, shape technical direction, and help prove Harper's value to technical and executive stakeholders.
  • Take the lead in conversations and reframe when a proposed approach doesn't fit Harper's platform strategy—leaning into what the platform does and why it's the right call.
  • Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the relationship, guiding customers on scalability, reliability, performance, security, and long-term operations.

What success looks like: Harper earns the technical trust that wins and expands enterprise deals, and customers see a credible partner who understands their world.

Solution Engineering & Hands-On Development

  • Write and ship production-quality code, scripts, APIs, and automation to extend Harper's capabilities on behalf of customers.
  • Prototype custom functionality and deliver field-ready solutions that address immediate customer needs, validated in real customer environments.
  • Lean into Harper's opinionated, platform-first model—using what the platform provides rather than rebuilding it from scratch—so customers get up and running fast.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering to ensure custom solutions align with long-term platform direction.

What success looks like: Solutions are developed rapidly and map cleanly to a stable path to production, with technical objections resolved swiftly.

Partner Enablement & Co-Delivery

  • Enable and upskill system integrators and technology partners to deliver Harper solutions independently and at scale.
  • Co-deliver strategic engagements alongside partners, providing deep technical guidance and quality assurance.
  • Build reusable delivery assets, reference architectures, and best practices that expand partner-led delivery capacity.

What success looks like: Partners are enabled to deliver Harper's value independently, expanding delivery capacity and Harper's reach.

Product Insight & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Serve as the customer's voice inside Harper—gathering field insights, surfacing real-world gaps and customer patterns, and bringing them to Product and Engineering with evidence and a clear point of view.
  • Partner with Sales, Professional Services, and Customer Success across the customer lifecycle, and hand off cleanly for a smooth path to production.
  • Participate in post-engagement reviews, capture lessons learned, and mentor peers to raise the delivery bar across the team.

What success looks like: Field insights directly influence product improvements and roadmap decisions, and the whole team delivers better over time.

Incident Support & On-Call

  • Participate in on-call rotations to support platform reliability and availability.
  • Provide engineering expertise during incidents and escalations, troubleshooting platform and infrastructure issues to minimize customer impact.

AI Fluency & Modern Engineering

AI is core to how Harper builds, sells, and delivers—and it's core to this role. Forward Deployed Engineers are expected to be fluent, hands-on users of AI tooling and conversant in the concepts behind it: able to accelerate their own work, demonstrate AI-enabled patterns to customers, and reason credibly about models and workflows in technical conversations.

AI-Assisted Coding & Productivity

  • Use AI coding assistants fluently (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) to build, deploy, and troubleshoot faster—prompting effectively, reviewing generated code critically, and knowing when to trust versus verify output.
  • Apply agentic and automation workflows to accelerate repetitive engineering, integration, and enablement tasks.

Problem Solving & Applied Reasoning

  • Decompose ambiguous, open-ended technical problems and use AI as a force multiplier for research, design, and debugging—paired with sound engineering judgment.
  • Rapidly get up to speed on unfamiliar systems, codebases, and customer domains by combining AI-assisted exploration with hands-on validation.

Understanding of Models, Concepts & Workflows

  • Hold a solid working understanding of modern AI concepts—LLMs, embeddings, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector search, context windows, tokens, agents, and tool use—and their practical trade-offs.

jobs.description:
At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world.

​

Job Overview

As a member of the Digital Data Networks (DDN) business in TE Connectivity you will play a key role in the design of products for high-speed products in the connector, cable assembly, and/or radio system industry—targeting high-speed communications and connectivity within datacenters and wireless infrastructure.

ROLE DESCRIPTION

The Internal Cables & Connectors Reliability & Testing (R&T) Leader will lead a dedicated team of R&T engineers and will have responsibility for driving standardized Design for Reliability Engineering (DfRE) and Robustness Validation (RV) Methodologies for all Internal Cable & Connectors Products in the DDN Portfolio. He/she and their team will work extremely closely with customers, Product Development Engineering (PDE) teams, Manufacturing Process Development Engineering (MPDE) teams, Field Application Engineering (FAE) and Advanced Quality Engineering (AQE) to deeply understand the end application requirements and the associated “mission profile”. They will partner with the Global R&T COE to drive the application of standardized methodologies and alignment on all Reliability Testing and Test & Validation plans for each of the assigned new product development programs. They will identify unique product line test needs and application testing requirements and work with the R&T COE to develop custom Test System & Software as required to support the unique testing requirements for each product line. In addition, he/she will also partner with the Global R&T COE to co-develop Reliability Test Plans and Test & Validation Plans aligned with TE’s LeanPD stage gate approach for product development.

The Internal Cable & Connectors R&T Leader will oversee integrating reliability considerations during technology & product evaluation, NPI product development from receipt of Customer Spec (“mission profile”) through Product Release into mass production. DfRE Experts in the Global R&T COE will help determine the appropriate test strategy to collect data using destructive Highly Accelerated Life Test (HALT) or Highly Accelerated Stress Tests (HAST) techniques to evaluate product reliability. Based on collected data and in close collaboration with PDE teams, they will identify weak design/process features or components and work closely with PDE and AQE on the development of corrective actions and improvement plans, engaging with material and component experts to evaluate improvements of the corrective actions by technics such a stress/accelerated screening.

Role Responsibilities

ENGINEERS ON INTERNAL CABLE & CONNECTORS R&T TEAM WILL HAVE THE FOLLOWING RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Integrate reliability considerations during technology & product evaluation, NPI product development from receipt of Customer Spec (Mission Profile) through Product Release into mass production.
    • Contribute towards requirement engineering. Understand the load requirements clearly to derive inner load and stresses.
    • Drive reliability planning tailored to environmental and use conditions, integrating contingency planning and business impact.
    • Analysis of test data. knowledge on data acquisition methods and system.
    • Apply accelerated test models and test-to-failure strategies to determine reliability limits and identify failure modes.
    • Perform the initial FIT estimation based on data from standards such as Siemens Norm SN-29500. Calculate final FIT value based on test data.
    • Analyze customer requirements, application requirements and mission profile to determine the optimal validation test to evaluate reliability of DDN products.
    • Design and develop detailed Test & Validation (T&V) Plans for Early Validation Testing (EVT), Design Validation Testing (DVT) and Process Validation Testing (PVT); coordinate all Validation Testing internally or externally, publish validation test reports.
    • Design and develop Packaging Test & Validation Plans; coordinate all Validation Testing internally or externally, publish validation test reports
    • Lead corrective and preventive action (CAPA) processes for reliability issues across products.
    • Contribute to or manage a centralized database of reliability test plans, models, and field data to promote reuse and faster decision-making.
    • Present reliability status and risks to executive leadership, influencing design decisions and investment in robustness.
    • Leverage on accelerated test methods to explore design margins and to enable fast selection of concepts.
    • Provide guidance on sample size requirements and duration for reliability testing by utilizing reliability statistics.
    • Act as a champion for reliability culture, fostering a proactive and metrics-driven mindset within cross-functional teams.
    • Analyze data from those optimal validation tests to calculate reliability and identify risks or failures. Calculate MTTF based on test to failure evaluation.
    • For identified risks, support definition of mitigation plans and implementation to improve reliability.
    • For identified high risk failure modes and actual failures, support definition of corrective actions and their implementation to improve reliability.
    • Communicate and interact with customer reliability experts to report on reliability analysis.
    • Participate in design reviews and facilitate the reliability section of the design review.
    • Establish a database of reliability tests, models to be re-used across projects.

What your background should look like

 Bachelor/ Master’s degree in technical discipline (Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Mechatronics)
 10+ years of Experience a high-speed hardware engineering role serving telecommunications market or data center applications.
 Seasoned people leader, experience managing engineering teams in global corporate matrixed environment.
 Must also have many years of experience working with test equipment, test systems, test labs, development and deployment of HALT/HAST testing, Test & Validation Plans, development of custom test systems and performing “application tests.” Must have a good balance between theory and practice.
 Experience interacting with global cross-functional engineering teams in multi-site global organization.
 Experience with high-speed test equipment (Digital Sampling Oscilloscope, Vector Network Analyzer, Bit Error Rate Tester, TDR, Pattern Generators, Power Supplies, etc.)
 In depth familiarity with IEEE 802.3: The cornerstone for Ethernet networking. Recent iterations (e.g., 802.3ck) define standards for 100 Gb/s, 200 Gb/s, and 400 Gb/s operation over copper and fiber, as well as Next-Gen (800G/1.6T) data center requirements.
 Expertise with electronic assembly product development and validation of hardware and software.
 Excellent English, both verbal and written, and the ability to interact professionally with customers, leadership, stakeholders, cross functional teams and subject matter experts.
 Exceptional analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills and ability to make decisions when presented with a series of challenges, conflicts and constraints. Ability to drive to big picture goals and milestones while valuing and maintaining strong attention to the details.
 Knowledge on FIT estimation methodology, statistical analysis for reliability calculation such as Weibull-analysis or 2-statistics, application of Bayes theorem, random failure principle, FMEDA, FTA
 Reliability Engineering training from company, ASQ, TUV, Reliasoft or equivalent
 Experience with custom product development, working closely with customers to define mission profile of the end application and optimizing reliability strategy based on customer needs.
 Experience in running statistical analysis for reliability calculation for mechatronic products.
 A high curiosity in understanding how systems/products work along with a reverse engineering mindset.
 Willingness to travel as required, ~20%

WE VALUE -
+ DFSS Blackbelt or DFSS Green Belt Certified
+ Standards Knowledge - ANSI/TIA-942 Standard, ANSI/TIA-568-E Standard, ISO/IEC 11801 Standard, ISO/IEC 24764 Standard, EIA-364 1000B, IPC Standards for Interconnecting and Packaging Electronic Assemblies, UL Standards for Data Center Component Level Certifications (i.e. UL 1977, UL 444, UL 817, UL 2416).

This is a Day 0 role. There is no existing playbook, no fixed KPIs, and no template to follow. You will work directly with the Head of Department to design how we engage, retain, and grow our self-service customers and small key accounts across the region.

You will spend roughly 70% of your time on our self-service cohort — customers who today have never spoken to a human at — and 30% on a small portfolio of high-potential key accounts. Your job is to move the self-service base from "unmanaged" to "observed and engaged", run monthly engagement experiments, and surface what actually drives retention and expansion in your region.

You will succeed in this role if you are energized by ambiguity, comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, and excited to be part of a small founding team building something from scratch.

The role

WhatsApp is how business gets done in APAC, and APAC is one of our fastest-growing regions. A big share of our customers bought Respond without ever talking to a human. This changes with you.

Your goal will be to work with our customers to help them expand, retain, and get more value from the platform through onboarding and best practices. This is a one-to-many role where you will learn how to make an impact at scale.

This is an early-stage role. The Account Management function is young: we have a first version of the playbook and early results, but APAC is untouched. You’ll be the first AM in the region, working directly with the executive team, with real room to shape how the playbook evolves as it scales globally.

This is a commercial role. You grow revenue from existing customers and stop revenue from leaving. If you want to own a number and build the machine others will later operate, keep reading.

What you’ll do

Grow the base

  • Own expansion revenue: usage growth, plan upgrades, monthly-to-annual conversions, multi-location rollouts.
  • Find adoption opportunities - help our customers deploy best practices, use AI agents, more platform features.
  • Work from usage and billing signals, because that is where expansion actually converts.
  • Run activation rescue on accounts that bought but never fully deployed.

Defend the base

  • Spot at-risk behavior early and intervene before the cancellation, not after.
  • Analyze every cancellation: find the root cause, document it, and share it with product and revenue leadership.
  • Stabilize high-potential accounts that currently have no dedicated point of contact.
  • Log every account touch from day one. We measure AM impact with data, and your results will be provable, not anecdotal.

What we’re looking for

  • 2+ years in B2B SaaS AM, CS, or Sales where you held a revenue, expansion, or retention number.
  • Managed a portfolio of 50–100 accounts and know how to focus on the ones that matter most.
  • Fluent English and Spanish; Portuguese a strong plus.
  • Deep familiarity with APAC business culture and the role WhatsApp plays in it.
  • Data-driven by default; fixes broken things without being asked; comfortable operating where the playbook is still being written.
  • Comfortable working regional coverage hours.

What’s in it for you

  • Founding role with direct exposure to the executive team and real influence over the function’s design.
  • Clear growth path: build the APAC playbook and have a team built around you.
  • Base plus variable tied to expansion revenue and retention performance.
  • The ownership of an early-stage role, backed by a profitable and well-funded company.
  • Flexible, remote-friendly environment built for sustainable performance.

Clarity RCM is a dermatology-focused revenue cycle management company on the Inc. 5000 fastest-growing companies list. We manage billing, credentialing, and account management for private dermatology practices nationwide. We're growing fast and we're building the team that grows with us.

This role is for someone early in their RCM career who wants broad exposure to how a modern billing operation actually works. You'll touch client management, billing operations, denial resolution, and payer navigation. You'll own a small set of clients directly and support account managers on more complex accounts. The people who thrive here are the ones who find the problems before they're assigned them, ask good questions, and figure things out.

Growth is real here. It's also earned, not given.

Client management

Billing operations

  • Monitor AR aging reports and flag patterns: slow payers, recurring denial codes, revenue getting stuck
  • Review EOBs and ERAs, identify discrepancies, and work with the billing team to resolve them
  • Navigate practice management systems. We work primarily in ModMed, EZDERM, Nextech, DrChrono, and eCW

Contributing to a growing operation

Who You Are

You're a self-starter who tolerates ambiguity well. This is a fast-growing company. Not everything is defined. You don't wait for perfect instructions before making progress.

You're AI-native. You use AI tools in your work already, or you're actively curious about how they can make you better. You think about efficiency, not just effort.

You communicate clearly and stay professional under pressure. Clients are sometimes frustrated. You stay calm, give straight answers, and follow through.

You're here to contribute, not to be developed. We'll give you exposure. What you do with it is on you.

What We Offer

  • $55,000 - $60,000 base salary
  • 90% employer-covered health, dental, and vision
  • Real exposure to all elements of a scaling RCM operation
  • A team that moves fast and rewards people who do the same

Who We Are

Clean Air Task Force (CATF) is a global nonprofit organization working to safeguard against the worst impacts of climate change by catalyzing the rapid development and deployment of low-carbon energy and other climate-protecting technologies. With 30 years of internationally recognized expertise on climate policy and a fierce commitment to exploring all potential solutions, CATF is a pragmatic, non-ideological advocacy group with the bold ideas needed to address climate change. CATF has offices in Boston, Washington D.C., and Brussels, with staff working virtually around the world.

What You’ll Do

Program Context

CATF’s Methane Pollution Prevention team works globally to reduce methane pollution across the energy, waste, and agriculture sectors. This role will help translate CATF’s technical and policy expertise into practical methane mitigation strategies throughout Latin America. Working with governments, regional institutions, civil society, industry, and technical experts, you will advance policies and initiatives that are ambitious, evidence-based, and responsive to regional priorities. You will lead regional policy development, advocacy, and partnership-building while helping connect lessons from Latin America to CATF’s broader global methane strategy.

Responsibilities

  • Policy Development & Analysis – Develop and advance technically sound methane policies, regulations, initiatives, and projects across the agriculture, waste, and energy sectors, supported by research into their effectiveness and political feasibility.

  • Advocacy Strategy & Influence – Design and execute advocacy strategies that build support for ambitious methane mitigation policies among national and subnational governments, regional institutions, and multilateral organizations.

  • Stakeholder Engagement & Coalition Building – Build trusted relationships and coalitions across government, civil society, industry, academia, partner organizations, and international institutions to strengthen methane reduction efforts throughout Latin America.

  • Capacity Strengthening – Design workshops, trainings, webinars, and roundtables that help governments and institutions develop methane mitigation plans, strengthen implementation capabilities, and apply effective policies and guidelines.

  • Thought Leadership & Communications – Translate complex technical and policy information into accessible reports, recommendations, presentations, testimony, briefings, and other materials for policymakers and regional stakeholders.

  • Regional Strategy & Opportunity Development – Identify emerging opportunities, priorities, and partnerships that can expand CATF’s regional methane work and contribute to the development and execution of its Latin America strategy.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration – Work closely with CATF’s methane, advocacy, communications, technical, and regional teams to align priorities, develop evidence-based solutions, and connect regional experience with global initiatives.

  • People & Program Leadership – Provide direction and collaborative supervision to the Fossil Fuel Policy Analyst for Latin America and the Caribbean while contributing to project planning, consultant coordination, budget implementation, and broader program development.

What You’ll Bring

You are a thoughtful and collaborative policy professional who can move between technical analysis, advocacy strategy, and relationship-building. You take ownership of complex work, exercise sound judgment in changing political environments, and communicate clearly with people who bring different experiences and perspectives. You are motivated by practical climate solutions and comfortable working independently as part of a globally distributed team.

Required Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in public policy, environmental science, engineering, economics, law, international relations, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
  • At least 5 years of relevant professional experience in climate, energy, environmental policy, advocacy, or a closely related field.
  • Demonstrated experience developing or advancing public policy initiatives and evaluating policy or regulatory approaches.
  • Knowledge of climate, energy, environmental, or regulatory systems in Latin America, with experience working across multiple countries in the region.
  • Experience engaging government stakeholders and policymakers in Latin America and operating effectively within complex political and stakeholder environments.
  • Professional fluency in both Spanish and English, including the ability to communicate technical and policy concepts clearly in writing and presentations.
  • Demonstrated ability to build partnerships, support coalitions, negotiate effectively, and influence policy change among stakeholders with different priorities.
  • Strong project leadership, analytical, organizational, and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a remote, international environment.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with methane mitigation, greenhouse gas emissions, or related environmental issues.
  • Experience or subject matter knowledge related to agriculture or waste policy, systems, or methane reduction.
  • Experience advancing regulatory policy or developing multi-stakeholder coalitions.
  • An advanced degree in public policy, environmental science, engineering, economics, law, international relations, or a related field.
  • Portuguese language proficiency.
  • Experience working effectively in a remote or globally distributed organization.

Compensation & Location

Candidates living in Latin American countries are preferred. Compensation is determined based on each country's local market conditions and CATF's compensation structure for the applicable country. Final salary offers will be based on experience, qualifications, internal equity, and local market factors. Candidates must be authorized to work in their country of residence.

What We Provide

Join a global team where your policy expertise and regional relationships can help accelerate practical methane reductions across Latin America.

  • A mission-driven role supporting methane pollution prevention across the agriculture, waste, and energy sectors.
  • Exposure to cross-functional collaboration with regional partners, technical experts, advocates, communications professionals, governments, and international institutions.
  • A collaborative and intellectually curious culture where diverse perspectives are valued and bold, practical solutions to climate change are encouraged.
  • A flexible remote working environment within Latin America, with a primary schedule oriented around Eastern Time and occasional flexibility to collaborate across time zones.
  • An excellent benefits package and a competitive salary based on experience and location.
  • Benefits aligned to your country of employment.

This position may require domestic and international travel several times per year, depending on project needs.

Ready to Apply?

If you've made it this far, you should go ahead and apply.

You don't need to meet every requirement to be a strong candidate. If this role aligns with how you like to work and the kind of impact you want to have, we encourage you to submit your application.

jobs.title: Sr Product Manager, Platform & Integrations
jobs.excerpt: Super Dispatch is looking for a Senior Product Manager to help build, innovate, and execute on our Platform & Integrations roadmap, including our public API and the ecosystem of partner and third party integrations that other Super Dispatch teams build on.
jobs.description:
Super Dispatch is looking for a Senior Product Manager to help build, innovate, and execute on our Platform & Integrations roadmap, including our public API and the ecosystem of partner and third party integrations that other Super Dispatch teams build on. This role demands a lean product development mindset and strong technical fluency, working in close partnership with engineering in a dynamic, fast paced, and data oriented environment.

This is a US based role that reports directly to our CPO, and requires the person to be flexible and collaborate closely with our engineering teams in Central Asia time zones, as well as with the other Product group leads whose teams depend on the platform.

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Senior Product Manager to help stand up and shape a new, foundational team at a high growth SaaS company with incredible growth potential.

About Super Dispatch
Super Dispatch is the leading end-to-end transport management platform built exclusively for the auto transport industry. For too long, vehicle shipping has been burdened by fragmentation, endless phone calls, and mountain loads of manual paperwork. We are changing that. By connecting shippers and carriers within a single, unified digital ecosystem, Super Dispatch eliminates operational friction and transforms how cars move.

Who We Are:

Our diverse team is composed of highly motivated professionals with a passion for solving big problems with technology. Our core values are built around learning, growing, evolving, and continuous experimentation. We believe and practice taking bold risks. We embrace failure as a lesson. We put our team first. We are committed to supporting each other and helping each other grow on this journey.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for Platform & Integrations, including our public API and third party integration ecosystem that other Super Dispatch product teams (Carrier, Shipper, and Broker experiences) build on.
  • Own and evolve our Public API Update and Change Management Policy, ensuring changes are well scoped, clearly communicated to customers and partners, and executed with minimal disruption.
  • Collaborate with external partners and integration providers to identify, prioritize, and build new connections into the Super Dispatch platform.
  • Work closely with engineering and design to define, document, and execute on the vision and roadmap for the platform, in close coordination with the other Product group leads who depend on it.
  • Define and monitor platform and integration health, adoption, and API usage metrics.
  • Own the design system and overall UX information architecture across Super Dispatch's products, partnering with the Design Council to keep patterns, components, and cross-team experience consistent as the platform grows.
  • Work directly with the Design Council's architecture leads to set direction for the design system, resolving trade offs between platform level consistency and individual team needs.
  • Represent design system and Information Architecture in roadmap planning, ensuring investment in shared UX foundations keeps pace with the needs of the teams building on top of Platform & Integrations.
  • Communicate on a regular basis your progress on roadmap items, learnings, plans, and problems you have identified, including directly with executive leadership.
  • Partner with Support and Marketing on external communications for API changes and integration launches.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 7+ years of Product Management experience, ideally with a background building and scaling public APIs, developer platforms, or partner and integration ecosystems.
  • Strong technical fluency, with the ability to work directly and credibly with engineers on API design and architecture trade offs.
  • Comfortable standing up a new, still forming team and helping shape process and scope as engineering is staffed.
  • Experience working in a metrics and experimentation driven organization.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate across remote and distributed teams in different time zones, including the US, Europe, and Central Asia, and to partner directly with executive leadership.
  • Thrive in a dynamic, fast paced startup culture by adjusting quickly to changing priorities, multitasking effectively, and delivering results with limited resources.
  • Analytical problem solver with the ability to structure and process data, navigate uncharted waters, and draw actionable insights to tackle complex challenges.
  • Collaborative and open minded team player, skilled at working cross functionally, building positive relationships, and giving and receiving constructive feedback effectively.
  • Bonus points if you have a background in transportation/logistics, B2B, or Marketplace products.
  • Systematic thinker with a strong ability to balance big picture strategy with detailed execution and delivery.
  • Open to criticism and ideas, with a positive attitude toward feedback and continuous improvement.

Within 1 month, you'll...

  • Graduate from Super Dispatch's company wide new employee onboarding program to understand who we are, how we work, and what we're building.
  • Get up to speed on the scope of Platform & Integrations: the public API, existing and emerging partner integrations and how they connect to Carrier TMS, Shipper TMS, and the broader Marketplace.
  • Meet with leadership and the other Product group leads to understand current dependencies, priorities, and open questions.

Within 3 months, you'll...

  • Own the near term roadmap for Platform & Integrations, including Information Architecture, APIs, and integration priorities.
  • Begin partnering directly with engineering to define and execute the plan.
  • Take over end to end ownership of the Public API Update and Change Management process.

Within 6 months, you'll...

  • Take over full roadmap execution for Platform & Integrations, including setting priorities and driving key adoption and usage metrics.
  • Build strong working relationships with the other group leads whose teams depend on the platform.
  • Identify gaps in our integration and partner ecosystem strategy and propose actionable solutions.

Within 12 months, you'll...

  • Fully own the Platform & Integrations roadmap and vision with minimal oversight from leadership.
  • Maintain a working backlog that informs both short term priorities and next year's roadmap planning.
  • Set a strategic vision for Super Dispatch's platform and partner ecosystem that aligns with company goals and enhances development efficiency across teams.

What We Offer

  • Great Culture - We strive for transparency and you’ll work with like minded highly motivated people excited about solving complex problems
  • Great Insurance - We offer multiple health, dental & vision plans with a portion of the employee premiums paid by the company
  • Retirement - We provide both Stock Options and 401K with a company match
  • Remote First Culture - We’re a 100% distributed team!
  • Wellness Stipend - We provide a monthly stipend for your health, wellbeing, and fitness needs ($50/mo)
  • Generous Time Off - Flex PTO policy so you can take the time you need, when you need it, as well as 6-12 weeks paid parental leave
  • Great Gear - we’ll set you up for success with the latest tech

Location

Open to candidates within the United States only. All work must be performed from within the United States. This role is not eligible for international remote work.

Citizenship

Candidates must be U.S. citizens. Proof of citizenship will be required during the hiring process.

Does this sound like you? We'd love to hear from you.

All regular full-time employees are also eligible for excellent Medical, Dental and Vision coverage with generous premium contributions for both employees and their families, the option of a Health Savings Account with Employer Match, Company paid disability and life insurance with opportunity to add additional coverage for you and your family.

Super Dispatch provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. As part of this policy and legal compliance, Super Dispatch will make reasonable accommodations for the known physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified individual with a disability who is an applicant or an employee unless undue hardship would result. Super Dispatch will also accommodate a religious belief or practice (including religious dress and grooming practices, such as religious clothing or hairstyles) if the accommodation is reasonable and will not impose an undue hardship.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

Super Dispatch, Inc. will comply with any and all applicable local, city, county, state and federal laws, regulations and orders now in effect or which may hereafter be enacted.

Do you have a track record of winning complex software deals in the public sector? Do you understand how government and mission-driven organizations buy technology and how to build consensus across executive leaders, department heads, procurement/IT teams, and other stakeholders?

Envisio is looking for a Senior Account Executive with strong public-sector sales experience, particularly within state and local government, to drive new customer acquisition and expand our footprint across the public sector.

Envisio is one of Western Canada’s fastest-growing software companies and was recently named one of 2026’s Top 100 GovTech companies. Our software helps public-sector and mission-driven organizations turn strategic priorities into measurable results through better planning, performance management, reporting, transparency, and accountability.

Our customers include cities, counties, state agencies, special districts, water and utility districts, K–12 school districts, higher education institutions, healthcare and nonprofit organizations, and other public-sector and mission-driven organizations.

The Role

As a Senior Account Executive, you will own the full sales cycle and be responsible for developing and closing new business across the public sector, with a strong focus on state and local government. The pay range for this role is approximately $200,000 to $230,000 OTE (CAD).

You will:

  • Own the full sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery through negotiation and close
  • Build and manage a strong pipeline of new business opportunities across the public sector, with a primary focus on state and local government
  • Pursue opportunities across municipalities, counties, state agencies, special districts, water and utility districts, K–12, nonprofits, and adjacent public-sector markets
  • Develop trusted, consultative relationships with senior and executive leaders within public-sector and mission-driven organizations
  • Leverage your knowledge of and ideally your existing network within the government and public-sector market to identify and develop new opportunities
  • Understand the priorities, challenges, and operating environments of public-sector organizations and connect those needs to Envisio’s value proposition

  • Represent Envisio at relevant conferences, industry events, and client-facing meetings as needed
  • Travel occasionally to support market presence such as industry events, roadshows, and client-facing meetings

This is an opportunity to play a key role in expanding Envisio’s presence across the public sector while helping organizations improve how they plan, measure performance, communicate results, and deliver on the priorities that matter most to their communities.

Experience & Qualifications

We’re looking for someone who brings:

  • 7+ years of B2B/B2G sales experience, with a demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding quota
  • Direct experience selling software or technology solutions into the public sector, ideally state and/or local government
  • Strong understanding of the state and local government market, including municipalities, counties, state agencies, special districts, water districts, utility districts, or similar public agencies
  • Experience navigating government procurement, RFP/RFQ processes, budget cycles, contracting requirements, and complex approval processes
  • Experience selling enterprise or SaaS solutions with multiple stakeholders and longer, consultative sales cycles
  • Demonstrated ability to build credibility and trusted relationships with senior leaders and executive decision-makers
  • Experience developing new business and building pipeline, not solely managing inbound opportunities or existing accounts
  • Strong discovery, value-selling, negotiation, and closing skills
  • Experience managing a pipeline and accurately forecasting revenue
  • Working knowledge of structured sales methodologies such as MEDDIC/MEDDPICC, GAP Selling, Sandler, SPIN, or similar
  • Experience using Salesforce or a comparable CRM and modern prospecting and sales intelligence tools
  • Ability to stay focused, resourceful, and adaptable in a fast-growing environment

Nice to Have

  • An established network within state and local government or the broader public sector
  • Experience selling into adjacent public-sector and mission-driven markets such as K–12 education, nonprofits, utilities, or special districts
  • Experience selling GovTech, enterprise SaaS, performance management, strategic planning, budgeting, ERP, civic engagement, or other solutions used across government organizations
  • Experience working with special districts, including water, utility, transit, parks and recreation, or other independent public agencies
  • Familiarity with cooperative purchasing vehicles, government contracts, and other public-sector procurement channels
  • Experience with tools such as Outreach, GovSpend, and AI-enabled sales tools

What Will Make You Successful

You are:

  • Consultative: You seek to understand how an organization operates, what it is trying to accomplish, and where its challenges lie before recommending a solution
  • Public-sector savvy: You understand that selling to government and other public-sector organizations is different from traditional commercial sales and know how to navigate multiple stakeholders, procurement requirements, budget cycles, and longer decision-making processes
  • Results-driven: You take ownership of your territory, pipeline, and outcomes and know how to maintain momentum through long and complex sales cycles
  • Relationship Builder: You establish credibility with executives and develop trusted relationships across multiple levels of an organization
  • Curious: You ask thoughtful questions and genuinely want to understand the strategic and operational challenges facing public-sector leaders
  • Strategic: You can identify the path to a deal, build consensus among stakeholders, and develop a compelling business case for change
  • Accountable: You operate with integrity, maintain accurate forecasts, and follow through on commitments
  • Adaptable: You are comfortable operating in a fast-growing company where priorities evolve and everyone contributes to the team’s success
  • Collaborative Team Player: You believe the best outcomes come from working together. You actively collaborate with Solutions Consultants and other teammates throughout the sales process, sharing insights, supporting others, and contributing to a strong team-selling culture.

Why This Role?

You’ll have the opportunity to help grow Envisio’s footprint across state and local government and the broader public sector, working with organizations that have a direct impact on the communities they serve.

Our customers are tackling meaningful challenges from delivering critical public services and infrastructure to improving student and community outcomes, increasing transparency, and demonstrating progress against strategic priorities. You’ll work directly with senior leaders to help them translate those priorities into measurable results.

This role offers the opportunity to bring your government and public-sector expertise to an established GovTech company while helping us expand into new organizations and adjacent markets.

You’ll be supported by a close-knit, collaborative sales and marketing team, along with Solutions Consulting, Customer Success, and Product. We’re looking for someone who can independently build and close business while thriving as part of a highly collaborative team.

Benefits

  • Competitive base salary and generous commission plan
  • Extended health, dental, and vision care
  • Vacation and paid time off
  • A collaborative, high-performing team
  • The opportunity to make a meaningful impact in a growing GovTech company

Why Envisio?

Envisio’s award-winning software helps public-sector and mission-driven organizations connect strategic priorities to departmental action plans, performance measures, and transparent reporting.

Our customers use Envisio to improve organizational alignment, demonstrate progress, strengthen accountability, and build trust with the communities and stakeholders they serve.

We’re passionate about building deep, personalized relationships with our customers and helping them create stronger, safer, and more thriving communities. We have great software, happy customers, and a passionate team. We’re leaders in our market and share a strong sense of purpose with the organizations we serve.

We are a high-performing team with offices in downtown Vancouver, British Columbia. We value collaboration, accountability, curiosity, and people who are excited to make an impact.

We’d love for you to join us!

jobs.description:
Mechanical Engineering Expert

Pay: $80–$130/hour

Location: Global, fully remote

Job Type: Contractor (~15 hours per week)

Schedule: Flexible—you choose the hours and days you work, including weekends if desired

We are looking for a highly skilled Mechanical Engineering Expert to contribute to an AI training project involving engineering design, physical modeling, simulation, technical problem-solving, and Python.

The work involves creating, solving, reviewing, and validating engineering tasks across structural, thermal, mechanical, and multiphysics domains. A representative task may require translating physical requirements into a computational model, generating the required geometry or mesh, applying materials and boundary conditions, running an engineering simulation, and determining whether the resulting artifact and analysis satisfy the applicable physical and design constraints.

This role requires strong mechanical-engineering judgment and experience using engineering tools through code, scripts, configuration files, or a command-line interface. Experience limited exclusively to graphical interfaces will not be sufficient.

What You’ll Work On

  1. Solve and validate mechanical-engineering problems involving design, analysis, simulation, testing, or R&D.
  2. Translate physical systems and engineering requirements into analytical or computational models.
  3. Create or modify geometry, meshes, materials, loads, contacts, constraints, and solver inputs.
  4. Perform structural, thermal, dynamic, fatigue, buckling, vibration, or related analyses.
  5. Use Python to automate model preparation, simulation, parameter sweeps, optimization, postprocessing, and verification.
  6. Analyze stress, strain, displacement, temperature, heat flow, deformation, frequency response, safety factors, and other relevant outputs.
  7. Compare simulation results with hand calculations, experimental data, reference cases, or expected physical behavior.
  8. Diagnose invalid geometry, mesh problems, convergence failures, incorrect boundary conditions, and unrealistic outputs.
  9. Review AI-generated engineering solutions and identify reasoning errors, incorrect assumptions, and violated physical constraints.
  10. Develop clear, reproducible reference solutions and objective validation checks.
  11. Iteratively improve designs for performance, mass, strength, stiffness, thermal behavior, reliability, or manufacturability.

Required Qualifications

  1. An MS or PhD in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline; or
  2. A BS in Mechanical Engineering plus at least 1–2 years of relevant professional experience in mechanical design, analysis, simulation, testing, or R&D.
  3. Strong understanding of applied mechanics and mechanical-engineering fundamentals.
  4. Experience developing analytical, computational, or simulation-based engineering solutions.
  5. Practical proficiency with Python.
  6. Experience with at least one mechanical-engineering, geometry, meshing, or simulation tool that can be operated through a CLI, scripting interface, configuration files, or programmatic API.
  7. Ability to select and justify loads, boundary conditions, material properties, physical assumptions, and model fidelity.
  8. Ability to troubleshoot simulations and determine whether results are physically reasonable.
  9. Ability to explain engineering decisions, limitations, and trade-offs clearly.

Relevant tools may include CalculiX, Gmsh, Elmer, FEniCSx, CadQuery, OpenSCAD, OpenFOAM, or similar programmatic engineering software. Experience with an equivalent CLI-accessible tool is acceptable.

Relevant Python tools may include NumPy, SciPy, SymPy, pandas, Matplotlib, Jupyter, CAD or meshing APIs, finite-element libraries, optimization packages, or domain-specific scientific tools. No single library is mandatory.

Process

  1. Apply to the role and complete the screening questions.
  2. Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes.
  3. Complete a technical assessment, if required.
  4. Complete the hiring manager review.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete each task may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow.

Minimum submission requirements apply.

Start Timeline & Availability

We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts who are ready to begin immediately. If selected, you will be expected to start your first task within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead multiple concurrent assignments independently.

jobs.excerpt: About GenesisGenesis is an ecosystem of product IT companies building globally innovative products.
jobs.description:
About Genesis

Genesis is an ecosystem of product IT companies building globally innovative products. Products created within the Genesis ecosystem have been downloaded over 1 billion times in total. Genesis is one of Europe's leading tech teams: ranked the best employer by Forbes in 2023 and 2026, and the top IT employer by the DOU community in 2024 and 2025.

About the team and the role

Our Offensive Security Team is five engineers delivering penetration testing to external clients, alongside our Application Security, Infrastructure Security and Dark Web Monitoring service lines. You'll own engagements yourself: scoping, testing, reporting and the client conversation that follows, with the Team Lead and fellow engineers reviewing your findings rather than managing your calendar. Demand for our testing services keeps growing, and we're raising the technical bar across all four platforms instead of depending on individual specialists. In your first months you'll deliver client engagements end-to-end and build our internal methodology for AWS cloud security assessment. Within a year you'll be the team's reference point on at least one platform, and the AI agents you build will be covering the recon and enumeration phases of our tests.

What you'll be doing:

  • Deliver end-to-end penetration tests of Web and Mobile applications, Active Directory and cloud environments — from scoping and recon through exploitation and post-exploitation to evidence collection and retest;
  • Validate findings from our Application Security and Infrastructure Security services and triage automated scan output: eliminate false positives, confirm exploitability and real business impact, assign accurate risk ratings;
  • Write client-facing technical reports in English — reproduction steps, evidence, business-impact framing and practical remediation guidance;
  • Communicate directly with clients: kick-off calls, status updates, report walkthroughs, remediation Q&A and retest agreement;
  • Build automation and internal tooling that shortens the recon, enumeration, and active scanning phases, including AI-agent-based workflows;
  • Create and maintain the internal methodology, testing checklists and knowledge base for our Offensive Security service lines;
  • Research new attack techniques, evaluate tooling and share what you find with the team.

What we expect from you:

  • 2.5+ years of hands-on commercial penetration testing, with several engagements delivered end-to-end and reports written by you, plus at least one practical certification — OSCP, CPTS, GPEN or CWEE, or a proven equivalent;
  • Web application testing to the OWASP Web Security Testing Guide and beyond it: authentication and authorisation flaws, IDOR, injection, SSRF, insecure deserialization and business-logic abuse, with Burp Suite Professional as a daily tool;
  • Mobile application testing based on OWASP MASTG for Android and/or iOS: static and dynamic analysis, traffic interception, certificate pinning bypass, insecure local storage, IPC and platform misuse;
  • Working knowledge of Active Directory and internal network attacks: enumeration, Kerberos abuse, credential relaying, lateral movement and privilege escalation paths;
  • Scripting in Python and/or Bash, and the ability to read application source code and trace vulnerable patterns in at least one of PHP, Java, C#, JS/TS or Python;
  • English AND Ukrainian at B2 or above — enough to run client calls, write structured evidence-based reports and justify a severity rating to a technical client.

Nice to have:

  • A second practical certification: BSCP, CWEE, CAPE, GWAPT, OSWE, CRTO, eWPTX or eMAPT;
  • Cloud security testing in AWS, Azure or GCP: misconfiguration review, identity and privilege-escalation paths, attacks on managed services;
  • Hands-on experience or genuine interest in AI and LLM security — OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, prompt injection, agent abuse — and in using AI agents inside offensive workflows;
  • Public technical contribution: CVEs, open-source tooling, research write-ups, conference talks, or bug bounty with high-quality reports.

What we offer

  • Flexible hours and the option to work from anywhere that suits you;
  • Medical insurance;
  • 20 paid vacation days per year and unlimited sick leave;
  • All the equipment you need for work;
  • Compensation for professional training, access to our internal learning platform and lectures;
  • Corporate events and networking;
  • Free sports training, corporate discounts, and massage when you visit the office;
  • Support for colleagues and their families serving in the Defence Forces;
  • Support for veterans;
  • Assistance in case of harm to health or property caused by the war.

Hiring process

  1. Intro call with the recruiter;
  2. Interview with the Offensive Security Team Lead;
  3. Test task and a walkthrough of your solution;
  4. Bar-raising interview;
  5. Offer.

Supporting Ukraine 🇺🇦

The Genesis for Ukraine foundation was created in April 2022 in response to the full-scale invasion and the need to act systematically and for the long term. Its focus is supporting Genesis employees and their families in the military, helping the country, and developing educational and veteran projects that support reintegration into civilian life. Its large-scale partnership initiatives include Ukraine's first Veteran Master's Programme, an innovation space with a 3D-printing farm at Kyiv Polytechnic Institute, entrepreneurship training and grant programmes for veterans.

As of early 2026:

  • UAH 650+ million — total aid to Ukraine from Genesis and its partners;
  • UAH 26+ million — targeted assistance to employees and their families serving in the military.

jobs.excerpt: Our client, an international e-commerce company with a strong presence in the USA, is seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Inventory & Logistics Specialist to oversee end-to-end supply chain and inventory operations.
jobs.description:
Our client, an international e-commerce company with a strong presence in the USA, is seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Inventory & Logistics Specialist to oversee end-to-end supply chain and inventory operations. This full-time remote role combines freight management, Amazon FBA coordination, inventory forecasting, and reverse logistics to ensure smooth operations across all sales channels. If you are experienced in e-commerce logistics, Amazon fulfillment, and supply chain optimization, and enjoy working in a fast-paced, high-impact environment, wed love to hear from you.

About the company:

The company is a premium pet brand known for its high-quality, durable bulky pet products and accessories. Built for both professionals and devoted pet owners, the brands products are designed with attention to detail, functionality, and longevity. The brand is committed to creating elevated, practical experiences for pets and their people—and is looking for an Inventory & Logistics Specialist to help scale that mission by ensuring seamless product flow from factory to customer.

Key Responsibilities:

Freight & Supply Chain Management

  • Manage end-to-end order placement with factories and track order progress through to completion.
  • Request, negotiate, and select the best quotes from freight forwarders, determining the optimal type of sea freight for each specific situation.
  • Design ideal loading configurations for shipping containers based on product dimensions to maximize space and reduce shipping costs.
  • Oversee the loading process through active communication with factories and freight partners.
  • Track all global shipments, proactively flagging and mitigating any potential delays.

Amazon FBA & E-commerce Operations

  • Create and manage Amazon Shipments, utilizing software solutions (e.g., 9Yards and similar simulation tools) to run multiple simulations and target the most cost-effective Amazon warehouses.
  • Oversee the receiving of units at both Amazon fulfillment centers and partner 3PL warehouses.
  • Perform thorough reconciliation for all inbound shipments to ensure accurate stock levels and file claims for missing units when necessary.
  • Coordinate Less-Than-Truckload (LTL) orders for Last Mile transport from our 3PL to customers for non-Amazon (DTC/B2B) orders.

Inventory Forecasting & Management

  • Continuously monitor inventory levels across all sales channels to prevent overstocking or Out-of-Stock (OOS) situations.
  • Forecast inventory movements and project OOS dates at the SKU level to accurately plan factory order quantities.

Reverse Logistics & Returns Management

  • Create and manage Amazon removal orders for customer returns.
  • Arrange transport from Amazon to 3PL/processing facilities.
  • Oversee the de-kitting, inspection, and sorting of damaged units into tiers for parts harvesting or resale.

Scale of Operations:

  • Container Shipments: ~8 per month.
  • LTL Orders (Last Mile): ~10 per week.
  • Factory Orders: ~6 per year.

Software & Workflow Proficiency:

  • Amazon FBA & E-commerce Systems: Deep expertise with Amazon Seller Central, FBA placement optimization, inbound reconciliation, and removal/disposal orders.
  • Forecasting & Inventory Management: Hands-on experience with IMS tools (SoStocked, RestockPro, Cin7, Skubana), advanced Excel or Google Sheets for SKU-level forecasting and run-rate models.
  • Logistics, Freight & 3PL Integration: Familiarity with container load planning software (EasyCargo, CubeMaster), freight platforms (Flexport, Freightos), warehouse management systems (ShipStation, ShipHero), and reverse logistics workflows.

Core Competencies

  • 3+ years of experience in supply chain, logistics, or Amazon inventory management.
  • Proven ability to manage complex shipments and multi-stage fulfillment workflows across international markets.
  • Strong understanding of Amazon FBA processes and multi-channel e-commerce operations.
  • Advanced analytical mindset with the ability to build and interpret detailed SKU-level forecasting and inventory models.
  • Practical experience coordinating international freight, container shipments, and 3PL operations in a multi-channel environment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and high attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently while coordinating with multiple stakeholders.
  • Alignment with the companys premium brand standards and operational excellence mindset.

Why Join Us:

  • Play a critical role in ensuring smooth operations for a high-ticket pet brand on Amazon.
  • Own inventory planning, logistics, and fulfillment workflows.
  • Work remotely from anywhere.
  • Competitive salary and flexible working hours.
  • Collaborate with a creative, forward-thinking team dedicated to innovation in the pet space.
  • Make a tangible impact on a brand that values quality, customer experience, and operational excellence.

jobs.title: Accountant - HK Clients (Malaysia-Based Remote | Cantonese/Mandarin Speaker)
jobs.excerpt: Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.
jobs.description:
Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.

We give Entrepreneurs time back to focus on what they love doing - growing their business and being with customers. With a surging number of Entrepreneurs globally, we are innovating in a highly lucrative space.

We operate 3 business segments:

  1. Corporate Secretary: Automating the company incorporation, secretarial, filing, Nominee Director, mailroom and immigration processes via custom online robots and SleekSign. We are the market leaders in Singapore with ~5% market share of all new business incorporations
  2. Accounting & Bookkeeping: Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary SleekBooks ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service
  3. FinTech payments: Overcoming a key challenge for Entrepreneurs by offering digital banking services to new businesses

Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 15,000 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 600 staff with an intact startup mindset.

We have recently raised Series B financing off the back of >70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years. Sleek has been recognised by The Financial Times, The Straits Times, Forbes and LinkedIn as one of the fastest growing companies in Asia. Backed by world-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech-enabled unicorns based out of Asia Pacific.

Requirements

We are looking for an Accountant - HK Clients (Malaysia-Based Remote | Cantonese/Mandarin Speaker) / 會計 - 香港客戶 (馬來西亞遙距工作 | 廣東/普通話) who is excited about the mission and outcome below.

This is a 100% remote role. We welcome applications from qualified candidates located anywhere in Malaysia (including but not limited to Kuala Lumpur, Selangor, Penang, Johor, Perak, Sarawak, Sabah, Kedah, Malacca, etc.).

Mission of the Role: As an Accountant, you will play a key role in providing high-quality accounting services to our clients. This position is ideal for someone with 5 years of experience, preferably within practice, looking to deepen their expertise and take on new responsibilities in a fast-paced, cloud-based environment. You'll collaborate with a team of experienced accountants, managing a portfolio of clients and ensuring financial accuracy.

Your 5+ years of Accounting experience working with a portfolio of international clients will help you succeed in this role.

Position Duties:

  • You will lead and manage a high volume of portfolio of accounting clients and be the key point of contact for all your clients.
  • You will hence be accountable for the quality of service deliveries, timeliness, accurate billings, managing client relationships, maintaining good rapport with clients, and having the ability to achieve client satisfaction and retention.
  • You must be able to plan your work effectively and efficiently, and provide effective leadership, supervision and guidance to staff to ensure deliverables are in accordance with the scope of services and timelines. This includes but is not limited to corporate secretarial, accounting, tax, payroll, MPF, immigration, mailroom, and nominee director services.
  • From the start of your engagement, you must be able to demonstrate expertise in primary accounting frameworks and in relation to financial reporting matters as regulated by the Companies Registry and the Inland Revenue Department (IRD). You must also have sufficient knowledge on the regulatory requirements of various company set-ups in Hong Kong, mainly that of private limited companies.
  • You are required to gain a comprehensive understanding of client operations, processes, and business objectives and utilise that knowledge on engagement.
  • For assigned clients, you must have the ability to review and/or prepare management accounts and schedules, profits tax computations, payroll reports, employer's returns and other statutory filings, and ensure its accuracy and completeness before delivering to clients.
  • The knowledge that you have will enable you to provide basic consultancy advice to clients on various accounting, tax, payroll and corporate secretarial matters.
  • One of your key responsibilities is to prepare Unaudited/Group Unaudited Financial Statements and profits tax returns for clients with zero error.
  • You must adhere to the highest degree of professional standards and strict client confidentiality.

Role Requirements:

  • Fluent in spoken and written Cantonese/Mandarin and English.
  • Recognised degree/diploma in Accountancy.
  • Preferably professionally certified with ACCA, HKICPA, or equivalent qualification.
  • Preferably 5–7 years of relevant working experience for candidates who are not / yet to be certified. 2–3 years of relevant working experience for professionally certified candidates.
  • Hands-on experience with Google Workspace and Microsoft applications.
  • Experience with cloud accounting software, Xero will be a definite plus, preferably at least a year of experience in Xero.
  • Resourceful and experience with various productivity software applicable to facilitate daily works.
  • Self-motivated, positive attitude, proactive and detail-oriented.
  • Love meeting people and have great interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Able to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
  • Immediate availability is preferred.
  • Must be based in Malaysia (100% Fully Remote). Must have a suitable home workspace located within Malaysia with a reliable high-speed internet connection..
  • Must possess the legal right to work in Malaysia. We are unable to provide employment pass sponsorship for this role.

Important Notes: Recruitment interviews will be conducted primarily in English, with a short section conducted in Mandarin to evaluate language proficiency.
This is a full- time position requiring a commitment of 40 hours per week. The core working hours for this role are Monday to Friday 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM (HK time/ Malaysia time).

Behavioural fit is also important at Sleek, and we will be looking for candidates that have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles:

Ownership: This shows reliability and helps build trust within the team. We move fast and need to know that everyone will see things through to completion and proactively help to get things back on track when challenges arise. Accountability is really important to us.

Humility: There is so much we don’t know. Humility allows for open-mindedness to feedback and a willingness to learn from others. It paves the way for collaboration and creates a positive work environment. It is a key ingredient of self awareness and emotional intelligence.

Structured Thinking: Our business is complex with many layers (many services, many countries, many cultures). Regardless of whether you’re more analytical or creative in nature, being able to show sound judgement is important to us. It ensures solutions are pragmatic and balance the needs of the organisation, team and customers.

The interview process

The successful candidate will participate in the below interview stages. We anticipate the process to last no more than 3 weeks from start to finish.

Whether the interviews are held over video call or in person will depend on your location and the role.

One-way Video Interview

Shortlisted candidates will receive an invitation to complete a one-way video interview. This step allows us to review your skills and background early in the process, ensuring a smooth and efficient experience for all applicants.

Technical round
A ~60 minute chat with a Hiring Team. They'll discuss your last 1–2 roles to understand your experience in more detail.

Behavioral/ Soft Skills round

A ~45 minute chat with a member of the leadership team, where they will dive into some of your recent work situations to understand how you think and work.

Reference verification

Prior to final offer confirmation, we will conduct one professional reference check with your recent direct manager or supervisor. To keep the process moving smoothly, this step may be initiated during the final interview stages.

Requirement for background screening

Please be aware that Sleek is a regulated entity and as such is required to perform different levels of background checks on staff depending on their role.

This may include using external vendors to verify the below:

  • Your education
  • Any criminal history
  • Any political exposure
  • Any bankruptcy or adverse credit history

We will ask for your consent before conducting these checks. Depending on your role at Sleek, an adverse result on one of these checks may prohibit you from passing probation.

By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Data Privacy Statement for Candidates, found at sleek.com.

Benefits

Some other great things about working at Sleek…

Humility and kindness: Humility is a core attribute we hire for, which means we have a culture of not taking ourselves too seriously and being able to laugh. Kindness is also incredibly important. We are committed to creating and nurturing a diverse and inclusive environment.

Flexibility: You’ll be able to work remotely. If you need to start early or start late to cater to your family or other needs, we don’t mind, so long as you get your work done and proactively communicate. You can also work fully remote from anywhere in the world for 1 month each year

Financial benefits: We pay competitive market salaries and provide staff with generous paid time off and holiday schedules. Certain staff at Sleek are also eligible for our employee share ownership plan and can share in the upside of our stellar growth trajectory as we work toward listing on a prominent stock exchange in the Asia Pacific region.

Personal growth: You’ll get a lot of responsibility and autonomy at Sleek - we move at a fast pace so you’ll be making decisions, making mistakes and learning. There’s also a range of internal and external facing training programmes we run. We’re also at the forefront of utilising AI in our space and are developing a regional centre of AI excellence. It is our intention that if you leave Sleek, you leave as a more well-rounded person and professional.

Sleek is also a proudly certified B Corp. Since we started our journey in 2017, we’ve been committed to building Sleek as a force for good. In just over 5 years, we’ve joined a community of industry leaders like Patagonia, Ben & Jerry's, and P&G who are building an inclusive, equitable, and a regenerative economy.

The work involves creating, solving, reviewing, and validating engineering tasks related to material structures, properties, processing, performance, and failure. A representative task may require constructing a material or atomic model, configuring and running a simulation, calculating relevant properties, analyzing the resulting outputs, and determining whether the solution is computationally valid and physically meaningful.

This role requires both strong materials expertise and experience using engineering or scientific tools programmatically. Experience limited exclusively to graphical user interfaces will not be sufficient, as task solutions must be reproducible through code, scripts, configuration files, or command-line tools.

What You’ll Work On

  1. Solve and validate computational materials-science and materials-engineering problems.
  2. Create material structures, atomic configurations, compositions, and solver-ready inputs.
  3. Model relationships between composition, structure, processing, properties, and performance.
  4. Run atomistic, electronic-structure, molecular-dynamics, continuum, electrochemical, or related simulations.
  5. Use Python to generate inputs, automate calculations, conduct parameter sweeps, process results, and validate outputs.
  6. Analyze mechanical, thermal, electrical, chemical, structural, or electrochemical properties.
  7. Diagnose failed calculations, invalid structures, convergence problems, numerical instability, and incorrect physical assumptions.
  8. Compare computational results with experimental data, literature values, known properties, or expected physical trends.
  9. Review AI-generated solutions for scientific correctness and identify invalid assumptions, configurations, or conclusions.
  10. Develop reproducible reference solutions and objective verification methods.

Required Qualifications

  1. An MS or PhD in Materials Science and Engineering, Metallurgy, or a closely related discipline; or
  2. An MS or PhD in Mechanical Engineering or Chemical Engineering with a substantial materials specialization.
  3. Strong understanding of materials behavior and relevant structure-property relationships.
  4. Experience with computational materials modeling, simulation, characterization, or materials-focused engineering analysis.
  5. Practical proficiency with Python.
  6. Experience with at least one engineering or scientific tool that can be operated through a CLI, scripting interface, configuration files, or programmatic API.
  7. Ability to understand and justify modeling assumptions, parameters, approximations, and convergence criteria.
  8. Ability to distinguish computational failures from genuine physical behavior.
  9. Ability to explain complex scientific reasoning and technical limitations clearly.

Relevant tools may include LAMMPS, ASE, pymatgen, Quantum ESPRESSO, FEniCSx, CalculiX, Elmer, PyBaMM, or similar programmatic materials and simulation software. Experience with an equivalent CLI-accessible tool is acceptable.

Relevant Python tools may include NumPy, SciPy, pandas, Matplotlib, Jupyter, atomistic modeling packages, materials informatics libraries, or domain-specific scientific tools. No single library is mandatory.

Experience may come from academic research, national laboratories, industry R&D, computational engineering, or other demonstrated materials work.

Process

  1. Apply to the role and complete the screening questions.
  2. Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes.
  3. Complete a technical assessment, if required.
  4. Complete the hiring manager review.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete each task may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow.

Minimum submission requirements apply.

Start Timeline & Availability
