jobs.description:
Corporate Travel Consultant - Virginia Team

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

Ranked as one of the world’s top five travel management companies, it has a business network in over 97 countries and global headquarters in London, Brisbane, Singapore and New York. Backed by the global strength of Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), FCM combines local expertise and global experience to provide clients with a truly bespoke experience.

To learn more about FCM please click HERE

About the Opportunity

This role will have you arranging domestic and complex international travel for busy executives including air, car hotel and ground transportation. Before you begin your role, you will spend three weeks (paid) training. This program will boost your knowledge, train you on contract airfares and sharpen your Sabre skills. Our corporate travel agents handle the air, car, rail and ground transportation bookings as well as the ticketing, changes and the exchange and queue management.  You will also need to offer exceptional customer service to satisfy our business traveler’s needs. We encourage our Corporate Travel Agents to study the travel polices of our corporate accounts and develop a relationship with them so when our valued business travelers have the need for business travel arrangements, they rest assured that their business travel needs are in the hands of a dedicated team of Corporate Travel professionals they trust and are on a first name basis with.

Our business hours are 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM EST Monday – Friday

A typical schedule will include a 40-hour work week with five 8-hour shifts. Be prepared to work an evening shift until 8:00 PM once or twice a week.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate air, hotel, car, and ground transportation bookings for domestic and international travel
  • Build rapport and develop a relationship with business travelers to ensure their business travel needs are in the hands of a trusted team of Corporate Travel professionals
  • Ensure accurate and timely completion of reservations while meeting travelers' needs
  • Executing all responsibilities within company guidelines for customer service, documentation of PNRS (Passenger Name Records) and profiles, ticketing, invoicing, and maintaining accuracy throughout
  • Staying fully informed about airline rules, regulations, tariffs, and fare requirements and applying this knowledge accurately to all travel arrangements
  • Deliver consultative support and exceptional customer service throughout the booking process
  • Keeping clients informed about all necessary travel documents and health requirements for their destinations
  • Proficiently handling ticketing, Phase IVs, and exchanges/changes involving complex international fares
  • Expertly managing rerouting and exchange processes, ensuring minimal disruption to travel plans
  • Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and accessible work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive

Experience & Qualifications

  • 2+ years of recent, prior experience in corporate travel management, understanding the unique needs and challenges of business travelers.
  • In-depth familiarity with current Sabre GDS (Global Distribution System) for fare calculations, itinerary management, and ticket issuance.
  • Previous exposure to quality control processes to ensure the accuracy and compliance of travel bookings.
  • Proficiency in ticketing procedures and scripting, along with the ability to handle complex itinerary changes and exchanges for both international and domestic travel.
  • Proven ability to navigate and manipulate complex itineraries, international fares, and Passenger Name Records (PNRs) to meet client requirements.
  • A polished and professional demeanor when interacting with clients and colleagues.
  • Proficiency in handling multiple urgent tasks simultaneously while maintaining efficiency and quality in each interaction.
  • The capacity to make quick and effective decisions to resolve travel-related issues promptly.
  • Excellent communication skills to keep clients informed and reassured throughout the travel process.
  • A deep commitment to delivering exceptional customer service with a focus on client satisfaction.
  • Comfortable and proficient in using travel booking systems and various communication tools.
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot and adapt to new technologies
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and manage tasks successfully

Work Perks! - What’s in it for you:

FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.

  • Have fun:At the heart of everything we do at Flight Centre is a desire to have fun.
  • Reward & Recognition: Celebrate the success of yourself and others at our regular Buzz Nights and at the annual Global Gathering - You'll have to experience it to believe it!
  • Use your smarts:Our people use their quick thinking, expertise, and tenacity to always figure things out.
  • Love for travel:We were founded by people who wanted to travel and want others to do the same. That passion is something you can’t miss in our people or service.
  • Personal connections:We are a big business founded on personal relationships.
  • Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through initiatives like Diversity Day (paid leave to observe a holiday or cultural celebration of your choice) Employee Resource Groups (Racial Equity, Gender Equity, LGBTQ2IA+, Accessibility, Environmental Justice), DEI education initiatives, and equitable practices, including regular equity assessments and inclusive recruitment protocols.
  • A career, not a job:We offer genuine opportunities for people to grow and evolve
  • We back our people all the way: We are strongly committed to supporting every single employee in their professional and personal development.
  • Giving Back:Our Corporate Social Responsibility program supports nominated charities through volunteering and fundraising, complemented by our Office Environmental Program, LEED® Gold-certified office spaces, and 1 paid Volunteer Day per calendar year.

Benefits Include:

  • Paid Time Off: A comprehensive time off package, including up to 15 vacation days (prorated upon hire and increasing to 20 days after 2 years of employment), 5 sick days, 3 personal days, 1 Diversity Day, 1 Volunteer Day, and 8 recognized holidays annually.
  • Travel perks/discounts
  • Health & Wellness Programs and Employee Financial Wellness Services
  • National/International Award Nights and Conferences
  • Health benefits including, medical, dental, vision, gender affirming care, and fertility care
  • Insurance including hospital indemnity, AD&D, critical illness, long-term and short-term disability
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • 401k program with partial match
  • Tuition Reimbursement Program
  • Employee Share Plan – Ability to purchase company stock on Australian Stock Exchange with partial company match, subject to terms and conditions
  • Global career opportunities in a network of brands and businesses

*Vacation, Personal, and Sick time accrual rates will vary based on full-time or part-time employee status. Recognized Holidays are either paid time off or, if required to work due to job requirements, holiday pay rate, and may vary depending on state.

Location – Remote, USA

If this sounds like the opportunity you have been waiting for then APPLY NOW.

Have questions about this opportunity? Reach out to our recruitment team at

For this position, we anticipate offering an hourly pay rate of $28.85 plus commission/incentive earnings based on achievable targets. On target earnings average range between $60,000 - $67,000. The annual salary range listed represents the total compensation package, excluding benefits.

jobs.excerpt: Senior Manager, SEO & GEOSearch Engine Optimization & Generative Engine Optimization | Parallels Push the boundaries of discovery.
jobs.description:
Senior Manager, SEO & GEO

Search Engine Optimization & Generative Engine Optimization | Parallels

Push the boundaries of discovery. In your sweatpants.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Manager of SEO & GEO to lead the next evolution of organic discovery at Parallels.

This role will own our strategy across both traditional search engines and emerging AI-powered discovery platforms. SEO remains a critical growth engine for Parallels - driving visibility, qualified traffic, customer acquisition, and category authority. At the same time, discovery is rapidly expanding into generative AI experiences, where customers increasingly ask tools like ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, and Copilot what to buy, how to solve problems, and which products to trust.

The Senior Manager of SEO & GEO will ensure Parallels continues to win in search today while building a leadership position in the AI-driven discovery channels of tomorrow.

This is a strategic, hands-on leadership role for someone who has deep SEO expertise and is excited to define the emerging GEO playbook. You will strengthen our technical SEO foundation, scale our content and authority strategy, and lead the company approach to improving how Parallels is surfaced, summarized, cited, compared, and recommended by AI-powered platforms.

You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, Sales, Analytics, Communications, and Channel teams to make Parallels more discoverable across the full customer journey - from traditional search queries to AI-generated recommendations.

Your team is global and works across multiple time zones, so comfort with remote work and asynchronous collaboration is critical. Understanding the virtualization space, developer ecosystem, Apple ecosystem, enterprise productivity landscape, and partner routes-to-market will be a strong advantage.

Why This Role Matters

Search is not going away. It remains one of the most important ways customers discover, compare, and choose technology products.

But search is changing.

Customers are increasingly moving from keyword searches to AI-assisted recommendations, conversational answers, and generated product comparisons. That makes SEO more important, not less - because strong technical foundations, authoritative content, structured knowledge, and trusted third-party signals are also what help AI systems understand and recommend a brand.

This role exists to help Parallels win across both dimensions: the proven SEO channels that drive growth today and the emerging GEO channels that will shape customer discovery tomorrow.

What You Will Do

Lead the Integrated SEO & GEO Strategy

  • Own Parallels global organic discovery strategy across traditional search engines and AI-powered discovery platforms.
  • Set the roadmap for SEO and GEO initiatives tied to measurable business outcomes, including qualified traffic, conversion, pipeline influence, brand authority, and AI search visibility.
  • Balance near-term SEO performance with long-term GEO leadership as discovery behavior evolves.
  • Establish Parallels operating model for how SEO, GEO, Product Marketing, Content, Engineering, PR, Channel, and Analytics work together.
  • Lead prioritization, planning, reporting, and executive communication for SEO and GEO initiatives.

Build Parallels GEO Leadership

  • Define and operationalize Parallels Generative Engine Optimization strategy.
  • Improve how Parallels products are surfaced, summarized, cited, compared, and recommended in AI-powered discovery experiences.
  • Monitor Parallels presence across ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Copilot, and emerging AI assistants.
  • Build strategies around entity authority, semantic relevance, structured knowledge, citation visibility, AI retrievability, and recommendation share-of-voice.
  • Partner with Product Marketing and Communications to increase high-quality third-party mentions, citations, and category authority.
  • Develop practical measurement frameworks for GEO where attribution is still evolving.
  • Identify how AI-driven discovery is changing customer journeys, competitive positioning, and purchase consideration.

Strengthen SEO as a Core Growth Engine

  • Lead technical SEO across crawlability, indexing, rendering, site architecture, Core Web Vitals, internal linking, structured data, and international SEO.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to ensure SEO requirements are embedded into product launches, site changes, and platform decisions.
  • Drive content SEO strategy across priority audiences including prosumers, developers, power users, gamers, small and mid-size businesses, enterprise buyers, and channel partners.
  • Improve organic acquisition through better intent mapping, content quality, conversion pathways, and authority building.
  • Ensure Parallels continues to perform strongly in traditional search while preparing for the future of AI-mediated discovery.
  • Diagnose and resolve SEO performance issues across large-scale web properties.

Drive Content, Authority & Discoverability

  • Partner with Product Marketing to translate product capabilities, launches, roadmap themes, and use cases into discoverable narratives.
  • Build topic authority across virtualization, Windows on Mac, Apple enterprise adoption, developer workflows, gaming, productivity, managed devices, and cross-platform work.
  • Create content and information architecture that serves both human buyers and AI retrieval systems.
  • Support digital PR and partner/channel content strategies that increase trusted references to Parallels across the web.
  • Use AI tools responsibly to accelerate research, content optimization, competitive analysis, and workflow efficiency.
  • Help simplify complex technical messages into clear, compelling stories for customers, partners, and search/discovery platforms.

Lead Measurement, Experimentation & Executive Communication

  • Define clear KPIs for both SEO and GEO, including traffic, rankings, conversions, technical health, content performance, brand visibility, AI citations, and recommendation presence.
  • Build test-and-learn frameworks for GEO experiments.
  • Translate complex changes in search and AI discovery into clear business implications for executives.
  • Use data to prioritize investments and communicate progress, risks, and opportunities.
  • Manage SEO/GEO tools, vendors, agencies, and reporting systems as needed.

What You Bring

Required

  • 6+ years leading SEO, organic growth, search strategy, or discoverability programs.
  • Deep technical SEO expertise with a proven record of improving organic growth at scale.
  • Strong understanding of content strategy, authority building, information architecture, and search intent.
  • Demonstrated curiosity and practical experience with AI-driven discovery, GEO, LLM-powered search, or emerging search experiences.
  • Ability to define a new discipline while continuing to operate and improve a mature SEO function.
  • Experience influencing Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, Content, Analytics, Communications, and executive stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort building reporting frameworks where measurement is imperfect.
  • Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Hands-on familiarity with enterprise SEO and analytics tools such as Google Search Console, GA4, Looker/Tableau, Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, Botify, Conductor, BrightEdge, Similarweb, or comparable platforms.
  • Strong project management skills and ability to manage multiple initiatives across teams and time zones.

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience in SaaS, developer tools, virtualization, enterprise productivity, managed devices, or infrastructure technology.
  • Understanding of Apple, Windows, Mac, developer, SMB, enterprise, and partner/channel ecosystems.
  • Familiarity with semantic search, entity optimization, structured data, knowledge graphs, retrieval systems, and AI citation behavior.
  • Experience working with GEO tools that monitor AI search visibility, brand mentions, citations, and recommendation share-of-voice across platforms such as ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and Copilot.
  • Experience using modern AI tools for research, content analysis, workflow automation, and experimentation.
  • Experience managing agencies, vendors, or distributed teams.
  • Comfort working in a global, remote-first environment with asynchronous collaboration.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 12 months, this leader will:

  • Maintain and improve SEO performance as a major organic acquisition channel.
  • Establish a clear GEO strategy, measurement model, and operating rhythm.
  • Improve Parallels visibility and recommendation presence across AI-powered discovery platforms.
  • Strengthen technical SEO foundations and content authority across priority product and audience segments.
  • Build durable collaboration between SEO, GEO, Product Marketing, Engineering, Content, Communications, Channel, and Analytics.
  • Create a repeatable experimentation framework for AI-driven discovery.
  • Position Parallels to win as traditional search and AI-driven discovery continue to converge.

About Parallels

Parallels is a global leader in cross-platform solutions, enabling businesses and individuals to access and use the applications, files, and workflows they need on any device or operating system.

Parallels helps customers get the best out of the technology they choose - whether that is Windows, Linux, macOS, ChromeOS, iOS, Android, or the cloud. Our products serve individuals, developers, power users, small and mid-size businesses, enterprises, public sector organizations, and educators who need simple, reliable, and cost-effective ways to work across platforms.

Parallels is best known for making complex technology feel simple. We solve deep engineering and user-experience challenges so customers can run the applications they need, where and how they need them - from Windows on Mac to managed enterprise environments and flexible hybrid work setups.

We have millions of users globally and decades of innovation behind us. Today, Parallels is focused on helping customers stay productive in a world where work happens across devices, operating systems, clouds, and increasingly AI-powered workflows.

We offer a fully remote workspace and flexible hours because we believe great work can happen anywhere. Our team is global, collaborative, and built around motivated people who care about solving meaningful customer problems.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Parallels is committed to building an inclusive, barrier-free recruitment and selection process and work environment. We offer equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, age, religion, national origin, sex, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetics, or any other protected characteristic.

If you are contacted for a job opportunity, please advise us of any accommodations required during the recruitment process. Appropriate accommodations will be provided upon request as required by applicable law and company policy. Any information received relating to accommodations will be treated as confidential.

Job Description

SmartDev is looking for a Business Development Manager - an individual contributor with excellent solution selling skills who can create solid and AI competence sales funnels and drive sustainable, predictable growth in the APAC region.

We need a BDM as a hybrid player who can translate complex AI capabilities into tangible business outcomes. You will identify, prospect, and close enterprise deals for custom AI solutions. Unlike a standard SaaS BDM, you must be comfortable discussing data pipelines, model accuracy, and ethical AI with CTOs while building a value-based ROI case for CMOs and CDOs.

Strategic Business Development (70%)

  • Identify and target high-potential enterprise accounts across Media, Fintech, and Logistics.
  • Build a 12-month pipeline in AI solution opportunities.
  • Lead consultative discovery: Map client pain points (e.g., manual data entry, churn prediction, document processing) to AI solution blueprints.
  • Structure and negotiate complex contracts (POCs, pilot-to-production, managed services).
  • Develop strategic partnerships with SI partners, cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP), and tech vendors.

Solution & Technical Acumen (20%)

  • Collaborate with Solution Architects to scope technical feasibility and effort estimates.
  • Translate technical differentiators (e.g., fine-tuned vs. RAG-based LLM) into competitive business advantages.
  • Educate prospects on AI risks (hallucinations, data privacy, bias) and our mitigation strategies.

Internal Collaboration (10%)

  • Act as the voice of the customer to influence product roadmaps.
  • Work with Marketing to create AI-specific sales collateral (case studies, ROI calculators).
  • Provide feedback on pricing models (consumption-based, outcome-based, subscription).
  • Key Performance Indicators (KPIs): Pipeline generation; Won deals; Pilot-to-production conversion rate; Average deal cycle.

Must-Have:

  • 5+ years in B2B solution sales or business development, with at least 2 years selling AI, ML, or data science services.
  • Proven track record closing five-figure to six-figure solution deals (not just SaaS licenses).
  • Ability to articulate AI concepts (supervised vs. unsupervised learning, token pricing, fine-tuning).
  • Experience selling to a mix of technical (CTO, CDO) and business (COO, GM) personas.
  • Hunter mentality – comfortable with cold outreach, relationship mapping, and negotiation.

Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience with cloud AI services (Azure AI, SageMaker, Vertex AI).
  • Familiarity with data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA) in AI context.
  • Existing networks in Media, Fintech, and Logistics.

The Person:

  • Straight-talking with a genuine focus on delivery and building great relationships.
  • A natural problem solver with full accountability and responsibility for business.
  • Understands the value of transparency and ensures key stakeholders have full visibility of the sales pipelines and expected performance, creating contingency plans to mitigate risks and shortfalls.
  • Able to work autonomously and as part of a collaborative team.

SmartDev is an AI-powered software development company headquartered in Vietnam, part of the Verysell Group. We help global businesses deliver faster and build smarter — combining AI-driven development practices with deep expertise across fintech, healthcare, retail, and enterprise technology. Our team of engineers, architects, and AI specialists works across the full stack: from custom software and cloud solutions to generative AI, MLOps, and intelligent automation. At SmartDev, we believe that great architecture and AI-first thinking are a competitive advantage — and we build our teams accordingly.

The company is at a pivotal point in our journey: transitioning from a pure IT outsourcing provider to an AI-enabled solutions partner.

jobs.description:
Copilot Developer/AI Engineer - Entry-Level

Hands-on development and technical architecture for Copilot agents, automations, and integrations

Role Overview

The entry-level Copilot Developer/AI Engineer turns strategic blueprints into working agents, workflows, and integrations, while also providing architectural guidance for complex implementations. They develop Copilot agents, Power Automate flows, reusable prompt “skills,” and locally-run AI solutions using tools such as Claude, ensure solutions are scalable and secure, and support the team through technical standards, mentorship, and escalation handling. A strong working knowledge of modern AI tools — particularly Microsoft Copilot and Claude (and related tools) — is central to the role, as is the curiosity to continually seek out and evaluate new AI platforms while operating responsibly within a regulated environment with strict data controls.

Description

We are seeking a Microsoft Power Platform Developer who is also familiar with Microsoft Copilot Studio to join our growing team. In this role, you will design, develop, implement, and optimize AI-powered productivity and automation solutions for a diverse portfolio of clients.

You will partner closely within an internal team to identify opportunities where the Power Platform, Power Automate, and Microsoft Copilot Studio — as well as other AI tools and technologies, including Claude used locally outside of the Microsoft 365 environment — can deliver transformative business value, ensuring that solutions are strategically aligned, technically sound, and effectively adopted. Engagements allow you to take ownership from solution development through implementation, optimization, and adoption. Throughout, you will work within a regulated environment governed by strict data controls, balancing rapid AI experimentation with rigorous compliance and data protection.

Key Responsibilities

Solution Architecture & Development

Develop application in PowerApps using Dataverse, Power Automate, Excel, Forms and SharePoint online. Use multiple Out-of-The-Box connectors with Power Apps, Power Automate. Develop and deploy Microsoft Copilot Studio solutions that integrate seamlessly with Teams, Microsoft 365, Power Platform (Power BI, Power Automate, Power Apps), and other enterprise systems. Build and run AI-assisted solutions using Claude locally — outside of the Microsoft 365 environment — for development, prototyping, and automation, while keeping data handling compliant with organizational and client controls. Incorporate adaptive cards, variables, triggers, connectors, and API integrations into Copilot Studio solutions to maximize functionality.

Collaborate in prompt engineering: crafting effective prompts, skills, and grounding/context strategies across both Copilot and Claude (and related tools). Participate in solution testing, validation, and quality assurance Technical feasibility analysis, solution design documentation, and user guides Ensure solutions comply with Microsoft security, compliance, and governance standards, including Entra ID (Azure AD), Microsoft Purview, and DLP (Data Loss Prevention) policies. Apply strict data-control practices to all AI tooling — including locally-run models such as Claude — ensuring sensitive and regulated data is handled, stored, and transmitted in accordance with policy. Mentor teammates, provide technical guidance, and handle escalated issues from deployed solutions

Optimization & Continuous Improvement

Develop supporting documentation, user guides, and enablement materials to encourage effective adoption and continuous improvement. Optimize development efforts based on user feedback. Stay current with emerging Microsoft Power Platform and Copilot features. Proactively seek out, evaluate, and pilot new AI tools and platforms, assessing their fit, value, and — critically — their compatibility with the organization's regulated environment and data-control requirements before adoption.

Technical Troubleshooting & Support

Diagnose and resolve technical challenges related to Copilot Studio implementations, working closely with internal engineering teams when necessary. Ensure data security in all Power Platform and Copilot-enabled solutions.

Required Qualifications

This is an entry-level position. Bachelor’s degree in a technical field and 1-2 years of professional experience, OR equivalent combination of education and experience. Proven success in Microsoft Power Platform and Copilot Studio solution design, development, and deployment. Strong, hands-on working knowledge of modern AI tools — specifically Microsoft Copilot and Claude (and related tools) — including their use for development, automation, and prompt engineering. Experience using Claude locally (outside the Microsoft 365 environment) for AI-assisted development and automation.

Strong familiarity with Teams, Microsoft 365, Power Platform, Azure, and their integration points. Familiarity with Microsoft Graph API, REST APIs, and third-party system integrations Skilled in identifying AI-driven optimization opportunities. Demonstrated ability to work effectively within a regulated environment with strict data controls, balancing AI experimentation against compliance, governance, and data-protection obligations.

A genuine desire to explore, test, and adopt emerging AI tools and platforms. Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and troubleshooting skills. Experience with data integration from multiple sources while maintaining accuracy, quality, and compliance. Understanding of prompt engineering principles and LLM behavior; experience with RAG-based architectures preferred Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including presentation development and delivery. Ability to work independently in a remote-first environment while maintaining strong coworker relationships.

Preferred Qualifications

Demonstrated ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable recommendations for non-technical stakeholders. Prior experience working for Microsoft or a Microsoft Gold/Cloud Solutions Partner. Certifications in Microsoft Power Platform, AI, or Copilot-related specialties. Experience with Agile/Scrum delivery models for enterprise technology projects. Knowledge of AI prompt engineering and LLM (Large Language Model) optimization techniques. Experience deploying and governing AI tools — such as Claude and other non-Microsoft models — in regulated or data-sensitive environments.

Work Environment & Travel

Location: United States, Eastern Time Zone Travel: None required. Work Hours: This role is for a United States company. Work will be conducted in English, and can be done asynchronously with the US time zones, though some overlap will be required for meetings and collaboration.

About the Role

This is a strategic consulting role where you will be part of a high-performing, client-focused team dedicated to unlocking the full potential of Microsoft Power Platform, Copilot, and a broader set of AI tools including Claude. You will work with organizations to reimagine productivity, streamline workflows, and empower teams with AI-driven insights and automation — always within a regulated environment where strong data controls and responsible AI adoption are non-negotiable.

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

As pioneers of the seaweed category, we introduced the world’s first line of Certified Organic and Non-GMO Project Verified roasted seaweed snacks in 2012 and has since grown to become the #1 selling, premium, organic seaweed-based snack – but our aspirations reach even further.

Led by founders and visionary food entrepreneurs Annie Chun and Steve Broad, we take great pride and care in creating delicious and convenient snacks inspired by our Korean heritage and believe that seaweed represents a sustainable path forward that nourishes people and the planet.

With our eyes focused on the future, we’re on a mission to increase our impact by winning over a whole new generation of foodies. We are assembling a team of talented and driven individuals who are just as excited about the future of seaweed as we are!

WHO YOU ARE

You understand that trade spend is one of the most important and complex levers in a CPG business. You know how deductions, promotions, distributor activity, retailer programs, and accruals impact the P&L, Balance Sheet, and day-to-day operations. You enjoy bringing structure and clarity to that complexity.

You are highly analytical, detail-oriented, and naturally curious. You ask questions when something doesn’t look right, investigate root causes, and work collaboratively across teams to solve problems. You’re comfortable working in the details of customer chargebacks and trade accruals while also identifying broader trends and opportunities for process improvement.

You thrive in a fast-moving, growing environment where processes are still evolving. You bring organization and accountability without creating unnecessary bureaucracy, and you’re excited by the opportunity to help build scalable systems and workflows.

You’re a strong cross-functional partner who communicates clearly and works effectively with Sales, Finance, Operations, and external partners. You can translate complex financial and operational data into actionable insights that help the business make smarter decisions.

WHAT YOU DO

Trade Promotion Spend Management

  • Ensure all customer trade promotion chargebacks are valid, authorized deductions that are accurately accounted for by customer, promotion, and general ledger account within the trade promotion management (TPM) system
  • Partner closely with the Head of Sales Operations to support promotion planning, execution, and accuracy within the TPM system
  • Serve as the primary relationship manager for the TPM service provider and act as the internal TPM superuser
  • Set up and maintain customer records, SKUs, promotions, and general ledger mappings within the TPM system
  • Upload and validate direct customer sales, distributor shipments, and consumption data into the TPM system
  • Manage automated workflows for incoming customer remittances and chargeback documentation
  • Enter and maintain non-chargeback accounts payable invoices within the TPM system
  • Review, validate, and allocate customer chargebacks to the appropriate promotions while driving process scalability through automation, AI, and outsourced operational support

Trade Spend Accruals & ERP Integration

  • Prepare monthly trade spend accruals by customer, promotion, and general ledger account by analyzing open promotions, planned spend, and chargeback activity within the TPM system in accordance with company accounting policies and GAAP
  • Summarize accruals by channel and general ledger account and review findings with the CFO, Controller, and Accounting Manager
  • Export, validate and reconcile trade promotion spend data from the TPM system for ERP upload and financial reporting and balance sheet accuracy
  • Partner with Accounting to support accurate month-end close processes through detailed reconciliation and variance analysis

Customer Disputes & Deduction Resolution

  • Partner with the TPM service provider to identify, dispute, and resolve invalid customer chargebacks
  • Collaborate with Operations to dispute logistics fines, shortages, and other operational deductions
  • Assist Finance with collections and accounts receivable follow-up related to settled disputes
  • Track deduction trends and root causes to improve recovery rates and reduce future chargebacks

Budgeting, Audit & Financial Support

  • Collaborate with the Head of Sales Operations and Financial Planning & Analysis to develop annual and monthly trade spend budgets by customer, promotion, and general ledger account within the TPM system
  • Support year-end audit requests and provide supporting trade spend documentation as needed
  • Help maintain strong financial controls, documentation, and audit readiness across trade spend processes

Reporting, Insights & Process Improvement

  • Prepare monthly trade spend reporting and variance analysis versus budget and forecast
  • Provide trade spend data, analysis, and insights to external trade spend consultants
  • Support Sales leadership with TPM reporting, analysis, and performance insights
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Finance, and Operations to improve the efficiency, scalability, and effectiveness of trade spend processes
  • Identify opportunities for process optimization, automation, and improved reporting capabilities across systems and workflows

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Strong understanding of trade promotion spend, customer deductions, accrual accounting, and retailer/distributor programs within a CPG environment
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Finance, Operations, and external partners
  • Ability to manage large volumes of transactional data while maintaining accuracy and organization
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to clearly explain financial and operational insights
  • High ownership mindset with a proactive, solution-oriented approach
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and operating effectively in a fast-paced, evolving business
  • Ability to identify process inefficiencies and drive continuous improvement initiatives
  • Advanced Excel and data manipulation capabilities; experience working with ERP and TPM systems
  • Interest in leveraging automation, AI, and scalable processes to improve operational efficiency
  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, or a related field
  • 10+ years of finance and accounting experience, including 5+ years managing trade promotion spend in a CPG food & beverage environment
  • Experience working with trade promotion management (TPM) software
  • Experience working with major food distributors and retailers (eg. UNFI, KeHE, Amazon, Target)
  • Experience identifying and successfully disputing incorrect chargebacks in customer portals
  • Experience with trade spend accrual accounting, balance sheet reconciliations and month-end close processes
  • Advanced Excel, data manipulation skills
  • Experience with ERP systems (NetSuite preferred)

YOUR EXPERIENCE

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS & WORK ENVIRONMENT

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this role. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit for extended periods, use hands and fingers to operate a computer and standard office equipment, and communicate clearly with internal and external stakeholders.

The employee may occasionally be required to stand, walk, and lift or move items up to 15 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this role include close vision for computer work.

This position is primarily a remote position with occasional travel to headquarters located in San Rafael, Ca, Bay Area candidates preferred.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

This full-time role will receive a competitive salary + benefits, including medical, dental, vision, 401k, and equity. This position's anticipated annual pay range is $120,000 - $130,000 plus bonus and equity. Various factors are considered when determining an individual's compensation–including a candidate’s professional background, education, certifications, experience, professional licenses, and location. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed. We neither ask for nor take into consideration the salary history of applicants.

jobs.description:
The Proportional Representation Hub

American democracy is at a breaking point. Across the country, voters increasingly find themselves throwing up their hands and turning away from a failing political system. Hyper-partisanship has become entrenched. Fewer than one in ten House races is competitive, and 97% of incumbents cruise to reelection: for most voters, the outcome was settled before a single ballot was cast. Little wonder that politicians feel little pressure to deliver legislative results. Public trust in democratic institutions continues to erode as more and more voters tune out.

But the problem isn’t the politicians. It’s the rules. U.S. elections are distorted by single-winner, winner-take-all districts. A party can win 45% of the vote in districts across a state yet it wins no power. The Supreme Court’s evisceration of the Voting Rights Act has made things much worse: voters in communities of color are being carved up and packed into districts engineered to drown out their voices, and the court has triggered a redistricting death spiral. The need for structural reform has never been more urgent.

There is a fix, and most of the world already uses it: proportional representation. The idea is simple––districts elect several members, and a party that wins a third of the votes wins about a third of the seats. It breaks the two-party monopoly, makes every district competitive, eliminates partisan gerrymandering, and reduces polarization.

The Proportional Representation Hub has launched to help build the next chapter of American democracy. We have raised more than $70 million to lead a campaign to advance proportional representation at the local, state, and federal levels and build a government that delivers again. Proportional representation is the best path to create a democracy that better reflects the diversity of the American people, and the best path to end the redistricting wars.

This work is ambitious: forging unlikely coalitions, winning new legislation and ballot measures, changing public narratives, and developing innovative political strategies. Above all, it demands a cross-partisan movement big enough to persuade the huge majority of Americans who say the political system no longer works for them that our democracy can work far better than it does today.

We are building a team of exceptional leaders working together to reshape the architecture of American democracy itself.

Position Summary

The Vice President of State and Local Campaigns will design, build, and win the campaigns that will make proportional representation a political reality across the United States, one of the most important democracy reform efforts of the next decade.

The Vice President of State and Local Campaigns will lead efforts to advance proportional representation through ballot measures and legislative campaigns at the state, city, and county level. This executive will develop and oversee a national portfolio of state and local campaigns, identifying opportunities for breakthrough victories while building long-term political power for the movement. They will work closely with local organizers, advocacy organizations, elected officials, coalition partners, philanthropic investors, and policy experts to build winning campaigns that can serve as models for replication nationwide.

The successful candidate will bring extensive experience winning state-level legislative and ballot campaigns, advancing policy reforms through complex political environments, and ideally leading sophisticated local campaigns.

The Vice President of State and Local Campaigns will serve as a member of the organization’s Senior Leadership Team.

This is a role for a senior strategist, movement builder, and campaign leader who understands how to translate ambitious ideas into real-world political victories.

What You’ll Lead

Win State and Local Victories

  • Design and execute ambitious state and local campaign strategies that advance proportional representation and related democracy reforms.
  • Secure legislative victories, ballot measure wins, municipal reforms, pilot programs, and other policy breakthroughs that move the field forward.
  • Build a growing portfolio of successful campaigns that demonstrate the viability and effectiveness of proportional representation.
  • Identify emerging opportunities and rapidly deploy resources where victories are achievable.

Build and Support State Campaign Infrastructure

  • Develop and manage a national strategy for supporting state and local reform efforts across multiple geographies.
  • Provide strategic guidance, technical assistance, campaign planning, communications support, policy expertise, and political analysis to partners.
  • Help create campaign infrastructure, tools, training programs, and best practices that can be utilized across states and municipalities.
  • Build systems that allow local victories to accelerate broader national momentum.

Build Powerful Coalitions

  • Cultivate strong relationships with state and local advocacy organizations, community leaders, civic groups, labor organizations, democracy reform advocates, academics, elected officials, and grassroots organizers.
  • Build broad-based coalitions capable of advancing reforms through diverse political environments.
  • Help align local, state, and national stakeholders around shared campaign goals and strategic priorities.
  • Foster partnerships that can sustain long-term movement growth beyond individual campaign cycles.

Raise Resources for Campaigns

  • Partner closely with the senior leadership team to secure significant investments in state and local campaign efforts.
  • Help raise funding for campaign partners, coalition efforts, and priority states.
  • Cultivate relationships with major donors, foundations, and philanthropic collaboratives interested in democracy reform.
  • Develop compelling investment cases for emerging campaign opportunities.

Build the Field

  • Position the Proportional Representation Hub as the premier strategic partner and leader for state and local proportional representation efforts nationwide.
  • Elevate successful campaigns through media, thought leadership, conferences, convenings, and strategic communications.
  • Create opportunities for knowledge sharing, collaboration, and movement-wide learning.
  • Help build a durable ecosystem of organizations and leaders advancing proportional representation across the country.

Lead Across the Organization

  • Serve as a senior member of the Executive Leadership Team.
  • Manage campaign staff, consultants, in-state directors, and external partners.
  • Collaborate closely with communications, policy, research, partnerships, and development teams to maximize campaign effectiveness.
  • Build a culture of excellence, innovation, accountability, and continuous learning.

Who You Are

You have spent your career winning difficult state legislative and ballot measure campaigns. You understand how to build winning coalitions and teams across a diversity of geographies and organizations.

You are equally comfortable working with donors as with grassroots leaders and campaign staff.

You understand the rhythm and needs of local campaigns and can support campaigns with everything from strategic guidance to infrastructure-building to training.

Our engineering team embraces AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity, code quality, and innovation. You'll work with modern AI-powered development workflows while helping deliver intelligent features that enhance customer experience and operational efficiency.

  • Design, develop, and maintain Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, and platform best practices.

Technology Stack

Salesforce (Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, SOQL, Triggers), Salesforce DX, REST APIs, PowerBI, Nintex DocGen, Git, Python, React, and AI-assisted development tools including Cursor and BugBot.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of Salesforce development experience with expertise in Apex, Lightning Web Components, and Salesforce architecture.

jobs.description:
Department Name:

IT Tech Solution Arch-Corp

Work Shift:

Day

Job Category:

Information Technology

Banner Health was named to Fortune’s Most Innovative Companies in America 2025 list for the third consecutive year and named to Newsweek's list of Most Trustworthy Companies in America for the second year in a row. We’re proud to be recognized for our commitment to the latest health care advancements and excellent patient care.

Banner Health's Data Platform Team is building the modern data platform that runs on Databricks and AWS, supporting everything from claims and clinical data to population health analytics and AI-enabled by data. We're looking for a Data Architect to lead Databricks solution architecture end to end — designing PHI-compliant data patterns, defining the architectural standards for how data moves from Bronze through Gold and how entity resolution and claims data get handled, and partnering with enterprise and cloud architecture teams to make sure what we build fits inside Banner's broader security posture. You'll be the person in the room when a new data pattern needs a PHI-safe design, and the person who can explain why it's built that way to both a cloud architect and a compliance reviewer. You define the patterns and standards — engineering teams build against them.

This isn't a design-and-hand-off role. You'll work directly with analytics leaders to translate platform capabilities into terms they can act on, and you'll work directly with data engineers on coding standards, CI/CD practices, and Gold-layer development patterns — teaching the practices, not just documenting them. If you can move between an architecture review with enterprise architects and a working session teaching an analytics team how to build a compliant Gold pipeline, and you understand both the technical and healthcare-data complexity underneath each, this is the role. This is a remote position. In this role you would work Monday through Friday normal business hours 8am - 5pm AZ time zone and can be a remote position if you live in the following states only: AL, AK, AR, AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IA, ID, IN, KS, KY, LA, MD, MI, MN, MO, MS, NC, ND, NE, NH, NM, NV, NY, OH, OK, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI, WV & WY.

Your pay and benefits (Total Rewards) are important components of your Journey at Banner Health. Banner Health offers a variety of benefit plans to help you and your family. We provide health and financial security options, so you can focus on being the best at what you do and enjoying your life.

Within Banner Health Corporate, you will have the opportunity to apply your unique experience and expertise in support of a nationally-recognized healthcare leader. We offer stimulating and rewarding careers in a wide array of disciplines. Whether your background is in Human Resources, Finance, Information Technology, Legal, Managed Care Programs or Public Relations, you'll find many options for contributing to our award-winning patient care.

POSITION SUMMARY

This position leads enterprise-scale solution design, ensuring technology strategies align with Banner Health’s mission to deliver safe, efficient, an innovative healthcare services. This role drives the adoption of AI-enabled care models, advanced cloud architectures, and secure, compliant integration of healthcare systems. Mentors junior staff, influences, strategic decisions, and ensures delivery of solutions that enhance patient outcomes and operational performance.

CORE FUNCTIONS

1. Lead the design of complex, multi-domain healthcare solutions using Azure, AWS, and hybrid architectures.

2. Architect AI/ML-enabled applications for predictive analytics, clinical decision support, and operational efficiency.

3. Define and enforce architecture governance, ensuring adherence to HIPPAA, HITECH, PCI, NIS 800-53, and internal security standards.

4. Develop cloud adoption roadmaps, including Azure Landing Zones or AWS Landing Zones, hybrid connectivity, and more.

5. Evaluate and select vendor solutions, balancing innovation, cost, compliance, and operational readiness.

6. In collaboration with Enterprise Architects, create and maintain architectural artifacts, archetypes, reference architectures, and capability roadmaps for enterprise consumption and integration to the Enterprise Architecture roadmap.

7. Provide thought leadership in AI ethics, data governance, and healthcare-specific deployment strategies.

8. Collaborate with Enterprise Architects, executives, clinicians, and IT Leaders to align technology with business goals.

9. Relentless focus on delivering outcomes and value to our business in partnership with Senior Leadership, stakeholders, and vendor partners to develop architectures, strategies, and guidance in support of strategic initiatives.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent experience. Must have 10 years of progressive IT experience in development, infrastructure, or systems analysis, and 4+ years of solution or enterprise architecture.

Must obtain one or more of the following certifications within one year of hire: Microsoft Certified Azure Solution Architect Expert, AWS Certified Solution Architect Professional, Google Professional Cloud Architect, TOGAF Certified Architect, or ITIL Intermediate.

Must have proven experience in cloud-based healthcare solutions, including AI/ML deployments. Strong understanding of healthcare compliance, interoperability, and security.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

5+ years of experience in healthcare or a regulated industry

5+ years of experience designing solutions utilizing AI components

Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC)

Proven mentorship of junior architects or engineers

The following certifications: Microsoft Certified Cybersecurity Architect Expert, AWS Certified Machine Learning Specialty, Salesforce Certified Technical Architect

Additional related education and/or experience preferred.

Estimated Pay Range:

$65.70 - $109.50 / hourBanner Health is committed to pay equity and transparency. The posted compensation range is a reasonable estimate that extends from the lowest to the highest pay Banner Health in good faith believes it might pay for this particular job, based on the circumstances at the time of posting.This range is based on possible base salaries and does not include the value of our total rewards package. Actual pay determined at offer will be based on years of relevant work experience, education, certifications, skills, and geographic location, along with a review of current employees in similar roles to ensure pay equity is achieved and maintained.

Who We Are

At YallaPlay, We are a rapidly growing startup mobile gaming studio on a mission to bring people together through play, we create exciting mobile games that bring joy to millions of players worldwide. Founded in Austin, Texas, we’ve since expanded to Brazil and the UAE, growing our diverse and talented team of creators. We pride ourselves on a fun and collaborative work environment, with a remote-friendly culture and a dedication to producing high-quality, engaging games. Our current titles, including “Spades Masters” (iOS/Android), have been enjoyed by millions of players globally.

Our passion lies in reinventing card games infusing them with fresh mechanics, beautiful design, and social features that spark connection and excitement. As we continue to scale, we’re looking for creative, driven individuals who are excited to help shape the future of multiplayer mobile gaming in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Join us and be part of building something big from the ground up.

The Opportunity

We’re building a new rapid-prototyping capability at YallaPlay focused on turning game ideas into complete playable experiences quickly, using AI to dramatically shorten the path from concept to validation.

We’re looking for a Senior Game Prototype Engineer who can independently design and build game prototypes from A to Z. You’ll sit at the intersection of game design, frontend engineering, backend engineering, and UI/UX, taking an initial concept and turning it into something players can actually play and evaluate.

This is not a role where you wait for detailed game designs, UX specifications, or technical requirements. You’ll define the core gameplay, design the player experience, build the client and supporting backend, create or source the assets needed, and deliver a complete playable prototype.

Your job is not to build production-ready games. It is to identify what needs to be tested and build the fastest complete experience capable of answering that question.

You’ll work heavily with AI coding agents and modern development tools to move from idea → design → prototype → playtest → learning → next experiment at high speed.

Some prototypes will survive. Most won’t. That’s expected. Success means helping us discover which ideas deserve further investment before we commit a full production team.

This position can be remote or based at our state-of-the-art offices in Yas Island, Abu Dhabi, UAE.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Take game ideas from concept to complete playable prototype, owning the process from A to Z.
  • Define and iterate on the core game mechanics, rules, player flows, controls, progression, and overall gameplay experience.
  • Design and implement clear, functional UI/UX that allows players to understand and properly experience the game.
  • Build the frontend, game logic, bots, lightweight backend, multiplayer functionality, and other systems required to make the prototype fully playable.
  • Use existing, generated, or placeholder art, animation, audio, and other assets to create a prototype that feels complete enough to evaluate fairly.
  • Scope ideas down to their smallest meaningful testable version, focusing effort on what needs to be proven rather than building unnecessary features.
  • Own the prototype loop end to end: define the hypothesis, build the experience, run playtests, analyze the results, and recommend whether to iterate, progress, or stop.
  • Use AI coding agents and AI-assisted development tools as a core part of your workflow to dramatically increase development speed.
  • Instrument prototypes with lightweight analytics where needed so decisions can be informed by player behavior as well as qualitative feedback.
  • Iterate rapidly based on playtests, data, and feedback.
  • When a prototype graduates, package the game rules, learnings, technical approach, and playable build for handoff to the production team.
  • Continuously experiment with new AI tools, frameworks, and workflows that improve prototype speed and quality.

What We’re Looking For

What you need to have:

  • 5+ years of professional game development experience, or an exceptional portfolio demonstrating equivalent senior-level capability.
  • A strong portfolio of at least 5 completed playable games, prototypes, game-jam projects, or commercial titles where you had substantial hands-on ownership.
  • Proven ability to independently take a game concept from idea to a complete playable prototype.
  • Strong game-design instincts, including mechanics, rules, pacing, player flows, feedback, and game feel.
  • Strong programming fundamentals with the ability to work across frontend, game logic, and lightweight backend systems.
  • Ability to independently create functional, mobile-friendly UI/UX without relying on dedicated designers.
  • Ability to implement bots, APIs, multiplayer functionality, game-state management, and server-side logic when the prototype requires them.
  • Experience using AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, or similar as a core part of your development workflow.
  • Comfortable using AI-generated, existing, or placeholder visual and audio assets to rapidly produce complete playable experiences.
  • Comfortable working independently from an incomplete brief, making both design and technical decisions without detailed specifications.
  • Strong judgment around what to build, what to simplify, and when the evidence says to iterate, progress, or stop.

Nice to have:

  • Experience prototyping card, board, casual, or multiplayer games.
  • Experience with TypeScript/JavaScript and lightweight web game frameworks such as Phaser or PixiJS.
  • Experience with server-authoritative multiplayer systems or hidden-information games.
  • Unity experience.
  • Experience using generative AI for art, animation, audio, or other game assets.
  • Experience with analytics or experimentation tools.
  • Experience taking prototypes through external player testing.

How We Measure Success

Success in this role is not measured by how much production code you write.

It is measured by:

  • Prototype velocity: how quickly meaningful game hypotheses become playable.
  • Learning velocity: how quickly prototypes produce clear answers.
  • Experiment quality: whether prototypes test the right question without unnecessary scope.
  • Decision quality: whether evidence leads to clear iterate, progress, or stop recommendations.
  • AI leverage: how effectively AI tools increase the amount and quality of experimentation one person can deliver.
  • Independence: how effectively you can take an ambiguous concept and move it forward without detailed direction.
  • Handoff quality: whether promising concepts can move into production without losing the important learnings from prototyping.

Why YallaPlay

What You Get

  • Real Impact – You’ll work on meaningful projects that reach a global audience.
  • Collaborative Culture – Small team, big ambition. We keep things fun, respectful, and feedback-driven.

Benefits & Perks

  • Competitive salary
  • Remote-first and flexible schedule- Digital nomad friendly
  • Generous paid time off
  • Paid birthdays off
  • UAE visa sponsorship (if applicable)
  • Growth opportunities and access to learning resources
  • A team that actually loves games—and each other

Next Steps

Ready to join the team? We’d love to hear from you!

  • Apply
  • Share sample code and projects (GitHub)

We review every application carefully and will be in touch if there’s a fit. Good luck!

*Resume MUST be in English

Location: Remote - MENA

Role: Account Manager

Department: Sales

Mode: Full-time

About Respond.io

Founded in Hong Kong in early 2017, is an AI-powered business messaging platform that helps companies manage customer conversations across chat, calls and email — all in one place.

Trusted by businesses in over 127 countries and recognized by G2 and SME100, enables fast-growing companies around the world to capture, convert, and retain customers at scale.

We operate as a globally distributed team with employees based around the world, contributing to a diverse and inclusive culture. Join us, and be part of a team that is shaping the future of customer conversation management!

Our Culture

At , we move fast, work smart, and always keep our customers at the heart of what we do. Here's what we stand for:

  • Solve Customer Problems: Every effort must solve real customer pain points. No guesswork—just real feedback and clear value!
  • The 80/20 Rule: We focus on 20% of actions that create 80% of the value. Simple is powerful—it gets us moving fast.
  • 100% Alignment, 80% Accuracy: We aim 100% team alignment and 80% accuracy. Perfect plans can wait—clear goals come first.
  • Be Direct: We give honest feedback, and tackle problems head-on. Clarity moves us forward!
  • Own It and Support Each Other: We step up, help out, and drive outcomes—together.
  • Build Human Connections: Work is better when we trust, care, and celebrate wins together. We're a team!

Role Description

We're hiring our Founding Account Manager for MENA to build 's Account Management function from the ground up.

This is a Day 0 role. There is no existing playbook, no fixed KPIs, and no template to follow. You will work directly with the Head of Department to design how we engage, retain, and grow our self-service customers and small key accounts across the region.

You will spend roughly 70% of your time on our self-service cohort — customers who today have never spoken to a human at — and 30% on a small portfolio of high-potential key accounts. Your job is to move the self-service base from "unmanaged" to "observed and engaged", run monthly engagement experiments, and surface what actually drives retention and expansion in your region.

You will succeed in this role if you are energized by ambiguity, comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, and excited to be part of a small founding team building something from scratch.

The role

WhatsApp is how business gets done in MENA, and MENA is one of our fastest-growing regions. A big share of our customers bought Respond without ever talking to a human. This changes with you.

Your goal will be to work with our customers to help them expand, retain, and get more value from the platform through onboarding and best practices. This is a one-to-many role where you will learn how to make an impact at scale.

This is an early-stage role. The Account Management function is young: we have a first version of the playbook and early results, but MENA is untouched. You’ll be the first AM in the region, working directly with the executive team, with real room to shape how the playbook evolves as it scales globally.

This is a commercial role. You grow revenue from existing customers and stop revenue from leaving. If you want to own a number and build the machine others will later operate, keep reading.

What you’ll do

Grow the base

  • Own expansion revenue: usage growth, plan upgrades, monthly-to-annual conversions, multi-location rollouts.
  • Find adoption opportunities - help our customers deploy best practices, use AI agents, more platform features.
  • Work from usage and billing signals, because that is where expansion actually converts.
  • Run activation rescue on accounts that bought but never fully deployed.

Defend the base

  • Spot at-risk behavior early and intervene before the cancellation, not after.
  • Analyze every cancellation: find the root cause, document it, and share it with product and revenue leadership.
  • Stabilize high-potential accounts that currently have no dedicated point of contact.
  • Log every account touch from day one. We measure AM impact with data, and your results will be provable, not anecdotal.

What we’re looking for

  • 2+ years in B2B SaaS AM, CS, or Sales where you held a revenue, expansion, or retention number.
  • Managed a portfolio of 50–100 accounts and know how to focus on the ones that matter most.
  • Fluent English and Spanish; Portuguese a strong plus.
  • Deep familiarity with MENA business culture and the role WhatsApp plays in it.
  • Data-driven by default; fixes broken things without being asked; comfortable operating where the playbook is still being written.
  • Comfortable working regional coverage hours.

What’s in it for you

  • Founding role with direct exposure to the executive team and real influence over the function’s design.
  • Clear growth path: build the MENA playbook and have a team built around you.
  • Base plus variable tied to expansion revenue and retention performance.
  • The ownership of an early-stage role, backed by a profitable and well-funded company.
  • Flexible, remote-friendly environment built for sustainable performance.

jobs.description:
ABOUT VICTORY LIVE
Victory Live is a private equity backed technology company aimed at maximizing distribution and yield for live event ticket inventory. We provide an end-to-end software platform for the live ticketing industry, managing thousands of sports, theater, and live music event tickets on behalf of artists, promoters, teams, venues, and professional resellers. Victory Live’s comprehensive offerings include an established B2B marketplace, along with both a full-service and an automated SaaS platform to handle all elements of the ticket sales lifecycle, from ingestion to sales fulfillment.

THE POSITION
Victory Live is looking for a Mid-Level Software Engineer to build and maintain features across our C# and .NET services. You'll own well-scoped pieces of our B2B marketplace and ticketing platform end to end, from design through production, working closely with senior engineers who'll help you level up.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ship features. Build and maintain services in ASP.NET Core, from a scoped design through code review to production.
  • Write tests that hold. Cover your code with xUnit so regressions show up in CI, not in production.
  • Debug production issues. Use logs, metrics, and Datadog dashboards to trace bugs to root cause.
  • Work within our data layer. Write efficient Entity Framework Core queries and migrations that don't lock production tables.
  • Handle messaging and background work. Build and monitor jobs on RabbitMQ or Kafka.
  • Take code review seriously. Review teammates' PRs and act on the feedback you get on your own.
  • Use AI tooling daily. Pair with Claude Code and Copilot for scaffolding, tests, and debugging, and learn where to trust them and where not to.

REQUIREMENTS

  • 2–4 years building production software, with at least 1–2 years in C# and .NET.
  • Comfortable building REST APIs with ASP.NET Core.
  • Solid grasp of xUnit (or NUnit) and test-driven development.
  • Working knowledge of Entity Framework Core, SQL Server, and relational databases.
  • Growing but genuine use of AI tooling in your day-to-day workflow.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Exposure to RabbitMQ, Kafka, or other messaging systems.
  • Familiarity with Redis or Azure services.
  • Interest in ticketing, marketplaces, or high-transaction consumer platforms.

WHY VICTORY LIVE

  • You'll build the infrastructure live events run on; millions of tickets, hundreds of venues, many of the largest teams and events in the world.
  • A lean team where decisions move fast and your code reaches real fans, often the same week.
  • Every release has stakes. Every improvement is felt.
  • High expectations, low tolerance for politics, and a culture built on writing well and shipping with care.

OUR VALUES
We build the systems that power live event ticketing, and we hold a high bar for how we do it. Four principles run through everything:

  • Quality of life. Sustainable processes over heroics. Nobody should be a single point of failure, and nobody should be afraid to take a vacation.
  • Quality of code. Clarity over cleverness. If a teammate needs a long explanation to follow your code, it needs simplifying. Tests prove your work; they aren't optional.
  • Protection of production. Every change is reviewed, tested, and observable. We build with monitoring in mind from day one so we find problems before our users do.
  • Shared knowledge. We work across time zones, so we communicate in the open. Questions go in channels, not DMs, and one answer becomes shared knowledge.

ENGINEERING PRINCIPLES
We are an AI-native engineering team. Here is what that looks like in practice:

  • AI-assisted engineering. Every engineer uses Claude, Claude Code, Copilot, and agentic tooling as a routine part of their workflow.
  • Async-first. Most decisions happen in writing through Jira, Confluence, PR descriptions, design docs. We over-communicate on changes and under-communicate on noise.
  • Ownership mindset. Engineers are responsible for what they write and no code reaches production without review. Reviewers are co-owners.
  • Observability is part of "done." If the on-call engineer can't understand a system without reading source, more logging, metrics, and dashboards are needed.
  • Preservation of quality of code and life. We write code that is clean, tested, and maintainable so it serves us well over time, and we build sustainable processes so no one burns out or becomes a single point of failure.
  • Shared knowledge and continued education. We grow as a team by learning from each other through reviews, documentation, and collaboration.

OUR STACK & WAYS OF WORKING

  • C# and .NET power our B2B marketplace, distribution integrations, and partner-facing APIs
  • Web & mobile clients, REST APIs, microservices
  • Frameworks and tools: .NET, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core, xUnit
  • Data: MSSQL Server, Postgres, Redis
  • Cloud & infra: Azure, AWS, RabbitMQ, Kafka, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform
  • AI tooling: Anthropic / Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, in-house agentic workflows
  • Observability: Datadog, Grafana, Elastic/Kibana, OpsGenie
  • Collaboration: Jira, Confluence, GitHub, Slack, Miro
  • Async-first, agile cadences, distributed onshore + offshore teams

BENEFITS & PERKS

  • Comprehensive medical coverage
  • 100% employer-paid dental, vision, life, and disability insurance
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid parental leave
  • Paid time off and company holidays
  • Employee wellness and professional development opportunities

Victory Live is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, Veteran status, or another other characteristic protected by state, local or federal law.

Community & Marketing Manager – Full Time

GAMURS Group are looking for an experienced Community Manager to become the ‘public face’ of Hefty OSRS, an app designed to reward and engage the OSRS community.

This is much more than a social media posting role. You’ll take ownership of our community, help market and grow the website, support our users and build genuine relationships with OSRS players across Discord, Reddit, X and other relevant platforms.

To succeed in this position, you must have strong, practical knowledge of OSRS, or be willing to become an expert. You should understand the game, its terminology, community culture, content creators, updates, memes and player expectations. We’re looking for someone who knows how to communicate with players authentically.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Act as the public face and voice of Hefty OSRS.
  • Build, manage and grow our Discord community.
  • Create and publish engaging content across Reddit, X and other relevant platforms.
  • Participate genuinely in OSRS conversations rather than simply promoting the app.
  • Develop and execute community marketing and user-growth initiatives.
  • Plan promotions, competitions, giveaways, campaigns and community events.
  • Introduce new players to the app and clearly communicate how it works.
  • Respond to user questions, feedback and support enquiries.
  • Identify common issues and work with the product team to improve the user experience.
  • Gather community insights and report on player sentiment, requests and emerging trends.
  • Monitor OSRS updates, conversations, creators and community developments.
  • Build relationships with OSRS creators, community leaders and potential partners.
  • Support app launches, new features and product announcements.
  • Track community growth, engagement, campaign performance and user feedback.
  • Help ensure that all community and marketing activity respects relevant platform and game rules.

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong, current knowledge of Old School RuneScape, or an eagerness to learn quickly.
  • Some experience playing OSRS and a clear understanding of its community and culture.
  • Experience managing an online community, ideally within gaming.
  • Strong knowledge of Discord, Reddit and X.
  • Experience in social media, digital marketing, community growth or customer engagement.
  • Excellent written communication skills and the ability to adapt your tone for different platforms.
  • Confidence engaging publicly with players, including responding to questions and criticism.
  • A creative, proactive approach to campaigns and community-building.
  • Strong judgement and the ability to communicate authentically without sounding overly corporate.
  • An understanding of community moderation and reputation management.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with product, marketing and customer-support teams.

Nice to Have

  • Existing involvement in OSRS Discord servers, subreddits or other player communities.
  • Relationships with OSRS creators, streamers or community leaders.
  • Experience launching or growing a gaming app, platform or digital product.
  • Experience creating short-form video, graphics, memes or other community content.
  • Knowledge of influencer, referral, affiliate or rewards-based marketing.
  • Experience using analytics to measure community and marketing performance.

About You

You’re an active gamer first and a community builder second. You understand what makes the community unique, what players respond to and what will immediately feel inauthentic.

You’re equally comfortable creating a marketing campaign, answering a user’s question, moderating a Discord discussion, posting on Reddit and sharing player feedback with developers. You enjoy being visible, building trust and turning an audience into an active community.

Role Details

  • Position: OSRS Community & Marketing Manager
  • Employment: Full time
  • Location: Remote
  • Salary:
  • Reports to: Chief Technology Officer & Product Manager

How to Apply

Please send us your résumé and a short introduction covering:

  • Your experience playing Old School RuneScape if applicable (Not required, but a nice to have).
  • Your current OSRS knowledge and involvement in the community (Not required, but a nice to have).

  • An example of how you would introduce Hefty OSRS to the wider OSRS community.
Salary: $1,500 – $1,800 / month
