As a key member of the Group Executive Leadership Team, the Group CFO will serve as a strategic advisor to the Group CEO, President, Board, Investment Committee, and other senior stakeholders, ensuring disciplined capital allocation, strong financial performance, balance-sheet resilience, regulatory compliance, and long-term shareholder value creation.

The role requires a sophisticated financial leader with experience across insurance, investment management, asset management, financial services, corporate finance, capital markets, and regulated financial institutions.

Key Responsibilities

1. Group Financial Strategy & Leadership

Develop and execute the Group's overall financial strategy in alignment with corporate objectives.

Provide strategic financial advice to the Group CEO, President, Board, and Executive Committee.

Establish Group-wide financial policies, standards, controls, and performance frameworks.

Ensure effective financial governance across subsidiaries, business units, joint ventures, and investment entities.

Lead the development of the Group's long-term financial and capital strategy.

2. Group P&L & Financial Performance

Assume overall responsibility for the Group's financial performance, profitability, balance sheet, cash flow, and capital position.

Monitor performance across all subsidiaries and business lines.

Drive sustainable earnings growth, expense efficiency, and return on capital.

Establish Group-wide financial KPIs and performance dashboards.

Challenge business-unit leadership on financial performance and corrective actions.

3. Financial Planning & Performance Management

Lead Group-wide annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-range financial planning.

Develop financial scenarios and stress tests to support strategic decision-making.

Consolidate financial plans across subsidiaries and investment businesses.

Monitor actual performance against budgets, forecasts, and strategic objectives.

Strengthen management reporting and financial analytics.

4. Insurance Finance

Provide executive oversight of financial management across insurance businesses.

Monitor premiums, claims, reserves, expenses, underwriting results, and insurance profitability.

Oversee financial analysis of loss ratios, combined ratios, expense ratios, and underwriting margins.

Partner with actuarial, underwriting, claims, and risk functions to understand financial exposures.

Provide financial input into product profitability, pricing, reinsurance, and portfolio decisions.

5. Investment & Asset Management Finance

Provide Group-level financial oversight of investment portfolios and investment businesses.

Partner with the Chief Investment Officer (CIO) and Investment Committee on investment strategy and performance.

Monitor investment income, portfolio returns, asset allocation, liquidity, and risk-adjusted performance.

Evaluate strategic investment opportunities and major portfolio decisions.

Ensure investment activities support the Group's liabilities, capital objectives, liquidity needs, and risk appetite.

6. Group Capital & Solvency Management

Lead Group-wide capital planning and capital optimization.

Monitor capital adequacy, solvency, leverage, liquidity, and financial resilience.

Develop strategies to optimize capital deployment across subsidiaries and business lines.

Assess the capital implications of acquisitions, investments, dividends, growth initiatives, and strategic transactions.

Partner with Risk and Actuarial leadership on capital and solvency assessments.

7. Asset-Liability Management

Provide executive oversight of asset-liability management (ALM) across relevant insurance and investment businesses.

Ensure investment portfolios are appropriately aligned with insurance liabilities and liquidity requirements.

Monitor duration, interest-rate sensitivity, liquidity gaps, and market exposures.

Support balance-sheet optimization and financial stress-testing initiatives.

8. Treasury & Liquidity

Lead Group treasury, liquidity, cash management, and banking relationships.

Establish Group-wide liquidity policies and funding strategies.

Optimize cash across subsidiaries while maintaining appropriate regulatory and operational liquidity.

Oversee debt facilities, guarantees, intercompany funding, and treasury risk.

Monitor interest-rate, foreign-exchange, credit, and liquidity exposures.

9. Capital Raising & Financing

Lead Group-level financing and capital-raising initiatives.

Develop relationships with banks, institutional investors, private equity firms, development-finance institutions, debt providers, and capital-market participants.

Oversee debt issuance, refinancing, capital injections, and other funding strategies.

Optimize the Group's capital structure and cost of capital.

Ensure funding capacity supports strategic growth.

10. M&A, Investments & Corporate Development

Lead financial evaluation of acquisitions, disposals, strategic investments, and joint ventures.

Oversee financial due diligence, valuation, transaction modeling, and deal structuring.

Assess the impact of transactions on earnings, capital, solvency, liquidity, and shareholder value.

Partner with the CEO and Board on major strategic transactions.

Oversee financial integration and post-transaction performance.

11. Group Financial Reporting & Consolidation

Ensure accurate and timely consolidated financial reporting across the Group.

Oversee statutory accounts, management reporting, regulatory returns, and Board reporting.

Establish consistent accounting and reporting standards across subsidiaries.

Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and insurance regulations.

Maintain strong relationships with external auditors and professional advisers.

12. Regulatory & Governance

Maintain strong financial governance across the Group.

Ensure compliance with applicable insurance, investment, corporate, tax, and financial regulations.

Manage relationships with regulators, auditors, rating agencies, and other external stakeholders.

Establish effective internal controls and financial policies.

Ensure appropriate governance across subsidiaries, SPVs, joint ventures, and investment entities.

13. Financial Risk Management

Establish and oversee the Group's financial risk-management framework.

Monitor market, credit, liquidity, underwriting, investment, interest-rate, FX, and operational financial risks.

Establish appropriate stress-testing and contingency-planning processes.

Work closely with the Group CRO, Chief Actuary, CIO, and business leaders to manage enterprise-wide risk.

14. Tax Strategy

Oversee Group-wide tax planning, compliance, reporting, and risk management.

Ensure appropriate tax governance across subsidiaries and jurisdictions.

Identify opportunities for legitimate tax efficiency.

Monitor changes in tax and regulatory requirements affecting the Group.

15. Investor & Stakeholder Relations

Develop strong relationships with shareholders, institutional investors, lenders, rating agencies, regulators, and other financial stakeholders.

Lead financial communications to the Board and key investors.

Support investor presentations, annual reports, strategic reviews, and capital-market activities.

Clearly communicate the Group's financial strategy, performance, and outlook.

16. Finance Transformation

Modernize the Group's finance operating model, systems, processes, and reporting infrastructure.

Strengthen ERP, FP&A, consolidation, business intelligence, and financial analytics capabilities.

Drive automation and digital transformation across finance.

Improve transparency and real-time visibility across subsidiaries and business units.

17. Leadership & Organizational Development

Lead the Group Finance function and senior finance leadership across subsidiaries.

Develop a high-performing, commercially focused finance organization.

Establish common standards, talent-development programs, and succession plans.

Build strong relationships with subsidiary CFOs and Finance Directors.

Promote a culture of integrity, accountability, financial discipline, and value creation.

Key Performance Indicators

The Group CFO will be accountable for:

Group revenue and earnings growth

Group EBITDA / net income performance

Return on equity (ROE)

Return on capital

Capital adequacy and solvency

Investment portfolio performance

Investment income and risk-adjusted returns

Insurance underwriting profitability

Combined ratio / loss ratio performance

Expense efficiency

Liquidity and cash-flow strength

Balance-sheet optimization

Cost of capital

Capital-raising effectiveness

M&A and strategic-investment performance

Budget and forecast accuracy

Regulatory and reporting compliance

Financial risk management

Shareholder value creation

Candidate Profile

Essential Experience

18+ years of progressive finance experience, including substantial Group or enterprise-level leadership.

Previous experience as Group CFO, CFO, Deputy Group CFO, Group Finance Director, Finance Director, or equivalent.

Significant experience within insurance, investment management, asset management, banking, pensions, reinsurance, or diversified financial services.

Proven experience managing complex group structures, subsidiaries, investment entities, and regulated businesses.

Strong understanding of insurance financial reporting, capital and solvency requirements, investment portfolios, and balance-sheet management.

Demonstrated experience in capital allocation, treasury, liquidity, financial planning, and enterprise risk.

Experience working directly with Boards, CEOs, regulators, auditors, investors, lenders, and rating agencies.

Preferred Experience

Previous Group CFO experience within a diversified insurance or investment group.

Experience covering both insurance operations and investment/asset-management businesses.

Exposure to life insurance, general insurance, reinsurance, pensions, or institutional investment.

Experience managing significant investment portfolios and ALM.

Proven experience with M&A, capital raising, restructuring, strategic investments, or international expansion.

Experience across multiple jurisdictions and regulatory environments.

Experience working with international institutional investors or rating agencies.

Education & Professional Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

Professional qualification such as CA, ACCA, CPA, CMA, CFA, or equivalent strongly preferred.

MBA or Master's degree in Finance/Business is advantageous.

Additional insurance, investment, actuarial, or risk-management qualifications are desirable.

Core Competencies

Group Financial Leadership

Corporate Finance

Insurance Finance

Investment Finance

Capital & Solvency Management

Asset-Liability Management

Treasury & Liquidity

Financial Planning & Analysis

Investment Analysis

Financial Modeling

Capital Allocation

M&A & Corporate Development

Regulatory Reporting

Risk Management

Investor Relations

Corporate Governance

Finance Transformation

Leadership Characteristics

The successful Group CFO will be:

Strategic, commercially astute, and financially rigorous

Comfortable operating across complex group structures

Strong in capital allocation and investment decisions

Experienced in highly regulated environments

A sophisticated communicator at Board and investor level

Strong in balance-sheet and liquidity management

Comfortable challenging business leaders and driving accountability

Able to balance growth, profitability, capital, liquidity, and risk

An effective partner to the CEO, CIO, CRO, Chief Actuary, and subsidiary CEOs

A transformational leader capable of building a world-class Group Finance function

  • Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules

jobs.excerpt: The Technical Project Manager is responsible for delivering infrastructure, cloud, and transformation projects from planning through completion.
jobs.description:
The Technical Project Manager is responsible for delivering infrastructure, cloud, and transformation projects from planning through completion. The role manages project scope, timelines, budgets, risks, resources, and client expectations while applying lean and agile project management practices.

Working closely with clients, engineers, consultants, and vendors, the Technical Project Manager translates business and technical requirements into clear project plans and ensures successful delivery. The role may also support client-led initiatives such as infrastructure refreshes, cloud migrations, M&A-related IT transitions, and transformation projects.

The position also contributes to improving internal project management processes, templates, and tools to promote consistent, efficient, and high-quality project delivery.

Job Details

Work set up: Work from home

Schedule: Monday to Friday | 8 AM to 5 PM | UK Time

Holiday: Will follow UK holidays

Responsibilities

  • Presales
  • Advise the sales team on technical delivery requirements, risks, and scheduling.
  • Review proposed solutions to ensure feasibility and alignment with client expectations.

    Project Planning
  • Ensure that all customer projects are well planned, considering reasonable timescales to complete the work, contingency, risk planning, resource availability and client expectations
  • Support the Professional Services Manager to schedule client projects, balancing resource availability and client expectations.
  • Set clear project expectations and deliverables with the client to ensure a common understanding of the scope and metrics of the project as a baseline in accordance with the commercial agreement.
  • Technical Project Management
  • Act as the primary point of contact for clients throughout the technical delivery lifecycle, managing expectations, communicating progress, and supporting clients in fulfilling their responsibilities during infrastructure and cloud-based projects.
  • Collaborate with internal technical teams (e.g., engineers, consultants) to ensure that all project tasks are delivered on time, within scope, and to the required technical standards and cost parameters.
  • Coordinate with external partners and vendors to ensure third-party deliverables meet the company’s technical and operational requirements, maintaining seamless integration with internal workstreams.
  • Manage all changes and exceptions from a technical, logistical, and commercial perspective — including scope adjustments, risk mitigation, and resource reallocation — ensuring alignment with client objectives and contractual commitments.
  • Provide regular internal updates on project status, technical progress, and risks to enable effective prioritization, resource planning, and escalation where necessary.
  • Apply agile principles to project delivery, adapting plans and priorities in response to evolving client needs, technical constraints, or emerging opportunities, while maintaining a focus on quality and efficiency. They will have a solid background in Azure/M365 and Infrastructure change initiatives in a MSP setting
  • They will have technical oversight and accountability for the technical success of project and not just administer the success
  • The Technical Project manager will understand technical discussions and collaborate and contribute to all design decisions.
  • PMO & Continuous Improvement
  • Put in place and continually review templates and guidance for project planning to raise the standard of project planning in the company and to enable others to plan smaller projects to a consistently high standard
  • Continually monitor and improve the processes for delivering projects to produce greater efficiency and reliability, leveraging automation where possible
  • Have a “lean and agile” mindset, looking continually to improve and expedite processes without compromising quality of delivery
  • General Responsibilities:
  • Maintain up to date knowledge of company’s operational procedures and Employee handbook and comply with the requirements
  • Work collaboratively with team members
  • Participate fully in company-wide initiatives
  • Undertake other duties as may reasonably requested by management
  • Client-Embedded Project Delivery
  • Serve as a client-facing resource, embedded within client teams to manage internal or third-party projects, applying company’s delivery standards and methodologies.
  • Represent the company professionally while operating within client environments, maintaining high standards of communication, delivery, and stakeholder management.
  • Provide strategic input and technical oversight for client-led initiatives, ensuring alignment with best practices and business objectives.
  • Act as a bridge between client stakeholders and external vendors, facilitating smooth delivery and issue resolution.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • Project Management certification such as PRINCE2, PMI, or Agile.
  • Technical certification such as Microsoft, Azure, or Cisco.
  • At least 5 years of experience managing IT infrastructure projects, including:
  • On-premises or cloud infrastructure refresh projects.
  • Microsoft 365 migrations or mergers.
  • Azure migrations or transformation projects.
  • Infrastructure, file, and user migration outsourcing projects.
  • Backup and storage projects.
  • Experience working with SME customers.
  • Experience managing projects across various industries using Waterfall, Agile, and/or Hybrid methodologies.
  • Experience delivering infrastructure migrations, cloud implementations, or SaaS implementations.
  • Strong technical understanding of infrastructure and cloud environments.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication and customer service skills.
  • Strong project management, time management, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work under pressure, manage multiple priorities, and maintain strong attention to detail.
  • Strong problem-solving, negotiation, influencing, and decision-making skills.
  • Agile mindset with a strong focus on quality and customer satisfaction.
  • Ability to lead others, build professional networks, and work effectively with internal and external stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 5–8 years years of corporate/commercial legal experience, ideally in-house or with a corporate law firm serving technology/infrastructure clients

Preferred

  • Prior experience in technology, cloud infrastructure, or AI/GPU-related industries

Someone comfortable operating with significant autonomy across jurisdictions with limited local precedent, who flags risk early and in plain language rather than after the fact.

jobs.title: Partnerships & Business Operations Manager
jobs.excerpt: The RoleWolf is looking for a Partnerships & Business Operations Manager to help turn important partnerships and company initiatives into products and experiences people can actually play.
jobs.description:
The Role

Wolf is looking for a Partnerships & Business Operations Manager to help turn important partnerships and company initiatives into products and experiences people can actually play.

Signing a partnership is only the beginning. Teams need to align, decisions need to get made, assets and approvals need to arrive, and product, engineering, creative, commercial, and partner work all need to stay connected. Your job is to help make that happen.

You’ll work directly with Wolf’s founders and across Partnerships, Product, Engineering, Creative, Marketing, Legal, and external partner teams. You’ll help create structure around ambiguous work, turn conversations into action, and make sure important details don’t fall through the cracks.

You’ll sit close to the center of the business, seeing firsthand how partnerships become products and how product, technology, creative, commercial, and audience strategy come together. Some days that means thinking through a new opportunity; others, it means tracking down a missing asset or decision blocking a launch.

Wolf is still early, and the partnerships, products, and ways we operate are being built today. You’ll start with defined pieces of important initiatives and take on increasingly meaningful ownership as you demonstrate judgment, reliability, and follow-through.

What You’ll Do

Turn Partnerships Into Products

  • Help move partnerships from agreement or idea through development, launch, and expansion.
  • Turn partner conversations and commitments into clear owners, actions, and next steps.
  • Keep track of deliverables, assets, approvals, timelines, and dependencies across Wolf and partner teams.
  • Prepare for partner meetings, capture decisions, and make sure follow-ups happen.
  • Build strong relationships with partner teams and grow into a trusted day-to-day counterpart.

Drive Cross-Functional Execution

  • Help build and manage plans for partner initiatives, products, and launches.
  • Coordinate across Product, Engineering, Creative, Marketing, and external teams.
  • Keep owners, milestones, decisions, and dependencies organized and visible.
  • Notice when something is blocked, unclear, or falling behind and help get it resolved.
  • Make sure decisions turn into action and that important details don’t fall through the cracks.
  • Adapt as priorities, requirements, and timelines change.

Learn What Works

  • Help define what success looks like for launches and partner initiatives.
  • Gather performance data, partner feedback, and lessons from what we ship.
  • Help the team understand what worked, what didn’t, and what we should do differently next time.
  • Carry lessons from one partnership or launch into the next.
  • Help identify opportunities to grow successful partnerships.

Help Build the Machine

  • Notice recurring problems, inefficiencies, and places where ownership is unclear.
  • Help create simple playbooks, workflows, templates, and tools that make execution easier.
  • Improve how Wolf keeps track of commitments, decisions, and next steps.
  • Make the team more organized and effective without adding unnecessary processes.
  • Take on increasingly ambiguous and important projects as you learn the business and earn trust.

What Success Looks Like

90 days in:

  • A strong understanding of Wolf’s partnerships, products, teams, and how work moves from idea to launch.
  • Partner initiatives where you’ve kept deliverables, decisions, and owners organized and moving.
  • Internal and external relationships where people increasingly trust you to follow through and get the right people aligned.

6 months in:

  • A partner initiative or launch where you’ve independently driven meaningful pieces of the work from planning through execution.
  • A complex project where you identified a blocker, dependency, or missing decision early and helped resolve it.
  • A process, tool, or workflow you’ve improved to make partnership execution more effective.

By the end of your first year:

  • A major partner product or initiative you helped take from idea to launch.
  • A partner relationship where you’ve become a trusted operating counterpart and helped identify opportunities for continued growth.
  • Lessons, processes, or playbooks from your work that have materially improved how Wolf executes future partnerships and launches.

The ultimate measure is simple: Wolf should be able to take on more ambitious work with more partners because you’re part of the team.

Who We’re Looking For

We care more about how you think, work, and learn than about a specific career path. You’re likely to thrive here if:

  • You are exceptionally organized. You keep track of details, commitments, and deadlines, and rarely let things fall through the cracks.
  • You learn quickly. You’re curious, ask good questions, and can get up to speed on unfamiliar products, technologies, and business problems.
  • You’re great with people. You communicate clearly, build relationships easily, and are comfortable working with different personalities and functions.
  • You turn ambiguity into action. When something isn’t clearly defined, your instinct is to figure out what’s needed and what should happen next.
  • You follow through. If you say you’ll do something, people can trust that it will get done.
  • You’re a clear communicator. You can listen to a complicated conversation and pull out the important decisions, questions, and next steps.
  • You notice things. Missing information, unclear ownership, potential problems, and loose ends tend to stand out to you.
  • You have good judgment—and want to develop more of it. You’re comfortable making progress independently but know when to ask questions or pull someone in.
  • You’re willing to do whatever the work requires. You’re as comfortable thinking through a bigger problem as you are tracking down a missing asset or following up on an overdue decision.
  • You want responsibility. You’re early in your career and excited by the opportunity to learn quickly, prove yourself, and earn increasingly significant ownership.

This could be a great role for someone with roughly 2-5 years of experience, but we care more about capability, trajectory, and demonstrated ownership than tenure.

Relevant backgrounds might include:

  • Business or startup operations
  • Strategy & operations
  • Partnerships
  • Program or project management
  • Product operations
  • Consulting
  • Implementation or solutions
  • Media, entertainment, gaming, or technology

We’re especially interested in people who have taken ownership of something and made it happen—whether that means shipping a cross-functional project, coordinating internal and external stakeholders, building a useful process or system, or becoming the person a team relied on to keep complicated work moving.

Compensation: $35-45/hour, depending on experience

This role starts as a 90-day contract, at which point we can assess mutual fit and discuss conversion to a full-time role with benefits.

AI Security Engineer — AI & Agentic Security

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on, AI Security engineer / developer, to support our Enterprise AI Security Program. Our AI landscape spans everything from internal chatbot pilot to a full agentic workflow with tool access, Code Assistant rollout to thousands of developers to new Agentic platform. Externally, the tools and protocols worth worrying about change every few months. You'll be the person who can look at both ends of that spread ensuring safe and secure adoption of AI.

Required:

  • Strong SWE, with 5+ years of experience; proficiency in Python (or equivalent)
  • 3+ years in AI/ML or GenAI security (prompt injection defense, unsafe output handling, tool-use abuse, data leakage), or equivalent hands-on infosec experience with a demonstrated pivot into AI security.
  • Demonstrated ability to write security policy that is specific and testable, and to translate it into automated enforcement (policy-as-code, CI/CD gates, gateway-level controls, DLP rules) rather than a document that relies on voluntary compliance.
  • A track record of self-directed learning on fast-moving technical topics — comfortable digging into how a brand-new tool, protocol, or framework actually works (architecture, trust boundaries, auth model) well enough to give a defensible security opinion on it within days, not months.
  • Working knowledge of AI/LLM security risks: prompt injection, jailbreaking, unsafe outputs, tool-use abuse, identity misuse, agentic workflow escalation.
  • Hands-on familiarity with AI security frameworks: NIST AI RMF, MITRE ATLAS, OWASP LLM Top 10 / OWASP Agentic Top 10.
  • Experience with cloud security across at least two of AWS, GCP, and Azure, including native AI/ML security tooling (Bedrock Guardrails, Vertex AI floor settings, Azure AI Content Safety).
  • Identity and access management fundamentals — OAuth 2.0/2.1, OIDC, mTLS — with interest in or exposure to non-human/workload identity (SPIFFE/SPIRE) and agent identity models.
  • Experience in a highly regulated industry (healthcare, financial services) with HIPAA or equivalent compliance obligations.
  • Strong technical writing — you can turn a vendor capability gap or a new tool's risk profile into a control requirement someone else can implement and test.

Preferred:

  • Direct experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or A2A protocol security, or with AI gateway products (Kong AI Gateway, Azure APIM GenAI Gateway, Apigee).
  • Exposure to AI-native runtime security platforms (Straiker, Palo Alto Prisma AIRS, Virtue AI) or classic content guardrail products.
  • Familiarity with shadow-AI / BYOAI risk — e.g., locally-run autonomous agent frameworks (OpenClaw and similar), unsanctioned browser extensions, personal AI accounts used for work — and how to discover and govern them at scale (CrowdStrike Falcon, Wiz, CASB, or similar).
  • AI red-team tooling experience (PyRIT, Promptfoo, AgentDojo, or custom harnesses).
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Purview DSPM for AI or equivalent DLP-for-AI tooling.
  • Relevant certification (CAISP, ISACA AAISM) or equivalent demonstrated skill.
  • Experience with detection engineering, SIEM integration, and telemetry design for AI/agent behavior.

ABOUT DRIPS

Drips is a conversational AI platform that helps enterprise brands and their partners have smarter, more human conversations with customers, at scale. We operate at the intersection of AI, messaging, and revenue-generating outcomes for some of the largest companies in the country.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are hiring a dynamic Senior Product Manager to join our Product team. This is an individual contributor role, reporting directly to the VP of Product & Engineering, and you will work across every department, including Engineering, Operations, Customer Success, Sales, Data Analytics, and AI/ML.

This is a fully remote role, working with fully remote teams. Leading and influencing across departments in a distributed environment is a key experience to success in this role.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

  • End-to-end delivery of product initiatives across multiple domains simultaneously
  • Writing clear, detailed PRDs and functional specs independently, utilizing AI-first workflows at every step along the way
  • Customer and stakeholder discovery, translating messy real-world requirements into scoped, buildable features
  • Owning relationships with external vendors and integration partners from evaluation through go-live
  • Regular communication with exec leadership, including presenting roadmap and status updates with confidence and precision
  • Working hands-on with AI and automation tooling to shape, validate, and accelerate product decisions, including defining requirements for LLM-based features and continually evolving your own workflows and tools to fit the problem in front of you
  • Querying and evaluating data directly to inform decisions and validate outcomes
  • Gaining consensus across Engineering, Customer Success, Sales, and AI/ML without losing momentum

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Product initiatives ship on a predictable cadence, with scope and tradeoffs understood by everyone involved before work starts
  • Customer and stakeholder input is translated into decisions, not just captured
  • Exec leadership has an accurate, current picture of the roadmap and can trust the status they hear
  • Cross-functional partners in Engineering, Customer Success, Sales, and AI/ML see Product as a source of momentum, not a bottleneck

WHO WE ARE

  • A true polyglot. You can write a PRD in the morning, jump on a customer call in the afternoon, and review an API spec before end of day
  • As comfortable analyzing complex data as you are presenting a strategic roadmap to leadership
  • At home in ambiguity. You do not need process handed to you, and you build what is missing rather than waiting for it
  • You treat unfinished problems as opportunities rather than blockers
  • AI-first in how you work. You reach for AI tooling by default and keep reshaping your workflow and toolset as the work and the tools change
  • A deliberate remote collaborator. You over-communicate by default and build trust across departments and time zones without needing a room

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

REQUIRED

  • 7+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS or high-growth startup environments
  • Proven track record in delivery-heavy roles where you shipped product, not just planned it
  • Hands-on experience with AI/ML products, conversational AI, NLP, or messaging platforms
  • API and integration fluency, you understand how systems connect and can own the details
  • SQL proficiency, you’re comfortable pulling your own data rather than waiting on analysts
  • An AI-first way of working, you use AI tooling to accelerate your own output without sacrificing quality or judgment, and you actively evolve your workflows and tools as your needs change
  • Demonstrated ability to manage external vendor and partner relationships end-to-end
  • Strong written communication, your specs and updates are clear the first time
  • Proven success leading cross-functional work in a fully remote, distributed organization, building alignment across departments without relying on in-person proximity

STRONG PLUS

  • Prior experience in a product-adjacent role, including engineering, implementation, sales, or customer success
  • Enough technical fluency to read and reason about code in an AI-assisted development environment, so you can ask sharper questions and pressure-test scope with Engineering
  • Interest in prototyping directly to validate an idea or communicate intent faster than a spec can. This is a product role, not an engineering role, you will not be assigned production development work or carry engineering deliverables
  • Background spanning both enterprise and startup contexts

jobs.description:
Шукаємо Motion Designer-a на проєктну роботу 4–6 тижнів в команду 6037, який(-а) допоможе створювати AI-generated відео та анімовані візуали для рекламних креативів. Стартуємо новий напрям у ніші longevity і разом з ним — тест нових для нас платформ: TikTok та Applovin.

Переваги позиції:

  • Гнучкість — ти сам(-а) обираєш, коли працювати.
  • Вплив на результат: твої відео побачать тисячі користувачів і напряму вплинуть на ефективність рекламних кампаній. Ти бачиш перформанс своїх креативів і швидко ітеруєш.
  • Свобода в інструментах: більшість продакшену йде через AI, ми підтримуємо автоматизацію і допоможемо зібрати пайплайн (у тому числі через Claude).
  • Можливість експериментувати, тестувати гіпотези та працювати з трендовими форматами на площадках, які ми тільки відкриваємо.

Твої майбутні виклики:

  • AI-генерація відеоконтенту (Seedance, Kling) і монтаж в After Effects — створення креативів з нуля.
  • Анімації: face/body scanner, анімація плашок, субтитри.
  • Створення end card / playable під Applovin: інтерактивний пекшот або міні-гра в HTML. Зазвичай робиться статичний креатив, який далі перетворюється в HTML, або збирається з графічних елементів у внутрішніх інструментах Applovin.
  • Адаптація відео з Meta під Applovin: там ліміт 59 секунд, тому частину роликів треба скорочувати по скрипту і перегенеровувати окремі шматки.
  • Взаємодія з креативними маркетологами, участь у брейнштормах та створенні концептів.

Що для нас важливо:

  • Сильний досвід використання AI-інструментів для генерації відео — Seedance, Kling або аналоги. Це ключова вимога: більшість продакшену йде саме через них.
  • Від 2-х років з After Effects.
  • Перформанс-мислення: розумієш, що таке hook і retention у відео, чому одна версія працює, а інша ні.
  • Вміння працювати структуровано, вкладатися в дедлайни та робити задачі «під ключ». Проєкт короткий, ітерації щоденні.

Буде перевагою:

  • Досвід з Applovin: playable, end card, базове розуміння HTML.
  • Досвід створення відео для TikTok / UGC форматів.
  • Навички роботи зі звуком (озвучка, саунд-дизайн).

Портфоліо — обовʼязкове. Винеси в ньому релевантні приклади:

  • AI-згенеровані відео, бажано таймінг 20 секунд і більше.
  • Реклама діджитал-продуктів (апки, підписки, сервіси).
  • Якщо є playable або end card під Applovin — покажи окремо.

Процес найму:

Перегляд портфоліо → інтервʼю з командою → офер. Тестового завдання немає — оцінюємо по роботах.

Про нас

6037 — венчурне партнерство, що інвестує в перспективні продукти на ранніх етапах. Ми перетворюємо стартапи на ефективні та стійкі бізнеси за допомогою маркетингової, аналітичної та операційної експертизи.

Наша місія — перетворити Україну з аутсорс-хабу на країну продуктів. Ми націлені побудувати портфель продуктових лідерів у своїх нішах із сукупною кількістю користувачів 1 мільярд.

Наші цінності:

  • Optimism. Наші люди сприймають кар'єру як марафон. Вони не збавляють темп навіть тоді, коли складно, бо розуміють: у фіналі — досягнення великої цілі.
  • Ownership. У 6037 немає запасних. Кожен відповідає за свою ділянку маршруту, бо від особистого внеску кожного залежить успіх усієї команди.
  • Diligence. Ми працюємо за принципом команд Формули-1, де швидкість поєднана з точністю. Ми мислимо логічно у цифрах і дослідженнях, бо віримо, що глибина аналізу формує стабільну перевагу.

Що нас відрізняє:

Ми не обіцяємо те, чого не можемо виконати. Не гарантуємо легкого шляху чи поверхневого комфорту. Натомість пропонуємо траєкторію до відчутних результатів.

  • Змагання у Вищій лізі. Якщо 6037 працює з продуктом, то тільки для того, аби змагатися з лідерами на світовій арені. Працювати тут — це змагатися на чемпіонаті світу. Саме тому ми шукаємо людей з ментальністю атлета, готових викладатися та боротися за перше місце.
  • Спільнота сильних. Командний результат залежить від кожного гравця. Тут люди задають високу планку собі й іншим та спонукають одне одного розвиватися.
  • Компенсація залежить від результату. Винагорода залежить не від кількості годин, а від якості роботи. Замість порожніх обіцянок ми даємо чітке розуміння, скільки й за який результат зароблятимеш.

Проєкт короткий, але це вхідна точка: якщо спрацюємось на TikTok та Applovin — є що робити далі.

Витисни максимум зі своєї карʼєри — приймай виклик та надсилай CV і портфоліо.

About the Program:

Every year, we sponsor 2 remote design accelerator apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end design and research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.

Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks build and launch their startup or business idea.

Apprenticeship Requirements:

This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:

  • Interested launching a digital app, AI app, or digital business/startup
  • Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables
  • Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules
  • Open to feedback from mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work

Apprenticeship Program Learnings:

  • Build digital products and services 0-1
  • Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice
  • Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management
  • Identify target market for product and position product for launch success
  • Incorporate AI tools into your UX design process
  • Design AI features and products by considering AI specific design parameters and heuristics
  • Understand how AI works and advocate for ethical AI design that builds trust without over-reliance with users
  • Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales
  • Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights
  • Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution
  • Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables
  • Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea
  • Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution
  • Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options
  • Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.

How to Apply:

Please fill out our application form to apply for UX Woman sponsoring your participation in the program. The application takes 5 minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your LinkedIn profile and resume, as well as ask you about why you are interested in this program. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply- we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.

You will receive UX tips and challenges via email to help you with your transition into UX and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort. Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status.If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. We consider applicants on a rolling basis.

The ABM will demonstrate initiative, drive, and independence, and take ownership for meeting and exceeding individual business goals. We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world.   • Establish relationship with thought leaders in assigned territory. Primary objective is to drive industry leading customer value.

  • 3+ years of sales experience.

  • Demonstrated ability to learn and apply technical and scientific product-related information.

  • Ability to travel to meetings/trainings/programs as necessary - additional travel may be required within the assigned territory.

Peak Financial Planning is a fee-only fiduciary financial planning firm specializing in helping pre-retirees and retirees make smarter decisions about retirement income, taxes, Social Security, investments, and long-term spending.

YouTube is the media engine behind Peak Financial Planning. Led by founder and CEO Eric Amzalag, CFP®, RICP®, our educational content reaches hundreds of thousands of viewers and generates millions of dollars of investment into the company each month.

Our mission is to become the most trusted retirement-planning media brand in the country.

We produce high-performance, long-form educational content designed to help people make better retirement decisions, deepen trust in the Peak brand, and generate measurable business impact throughout the firm.

Our content is not vanity media. It is the primary way prospective clients discover Peak, learn how we think, and decide whether our planning process is right for them.

We operate through structured workflows, disciplined production systems, clear performance metrics, and an aggressive commitment to innovation—especially through AI-native research, production, and optimization systems.

We are building a repeatable content machine that compounds: stronger ideas, better packaging, higher-quality videos, faster iteration, more qualified prospects, and deeper brand equity over time.

If you’re joining Peak Financial Planning, you’re not here to simply manage a YouTube channel. You’re here to help build the leading retirement-planning media brand in the country.

Role

The YouTube Manager exists to turn Peak Financial Planning’s business priorities, audience insights, and financial-planning expertise into long-form videos that perform at their ceiling and generate measurable business outcomes.

This is a true channel-owner seat for the Eric at Peak Financial Planning YouTube channel. You will have meaningful input upstream on ideas, angles, series concepts, livestreams, clip channel and formats, informed by performance data and a deep understanding of what retirement-focused viewers respond to.

You will help shape what gets made and how it gets recorded so that YouTube performance is built in from the start—not bolted on at the end.

This is not a channel babysitter or packaging-only position. You will own titles, thumbnails, metadata, upload operations, livestream operations, analytics, and back-catalogue optimization. You will be accountable for subscriber growth, booked consultations, and YouTube’s contribution to Peak’s client-acquisition engine.

Views and click-through rate are inputs, not the ultimate goal. The goal is to attract the right viewers, build trust at scale, and convert attention into qualified prospective clients.

The role is AI-forward by default. Analytics, reporting, A/B-test tracking, competitive research, and optimization workflows should increasingly run through AI agents and automation—not manual spreadsheets and gut instinct.

This role reports directly to the Chief Growth Officer, Chris, and works closely with Eric, the video editor, the thumbnail designer, to shape brand identity, content production, and distribution.

Own the creative direction of YouTube packaging, including titles and thumbnails, partnering with Peak’s editor and designers to translate each content brief into the final published package.

Own YouTube analytics and build AI-agent-powered workflows for data compilation, anomaly detection, competitive research, reporting, and performance diagnosis.
Translate performance insights into specific decisions affecting video ideas, hooks, titles, thumbnails, scripting, production, and distribution.
Systematically audit and re-optimize Peak’s back catalogue, including thumbnails, titles, descriptions, calls to action, links, and metadata, and create a documented prioritization framework.
Track the compounding impression, view, subscriber, consultation, and revenue impact generated by back-catalogue optimization.
Monitor the retirement, investing, tax-planning, and personal-finance content landscape to identify rising viewer demand, competitive gaps, and differentiated opportunities for Peak.
Evaluate and roll out new YouTube features using a clear test-and-measure process.
Maintain a reliable connection between channel performance and downstream business outcomes, including website traffic, consultation-funnel activity, qualified booked calls, and new-client acquisition.
Work within Peak’s compliance requirements as an SEC-registered investment adviser, ensuring content, descriptions, claims, disclosures, and publishing workflows meet the firm’s standards.

Requirements

3+ years managing, growing, or optimizing a high-volume YouTube channel.
Deep command of YouTube’s packaging ecosystem, including thumbnails, titles, click-through-rate mechanics, retention patterns, traffic sources, recommendation behavior, and catalogue optimization.
Strong analytical fundamentals and demonstrated experience drawing practical creative decisions from performance data.
Demonstrated experience running and documenting A/B tests for YouTube content.
Familiarity with AI tools for analytics, reporting, research, or workflow automation—or a clear drive to build with them.
Proficiency with project-management tools and Google Workspace, plus strong written communication for titles, descriptions, creative briefs, and internal reports.
Strong quality-control instincts and the ability to manage detailed publishing workflows without missed steps or preventable errors.
Ability to distinguish between content that generates broad attention and content that attracts qualified prospective clients.
Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, fully remote environment with clear ownership and measurable accountability.
Experience with financial, retirement, investing, or educational media is strongly preferred.
Familiarity with the advertising and recordkeeping considerations affecting financial-services content is a plus.

Results

Click-through-rate and impression benchmarks improve consistently across new uploads.
New videos attract qualified retirement-planning viewers—not merely broad, low-intent traffic.
The back catalogue generates measurable new impression, view, subscriber, consultation, and revenue volume through systematic re-optimization.
A/B testing is continuous, documented, and actively informs packaging decisions.
Analytics reporting is automated, timely, decision-ready, and connected to downstream business performance.
Zero uploads go live without passing the complete editorial, technical, brand, and compliance checklist.
Subscriber growth trends upward quarter over quarter.
YouTube remains a measurable and growing driver of qualified website traffic, consultation calls, new clients, and revenue for Peak Financial Planning.
The channel develops a clearer and more defensible competitive position as a leading source of retirement-planning education.

You will also help search for new critical/high risk vulnerabilities in our codebase. As issues are uncovered, you will communicate with the appropriate technical and leadership teams to ensure a focus on risk mitigation – allowing for business continuity, but without negligent risk. Application security engineers are constantly assessing applications for weaknesses and finding resolutions before they can be abused.

  • Discover vulnerabilities and construct exploits for core Parallels applications such as Parallels Remote Application Server
  • Assist in the CVE disclosure process
  • Provide threat models and design reviews for teams throughout the company
  • Assist in tuning existing static analysis, dynamic analysis, and dependency management tools

  • Eagerness to learn – you are not expected to know everything coming in, but you should continuously learn new techniques on the job

  • Familiarity with cloud security best practices
  • 3+ years of industry experience
  • OSCP/OSWE/OSED/RET2 certification

Inventory Forecasting & Management

  • Continuously monitor inventory levels across all sales channels to prevent overstocking or Out-of-Stock (OOS) situations.
  • Forecast inventory movements and project OOS dates at the SKU level to accurately plan factory order quantities.

Reverse Logistics & Returns Management

  • Create and manage Amazon removal orders for customer returns.
  • Arrange transport from Amazon to 3PL/processing facilities.
  • Oversee the de-kitting, inspection, and sorting of damaged units into tiers for parts harvesting or resale.

Scale of Operations:

  • Factory Orders: ~6 per year.

Software & Workflow Proficiency:

Core Competencies

  • 3+ years of experience in supply chain, logistics, or Amazon inventory management.
  • Proven ability to manage complex shipments and multi-stage fulfillment workflows across international markets.
  • Strong understanding of Amazon FBA processes and multi-channel e-commerce operations.
  • Advanced analytical mindset with the ability to build and interpret detailed SKU-level forecasting and inventory models.
  • Practical experience coordinating international freight, container shipments, and 3PL operations in a multi-channel environment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and high attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently while coordinating with multiple stakeholders.
  • Alignment with the companys premium brand standards and operational excellence mindset.

Why Join Us:

  • Own inventory planning, logistics, and fulfillment workflows.
  • Work remotely from anywhere.
  • Competitive salary and flexible working hours.

Following our successful, oversubscribed Seed funding round, Ladder Health is entering an exciting new phase of growth. As we expand partnerships with leading pediatric practices, children's hospitals, and health systems across the country, we are seeking our first Strategic Growth & Partnerships Leader to help build the commercial operating system that will support Ladder Health's next stage of national expansion.

Working directly with the CEO, this individual will help build Ladder Health's enterprise growth engine, accelerating strategic partnerships, coordinating cross-functional execution, and developing the commercial systems needed to support national scale.

This is not a traditional enterprise sales role; we're seeking an entrepreneurial healthcare leader who thrives in ambiguity, enjoys building new processes, and can serve as an extension of the CEO across strategic growth initiatives.

Core Focus & Primary Outcomes

  1. Primary Outcome: Build, advance, and expand strategic health system partnerships that accelerate regional growth, strengthen local market presence, and expand Ladder Health's national footprint
  2. Secondary Outcome: Build repeatable commercial systems, strengthen enterprise partnerships, and drive cross-functional execution that enables scalable organizational growth
  3. Long-Term Outcome: Help evolve Ladder Health from founder-led enterprise sales into a repeatable, scalable commercial organization capable of supporting national expansion

Core Responsibilities

  • Map complex stakeholder environments, identify executive and clinical champions, and build market-specific engagement strategies
  • Lead early-stage partnership discussions and coordinate executive engagement throughout the sales process

2. Drive Enterprise Growth Execution

  • Own the operational execution of the enterprise pipeline, ensuring opportunities continue moving with urgency and discipline
  • Prepare the CEO and executive team for strategic meetings, proposals, negotiations, and partnership discussions
  • Develop scalable commercial playbooks, meeting preparation frameworks, and follow-up systems that institutionalize founder-led growth
  • Partner closely with regional Ladder Liaisons to identify enterprise opportunities within existing markets and coordinate regional growth efforts

3. Expand & Strengthen Strategic Partnerships

  • Serve as the executive commercial lead for key health system relationships from initial engagement through implementation and expansion
  • Partner with Clinical, Operations, Product, and Technology teams to ensure successful partner launches and long-term success
  • Identify opportunities to expand successful pilots into broader enterprise partnerships
  • Support regional teams by advancing executive-level relationships while enabling Ladder Liaisons to focus on physician engagement and local market development

4. Serve as a Strategic Growth Operator

  • Act as a trusted extension of the CEO on priority growth initiatives, helping translate strategy into coordinated execution across the organization
  • Coordinate cross-functional workstreams spanning Growth, Clinical, Operations, Product, Marketing, and Revenue Cycle
  • Represent the voice of current and prospective partners in internal planning and product discussions
  • Build repeatable systems, processes, and operating rhythms that strengthen Ladder Health's long-term commercial organization

Qualifications and Requirements

  • Experience: 5+ years of business development, enterprise partnerships, strategic operations, commercialization, growth strategy, or Chief of Staff experience supporting healthcare organizations, digital health companies, or health systems
  • Health System Literacy: Proven capability navigating the clinical, administrative, and economic matrix of hospital environments and mapping out clinical champions
  • Workflow Comprehension: Strong understanding of health system operations, patient routing, care coordination, and ambulatory referral infrastructure (i.e. EMR/Epic interfaces)
  • Executive Presence: Comfortable engaging physicians, health system executives, board members, investors, and senior internal leaders with professionalism, credibility, and sound judgment
  • High Agency: Exceptional communication, writing, and presentation skills. An organized self-starter who handles high-volume follow-up with absolute professional persistence
  • Builder Mindset: Thrives in early-stage environments, enjoys creating structure where none exists, and takes ownership for building scalable systems rather than simply operating within existing ones
  • Early Stage Experience: Experience operating in early-stage healthtech environments, venture-backed companies, health system innovation programs, or healthcare consulting is highly desirable
  • Travel Flexibility: Willingness to travel as needed

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary paired with a milestone-driven, enterprise incentive structure that rewards performance on closed hospital contracts and multi-stage pilot conversions
  • Meaningful performance-vesting equity options, aligning your long-term upside directly with corporate valuation milestones and our Series A growth trajectory
  • A unique opportunity to become one of Ladder Health's foundational commercial leaders, helping shape the company's growth strategy, enterprise partnerships, and long-term commercialization approach as we scale nationally
  • Direct mentorship from experienced healthcare operators and a world-class board/advisor network
  • Comprehensive health benefits and a flexible, remote-first workplace culture

What is the Jack Talk for Indigenous Youth? Check out this video

The Jack Talk for Indigenous Youth puts community practice front and centre in educating about mental health struggle and healing from Indigenous perspectives. The program uses contact-based education and peer-to-peer outreach to connect Indigenous youth across Canada in conversations about mental health and healing.

A Jack Talk for Indigenous Youth is made up of two parts:

  • a video portion that explains social determinants of mental health from Indigenous perspectives and features youth stories about navigating mental health struggle, experiences with stigma and the relationship between culture, community and mental health
  • a live sharing circle led by an Indigenous Youth Facilitator who guides participants in exploring lessons and reflections, using the video portion as the spark for generating group discussion and connection.

jobs.excerpt: We have begun preparing for the interview process for this position and are only reviewing new candidates at the hiring manager's discretion.
jobs.description:
We have begun preparing for the interview process for this position and are only reviewing new candidates at the hiring manager's discretion.

Job Summary

Sports Reference, LLC is searching for a Scrum Master to assist our Agile teams by facilitating and coordinating Agile processes within the engineering department and cross-functional teams. The engineering team currently has 22 team members consisting of developers, testers, DevOps, and Scrum Masters.

We currently serve 20 million (and growing) monthly users on our free, ad-supported Reference Sites (, , , etc.) and , our SaaS offering that provides powerful search and filtering capabilities for deeper exploration of our vast databases. In 2023, we acquired , the viral baseball trivia game, and have since launched ad-supported grid games for basketball, football, hockey, and soccer.

To Apply

Please visit our jobs website at and submit your resume and a cover letter for this position.

We plan to begin the phone interview process the week of August 31st, but may start earlier depending on the volume of applications we receive. Applications arriving after phone interviews begin will be collected, but will receive consideration at the discretion of the hiring manager based on the progress we have made in filling the position. We have provided a general outline of our interview process here:

Our Purpose and Values

We democratize data, so our users enjoy, understand, and share the sports they love.

We value:

  • Respect for our users, the athletes we cover, and our team;
  • Craftsmanship in building tools and products;
  • Reliable tools and services that meet our users' needs every day; and
  • Data democratization. We publish many data sets for emerging and underserved sports. The New York Times covered our recognition of the Negro Leagues as major leagues in the summer of 2021. We added women’s college basketball data to our site in 2023 and now have the only publicly available database of every score in women’s NCAA Division 1 history.

More on our values and history can be found on our about page. To meet these expectations, we encourage team members to participate in company discussions and share new ideas, features or potential solutions to problems.

Background

As a Scrum Master, you will facilitate and coordinate Agile processes within cross-functional teams, ensuring the team can work collaboratively and efficiently to deliver high-quality solutions.

You will work closely with the team to ensure that the work progresses on schedule and to the desired level of quality. Additionally, you will help to foster a culture of continuous improvement and ensuring that the team is meeting its objectives consistently.

This is an entry level position, and Sports Reference will work with you to train your skills on the specifics of the role. This is a position within our engineering department, but no development skills are required.

We are searching for the role of a scrum master, but do not expect Scrum certification for this role. We provide continuing education benefits and would support you earning your Scrum certification.

Goals and Tasks for Your First Year (In rough order of importance)

Must-Reach Goals and Tasks

  • Organize project work in dashboards and project management tooling, and keep the status up to date
  • Help coordinate small to medium sized projects within the company
  • Report status of projects regularly verbally in small meetings, as well as written asynchronous communication when needed
  • Help create small tasks in project management software and assign as appropriate
  • Facilitate meetings (standups, iteration boundary, retros) ranging from 3-45+ people
  • Keep metrics about the status of work that is currently being worked on
  • Continually improve our process by analysis and holding retrospective meetings

Nice-to-Reach Goals and Tasks

  • Manage issues, small features and defects for teams
  • Facilitate demos of completed issues and requests
  • Help understand resourcing constraints for upcoming projects and suggest potential candidates based on skills within the engineering team

Qualifications and Skills

A qualified candidate will satisfy the following:

  • Evidence that you are capable of meeting many of the goals listed above.
  • Have a history of getting things done (and done well).
  • If you don’t think your application will have evidence that you can meet all of the 'nice-to-reach goals and tasks' above but still are interested in the job and otherwise qualify, please apply. Nobody checks every box—we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

Salary

Our salary range starts at $84k for U.S. based employees. We are a remote-first company and determine our pay range for this position based on the market rates for Philadelphia, our home base. The salary offered will be based on your experience and skill level.

Annual bonuses are variable and are tied to a percentage of the company's end of year profits and the employee's time worked and salary earned during the year. In the last three years, they have averaged 15% of an employee’s annual salary.

Benefits

Even though we are a small company, Sports Reference has a generous benefits package.

  • The total value of our benefits package is up to $30,000.
  • We cover full health and dental insurance costs for full-time employees and their dependent children. We cover 70%-80% of plans for an entire family.
  • We have a 401k with a match on your contributions up to 4% of your base salary. The 401k has many low cost investing options.
  • We pay all premiums for company-sponsored life and long-term disability insurance for all employees.
  • We provide up to $7,000/year in continuing education benefits.
  • Even if you live in or near Philly, you have the option to work remotely as much as you choose. We generally work a standard workday, but with flexibility to adjust hours within that framework.
  • Any parent welcoming a new child to their family is entitled to 13 weeks of fully paid leave, and up to an additional 39 weeks at half-time.
  • Employees begin with 18 days of PTO per year and an additional 8 paid company holidays and accrue sick leave at the rate of one day per month.
  • We will generally buy you whatever equipment will make you the most productive.
  • We typically will pay for reasonable moving-related expenses related to your acceptance of a position with Sports Reference. Please ask if you have questions regarding this benefit.
  • We provide a $68/month remote work stipend to cover the cost of internet access and incidental expenses.

Other Information

  • Sports Reference's first site was launched in 2000. We have bootstrapped ourselves to 45 full-time employees and have no venture capital backing.
  • Applicants must have a legal right to work in the United States or Canada. Hiring an employee not based in the US or Canada would be difficult to coordinate at this time.
  • We are willing to provide accommodations for candidates for whom the timing or structure of our interview process may be challenging. This may include early morning or evening interview times or provide payment to cover child care expenses if needed. If you are applying for a role where verbal communication is not a significant requirement, we may consider an alternative form of interview as is reasonably possible and suitable. Similarly, if an extended period of internet connectivity is a challenge, we may consider an alternate form of interview. If we invite you to interview, please let us know of any possibly necessary accommodations.
  • Our typical interview process is described at
  • Sports Reference is a remote-first company. Sports Reference is located in Philadelphia and non-Philadelphia candidates will be considered on an equal footing to those who are local. Presently, all Sports Reference employees are working remotely at least some of the time, but those in the Philly area may work from the office on days of their choosing.
  • This is a full-time position.
  • Employment at Sports Reference LLC is at-will and this position is an at-will appointment.
  • 100% of our merchandise sales support youth sports.

Sports Reference is a growing company, and your work will be highly visible and have a definite and immediate impact (Read about us in the New York Times and The Athletic ($)). We reached over 20 million users each month and served over 2.0 billion pages in 2023.

jobs.excerpt: ABOUT VICTORY LIVE Victory Live is a private equity backed technology company aimed at maximizing distribution and yield for live event ticket inventory.
jobs.description:
ABOUT VICTORY LIVE
Victory Live is a private equity backed technology company aimed at maximizing distribution and yield for live event ticket inventory. We provide an end-to-end software platform for the live ticketing industry, managing thousands of sports, theater, and live music event tickets on behalf of artists, promoters, teams, venues, and professional resellers. Victory Live’s comprehensive offerings include an established B2B marketplace, along with both a full-service and an automated SaaS platform to handle all elements of the ticket sales lifecycle, from ingestion to sales fulfillment.

THE POSITION
Victory Live is looking for a Mid-Level Software Engineer to build and maintain features across our Python and FastAPI services. You'll own well-scoped pieces of our B2B marketplace and ticketing platform end to end, from design through production, working closely with senior engineers who'll help you level up.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ship features. Build and maintain services in FastAPI, from a scoped design through code review to production.
  • Write tests that hold. Cover your code with pytest so regressions show up in CI, not in production.
  • Debug production issues. Use logs, metrics, and Datadog dashboards to trace bugs to root cause.
  • Work within our data layer. Write efficient SQLAlchemy queries and Alembic migrations that don't lock production tables.
  • Handle background and async work. Build and monitor Celery tasks and async FastAPI endpoints.
  • Take code review seriously. Review teammates' PRs and act on the feedback you get on your own.
  • Use AI tooling daily. Pair with Claude Code and Copilot for scaffolding, tests, and debugging, and learn where to trust them and where not to.

REQUIREMENTS

  • 2–4 years building production software, with at least 1–2 years in Python.
  • Comfortable building REST APIs with FastAPI and validating data with Pydantic.
  • Solid grasp of pytest and test-driven development.
  • Working knowledge of SQLAlchemy, relational databases, and database migrations.
  • Growing but genuine use of AI tooling in your day-to-day workflow.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Exposure to Celery, asyncio, or other async Python patterns.
  • Familiarity with Redis or Kafka.
  • Interest in ticketing, marketplaces, or high-transaction consumer platforms.

WHY VICTORY LIVE

  • You'll build the infrastructure live events run on; millions of tickets, hundreds of venues, many of the largest teams and events in the world.
  • A lean team where decisions move fast and your code reaches real fans, often the same week.
  • Every release has stakes. Every improvement is felt.
  • High expectations, low tolerance for politics, and a culture built on writing well and shipping with care.

OUR VALUES
We build the systems that power live event ticketing, and we hold a high bar for how we do it. Four principles run through everything:

  • Quality of life. Sustainable processes over heroics. Nobody should be a single point of failure, and nobody should be afraid to take a vacation.
  • Quality of code. Clarity over cleverness. If a teammate needs a long explanation to follow your code, it needs simplifying. Tests prove your work; they aren't optional.
  • Protection of production. Every change is reviewed, tested, and observable. We build with monitoring in mind from day one so we find problems before our users do.
  • Shared knowledge. We work across time zones, so we communicate in the open. Questions go in channels, not DMs, and one answer becomes shared knowledge.

ENGINEERING PRINCIPLES
We are an AI-native engineering team. Here is what that looks like in practice:

  • AI-assisted engineering. Every engineer uses Claude, Claude Code, Copilot, and agentic tooling as a routine part of their workflow.
  • Async-first. Most decisions happen in writing through Jira, Confluence, PR descriptions, design docs. We over-communicate on changes and under-communicate on noise.
  • Ownership mindset. Engineers are responsible for what they write and no code reaches production without review. Reviewers are co-owners.
  • Observability is part of "done." If the on-call engineer can't understand a system without reading source, more logging, metrics, and dashboards are needed.
  • Preservation of quality of code and life. We write code that is clean, tested, and maintainable so it serves us well over time, and we build sustainable processes so no one burns out or becomes a single point of failure.
  • Shared knowledge and continued education. We grow as a team by learning from each other through reviews, documentation, and collaboration.

OUR STACK & WAYS OF WORKING

  • Python and FastAPI power our B2B marketplace, distribution integrations, and partner-facing APIs
  • Web & mobile clients, REST APIs, microservices
  • Frameworks and tools: FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy, Alembic, Celery, pytest, Uvicorn
  • Data: Postgres, Redis, Kafka
  • Cloud & infra: AWS (RDS, ElastiCache, CloudSearch, EKS, MSK), Kubernetes, Terraform, Docker
  • AI tooling: Anthropic / Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, in-house agentic workflows
  • Observability: Datadog, Grafana, Elastic/Kibana, OpsGenie
  • Collaboration: Jira, Confluence, GitHub, Slack, Miro
  • Async-first, agile cadences, distributed onshore + offshore teams

BENEFITS & PERKS

  • Comprehensive medical coverage
  • 100% employer-paid dental, vision, life, and disability insurance
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid parental leave
  • Paid time off and company holidays
  • Employee wellness and professional development opportunities

Victory Live is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, Veteran status, or another other characteristic protected by state, local or federal law.

What You'll Do

  • Manage technical and non-technical vacancies from sourcing through offer acceptance.

  • Screen candidates for skills, experience, motivation, and cultural fit.

  • Track submissions, interviews, offers, placements, and other recruitment metrics.

  • Proactively match available candidates with relevant openings across Talentuch clients.
  • Identify recruitment challenges and recommend solutions.

Types of Projects You'll Work On

Talentuch Recruitment Projects

You may manage vacancies for several Talentuch clients, taking ownership of the recruitment process from sourcing and candidate engagement through interviews, client submission, and offer acceptance.

Managed Recruiter Projects

You may provide recruitment services directly within a Talentuch client's project. In this model, you collaborate with the client's hiring managers and TA/HR teams and work with their vacancies, recruitment systems, processes, and priorities.

This gives you exposure to different companies, international markets, hiring models, and recruitment challenges rather than limiting you to one type of search.

Compensation

Your contractor compensation consists of:

Fixed Monthly Fee + KPI Bonus + Placement Bonuses

Your fixed monthly fee and KPI bonus depend on your experience and recruiter level.

Monthly compensation can reach up to $1,600 at 100% KPI achievement, before placement bonuses.

Placement bonuses are paid on top of this amount for successful hires.

For Contingency placements, you receive 10% of the recruitment fee collected by Talentuch.

For example, if your placement generates a $7,560 recruitment fee for Talentuch, your placement bonus is $756.

Additional placement bonuses are available for successful hires with our Subscription/Engagement clients.

The compensation model is designed to reward recruiters who maintain strong pipelines, meet their targets, and successfully close vacancies.

Requirements

We expect from you:

  • Proven experience in paid social, performance marketing, and/or lead generation;
  • Hands-on experience running and optimizing social media advertising campaigns;
  • Strong understanding of how to generate and qualify B2B leads through social media;
